title: Second Love
summary: Second Love is an Indian Tamil-language television dating reality show that aires on Star Vijay and is digitally available on JioHotstar. The first season is presented by Ramya Krishnan and Shrutika Arjun.

articleSections.title: Summary
articleSections.text: The show revolves around men and women in their 20s and 30s trying to secure a place in Villa, a villa where they are detached from the real world. As participants move into a luxury villa to heal from past breakups and divorces and rediscover love by mingling with other residents.

episodesList.title: A Leap of Faith
episodesList.summary: Ramya Krishnan welcomes 12 people carrying the weight of heartbreak, failed marriages and lost love, all hoping for a second chance at happiness. Will they find it under one roof?

episodesList.title: Beyond First Impressions
episodesList.summary: As the contestants settle into the house, first impressions begin to evolve in unexpected ways. Cupid stirs emotions with a playful task, with hearts opening and curiosity growing.

episodesList.title: Bridges, Truths and New Doubts
episodesList.summary: Connections deepen and expectations rise. All are tested in a challenge that reveals how well they know each other. Later, a game of Truth and Dare stirs uncertainty.

episodesList.title: Secrets Unboxed
episodesList.summary: Emotions run high as misunderstandings and unresolved feelings begin to test everyone. Just when divisions erupt, Cupid introduces a challenge that uncovers hidden truths.

episodesList.title: A Chance to Connect
episodesList.summary: The mystery challenge leaves the house buzzing with questions. Cupid grants two couples an opportunity to spend time together, bringing forth new possibilities and fresh dilemmas.

episodesList.title: Feelings Take Centre Stage
episodesList.summary: Ramya Krishnan catches up with the housemates on their first week and Day 1 dates. A Real or Fake? challenge and a juice-shot task push everyone to reveal their true opinions.

episodesList.title: Truths Unleashed
episodesList.summary: Every relationship is scrutinised as Ramya Krishnan revisits the most talked-about moments. Long-simmering tensions erupt, and the house dynamics change in ways no one saw coming.

episodesList.title: Conversations That Matter
episodesList.summary: Connections continue to evolve through private chats leading to second dates. While some pairs seem more aligned, subtle tensions hint that not everything is as clear as it seems.

episodesList.title: A Dish, A Choice, A Surprise
episodesList.summary: The Cooking challenge tests relationships as the girls are forced to make a choice. The tasting table ends with an announcement from Vekkey that stuns everyone.

episodesList.title: Lost in a Maze, Found in Connection
episodesList.summary: The contestants take on a thrilling Blind Maze challenge that demands trust, communication and compatibility. Unexpected choices raise eyebrows, and surprising bonds emerge.

episodesList.title: Eyes Don't Lie
episodesList.summary: Sparks fly as the contestants engage in Eye Contact. While the vibe pairs get ready for intimate activity dates, Cupid guides the love pairs through honest conversations.

episodesList.title: Conversations That Change Everything
episodesList.summary: Private phone booth conversations give the contestants a chance to speak from the heart. Cupid arrives with fresh perspectives that challenge existing relationships.

episodesList.title: Letters, Apologies, Unspoken Emotions
episodesList.summary: Ramya Krishnan encourages the contestants to reflect on the relationships they've built. Personal letters and a new challenge compel everyone to express hidden feelings.

episodesList.title: Headphones, Spice Jars, Heartfelt Moments
episodesList.summary: The contestants take on the Headphone challenge to test communication and teamwork. A spice jar activity brings surprises and heartfelt moments that create meaningful interactions.

episodesList.title: A Choice, A Date, A Twist
episodesList.summary: As the contestants bond over bakery and pottery, thoughtful gestures bring some hearts closer. But before the day ends, an unexpected arrival shakes up every equation in the house.

episodesList.title: New Faces, New Possibilities
episodesList.summary: The arrival of two wildcard contestants brings a fresh wave of excitement with speed dates. New conversations and unexpected interactions open the door to unexpected twists.

episodesList.title: When Emotions Collide
episodesList.summary: A playful Spice Jar task drops Priyanka, Vekkey and Sindhoori in an emotional confrontation. As misunderstandings deepen, Cupid raises the stakes with a new challenge.

episodesList.title: No More Secrets
episodesList.summary: Cupid puts every contestant in the hot seat with a Lie Detector Test. As relationships face their biggest test of honesty, the wildcards answer thought-provoking questions.

episodesList.title: Seeking Clarity
episodesList.summary: When unexpected attractions stir the house, Cupid introduces a relationship counsellor. Consequently, every contestant is forced to confront what they truly want from love.

episodesList.title: Memories, Emotions, Unspoken Truths
episodesList.summary: Ramya Krishnan returns with a series of revealing questions that challenge both the housemates and the wildcards. The contestants reflect on their journey and what remains unsaid.

episodesList.title: Connections, Challenges, Heart Exchange
episodesList.summary: The changing equation between Veena, Dinesh and Rex takes centre stage. Through a new activity and challenge, honest confessions and shifting perspectives come to the surface.

episodesList.title: Moments That Stay, Questions That Grow
episodesList.summary: Priyanka and Vekkey revisit their bond through a symbolic kintsugi activity. A recap of old memories and new feelings leaves everyone questioning what comes next.

episodesList.title: Drama, Dates, Dilemmas
episodesList.summary: The contestants dive into dramatic enactments that spark laughter and conversations. As the Sundowner dates unfold, unexpected misunderstandings put relationships to the test.

episodesList.title: The Next Clue to Love
episodesList.summary: Heartfelt conversations and dreamy dates deepen connections. A tricky riddle task pushes everyone out of their comfort zone and sparks unexpected shifts in relationships.

episodesList.title: Across the Wall
episodesList.summary: A sudden wall separates the boys and girls, challenging their relationships. Genuine efforts and honest conversations force contestants to confront their futures.

episodesList.title: When Hearts Reunite
episodesList.summary: As the barrier falls, long-awaited reunions make way for deep confessions. Amid a wave of emotions, a sudden fortune-telling session sparks hope and questions about the future.

episodesList.title: Trust on Trial
episodesList.summary: Ramya Krishnan turns up the heat with a phone exchange task. A series of thought-provoking questions challenge couples to confront their trust, expectations and boundaries.

episodesList.title: Strong Bonds, Tough Goodbyes
episodesList.summary: Couples face their toughest test as four strong pairs secure their place in the finale week. The weakest couple bids farewell as doubts about their relationship take over.

episodesList.title: Dreams of Tomorrow
episodesList.summary: A romantic breakfast in bed inspires couples to envision a life beyond the house. A Couple Jar activity uncovers hopes, fears and expectations, ultimately testing their bond.

episodesList.title: Shopping, Cooking, Chemistry
episodesList.summary: From grocery runs to cooking together, the couples experience life as partners, sparking adorable moments. As they bond over teamwork and shared laughter, their chemistry deepens.

episodesList.title: Roots and Relationships
episodesList.summary: The arrival of family ignites heartfelt conversations and unveils unexpected revelations. The journey ahead takes on greater significance as relationships undergo scrutiny.

episodesList.title: Homecoming and Happy Moments
episodesList.summary: Cherished moments and questions from their loved ones inspire contestants to reflect on their relationships. A fun puzzle task celebrates teamwork, laughter and togetherness.

episodesList.title: Truths, Tapes and Tough Questions
episodesList.summary: Cupid hits rewind, reviving memories and unresolved questions. While some bonds find reassurance, others question whether they are strong enough for what lies ahead.

episodesList.title: Love Finds its Rhythm
episodesList.summary: A romantic beach date brings unspoken feelings to the surface. A vibrant musical evening fills the house with unforgettable moments, adding a new rhythm to the journey of love.

episodesList.title: The Grand Finale
episodesList.summary: After a journey of healing, hopes and second chances the finalists reunite with Ramya Krishnan and Cupid for one final choice. Are their bonds worth a promise beyond the house?

title: Super Subbu
summary: Super Subbu is a 2026 Netflix original Telugu-language television series written by Shivani Dhobal and Ramesh Eligeti and directed by Mallik Ram. The series stars Sundeep Kishan, Mithila Palkar and Murali Sharma in lead roles.
reception:
Divya Shree for The Times of India felt the series "loses momentum by juggling multiple subplots". Sreeju Sudhakaran for Rediff.com wrote that the series "touches upon how sex education is viewed by politicians as just another government target to be ticked off, and the pressure placed on junior officers to achieve those numbers, forcing Subbu into taking some drastic measures."
Sangeetha Devi Dando for The Hindu stated that the "finale deliberately leaves a few threads unresolved." Yashaswini Sri for The Indian Express wrote "The show earns its warmth by suggesting that laughter is not necessarily the enemy."
Nandini Ramnath of Scroll.in stated "This theme deserves better elaboration if there will be a follow-up season." Janani K for India Today wrote "By the time the finale arrives, it becomes evident that the creators are preserving several threads for another season."
ABP News reviewer Amit Bhatia rated the series 3.5 stars out of 5. A reviewer from Filmfare stated the series "may not reinvent the rural comedy genre, and its over-the-top treatment will not appeal to everyone." Reviewing for India TV Twinkle Gupta rated the series 3.5/5 stars.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: Netflix announced the series in October 2025. The series was premiered on Netflix from 2 July 2026.

episodesList.title: Subbu S/o Kukku
episodesList.summary: Subbu is a man whose life has been controlled by his father, Kukku, ever since Subbu was accidentally caught with an adult magazine in high school by his father, who was also the principal of the school. In the present, Subbu's family arranged a marriage alliance between Subbu and Divya. Subbu is working as a temporary computer lab assistant in a school. Kukku caught Subbu being intimate with Divya, and condemned his behaviour. Kukku demanded that Subbu finds a permanent job else he would cancel the wedding. During an inspection in the school by a government officer who was a classmate of Kukku, students are caught watching an inappropriate video in the computer lab and Subbu is blamed for that. The officer intends to inform Kukku about the incident. The principal promises that he will stop the officer from informing the incident to Kukku in exchange for Subbu getting transferred to Makhipur for the role of Sex Education Officer for six months. Fearing that the wedding would be cancelled, he agrees.

episodesList.title: Welcome to Makhipur
episodesList.summary: Subbu lies to his family that the new job is about social service. He attends the sex education training uninterestedly. Makhipur is infamous for high fertility rate, lack of awareness about family planning, STDs, etc. Makhipur has very poor network connectivity thereby making it difficult for Subbu to contact Divya. Kantha Rao is Subbu's assistant who helps him understand Makhipur. The village president wants the sex education program to be conducted successfully as it is a pre-requisite for constructing a water tank in their village. Ramesh Babu, brother of the village president, wants to become president and has enmity towards his brother. On his first day, he teaches about consent to some women of the village. That night, wives do not consent to sex and the husbands become violent towards Subbu after knowing that he taught them about consent.

episodesList.title: Virginee!
episodesList.summary: After being informed by Ramesh Babu about zero attendance in the sex-ed class, MPDO visits the village. The village president ensures maximum participation. While teaching the villagers about family planning, Subbu is mocked for being a virgin. He also messed up the condom on banana demonstration which angered the MPDO who considered firing him. After being requested by the principal, the MPDO allows Subbu to remain in the post. On a phone call with Divya, she questioned whether Subbu was a virgin. This angered him and he decided to contact the phone number which sells adult content in the village. He collects the pen drive from a location as per the instructions given on the call. While leaving the location, he found the person selling this was Swathi, a villager who aspires to become a movie heroine, whom he befriends. When he was about to view the adult content, his childhood memories haunted him and suddenly there is a power cut.

episodesList.title: The Man, The Mission
episodesList.summary: While trying to fix the power cut, he falls in the house of Rajini, the village prostitute. He narrates his entire story to Rajini. As he spent a lot of time in Rajini's home, people misunderstood that Subbu was good in bed. With the help of Swathi, Subbu and Kantha Rao meet the women of the village in Ramesh Babu's house and explain them sex chromosomes, sanitary pads, etc. Divya meanwhile is attending an interview for a US job. Swathi attends an audition and gives an impressive performance. Some of the villagers ask Subbu to train them to perform longer in bed like he did. He makes them do random exercises, drinks with them and befriends them. After reaching home, a girl from the village meets Subbu asking for help. She closes the door and when he wakes up the next day, he does not recall what happened after the girl came. He meets the girl and asks her about what happened last night. She starts crying and in a flashback scene, it is indicated that Subbu apparently slept with her.

episodesList.title: Family Planning
episodesList.summary: A month later, due to the poor outcomes of the sex-ed program, higher authorities assign Subbu a new task to complete, failing which his tenure would be extended. Subbu manages to organise a condom awareness program in the village despite hindrance created by Ramesh Babu and that day Subbu's family turn up as a surprise for Subbu's birthday. The village president, Kantha Rao and Swathi help Subbu keep his job a secret. Swathi gifts Subbu a handmade hourglass for his birthday. Before Subbu's family leave the village, Subbu's mother informs him about Divya's plans to go to the US. Subbu's friends from the village enquire him about lasting long on bed as the exercises are not helping. In a flashback scene, it is revealed that the task given to Subbu is to make four men undergo vasectomy. Subbu makes the four friends undergo vasectomy, without informing them about sterilisation, claiming that it will help them last long on bed. The girl Subbu apparently slept with informs him that she is pregnant and that her family will kill her if they get to know.

episodesList.title: The Mystery Girl
episodesList.summary: Subbu and the girl go to hospital and terminate the pregnancy. Subbu organises couple counselling in the village and people like it. Subbu's teaching efforts finally start to pay off. Co-director calls Swathi's home to inform that she got the role but Benjamin asks him to cast someone else. Swathi confronts Benjamin and he insults her. Divya informs Subbu her plans to go to the US and effectively cancelled the wedding. He gets drunk with his friends, has fun and reaches home. Swathi is at his home. Swathi and Subbu share their problems. Subbu sleeps with Swathi. She expects a romantic interest from him, but he thanks her for the sex and offers her money. She slaps him and leaves. Ramesh Babu publicises Subbu's impregnation and abortion secret. He demands Subbu to reveal the girl's name. In a flashback scene, it is revealed that the girl informed Subbu that she slept with her relative, became pregnant and needed Subbu's help for the abortion. Ramesh Babu starts attacking Subbu as he refuses to reveal the name. The village president stops the fight and asks him to wait till the water tank puja completes this week.

episodesList.title: Subbu vs Kukku
episodesList.summary: Swathi agrees to the marriage proposal arranged by Benjamin. Subbu gets to know that the abortion girl is Ramesh Babu's daughter. After the water tank puja, Ramesh Babu and his men chase Subbu. Swathi comes to his rescue and helps him board a bus. He apologises to her but she is still mad at him and the bus leaves. Divya and her family visit Kukku's home to set up the alliance again. Divya informs Subbu that her US visa got rejected. Subbu is no longer interested in the relationship but Kukku agrees to the marriage. Subbu and Divya's family accidentally get to know about Subbu's secret job. Swathi and Kantha Rao arrive at Hyderabad. Swathi informs Subbu that she ran away from her wedding and expressed her feelings towards him. Subbu embraces Swathi. Ramesh Babu calls Subbu, but Kukku picks the call and is informed that Subbu impregnated his daughter and helped with the abortion. Kukku loses his cool. Subbu confronts Kukku and tells him that he is proud to be a sex education officer. Kukku diswons Subbu. Subbu and Kantha Rao return to Makhipur by bus. The villagers surround the bus waiting to kill Subbu.

title: Sairaab
summary: Sairaab is an Indian Hindi-language musical romantic drama television series airing on StarPlus from 2 June 2026 and streams digitally on JioHotstar. Produced by Leena Gangopadhyay under Magic Moments Motion Pictures, the series stars Madirakshi Mundle and Krishna Kaul (replaced Rohit Chandel). It is an official remake of Star Suvarna's Kannada series Manasella Neene.
plot: The story follows Dr. Nayanika Roy, a single working mother and Ishaan Ganguly, a celebrity rockstar, as they navigate the challenges of love, family and relationships.
reception: In its opening week, the show recorded 0.7 TRP in week 23 of 2026 and had a household reach of 1.4 TVR. The next week, it clocked at a rating of 0.8 TRP.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Madirakshi Mundle and Rohit Chandel were selected to play Noyonika and Ishaan. Mohit Jaswani was cast as Rohan Basu. In July 2026, Actors Sagar Parekh, Avinash Mishra, and Aashay Mishra were approached for the role of Ishaan but Krishna Kaul was finalized to replace Rohit Chandel due to Chandel's POCSO Case.

episodesList.title: Meet Dr. Nayanika!
episodesList.summary: Single mother Dr. Noyonika lives a serene life with her daughter, Ujjayani. Then enters pop star Ishaan, reigniting her world, albeit with uncalled chaos!

episodesList.title: Nayanika's Surprise for Ujjaini
episodesList.summary: Ujjaini urges everyone to skip her birthday planning and confides in Indranil to celebrate Rohan's instead. Nayanika stuns her with unexpected tickets to the Sairaab concert.

episodesList.title: Ishaan's Memorable Performance
episodesList.summary: Ishaan makes a grand entry at the concert and leaves everyone mesmerised with his performance. After the show, he invites Nayanika into his van for an autograph as she thanks him.

episodesList.title: Ujjaini Seeks Forgiveness
episodesList.summary: Ujjaini staggers home drunk, and Nayanika slaps her in fury. Regretful, Ujjaini apologises and promises Nayanika she'll never make the same mistake again.

episodesList.title: Ishaan Meets Nayanika
episodesList.summary: Ishaan tells Nayanika that it is one of the most special days of his life. Later, after a hospital checkup, he surprises her by inviting her to lunch.

episodesList.title: Ishaan Opens Up to Nayanika
episodesList.summary: Sara encourages Maria to reconnect with Ishaan after his successful concert in Kolkata. Ishaan opens up to Nayanika about his deep bond with his mother, Maria.

episodesList.title: Angana Confronts Nayanika
episodesList.summary: Angana complains to Nayanika about Ujjaini's rude behaviour in the classroom. Mesmerized by memories of Nayanika, Ishaan pours his emotions into a song.

episodesList.title: Dinner Invitation for Ishaan
episodesList.summary: Nayanika is haunted by Indranil's confession about Angana. When Ishaan urgently wishes to meet her, Nayanika invites him for a dinner at her home.

episodesList.title: Ishaan, Nayanika's Poetic Romance
episodesList.summary: A rainy day brings Ishaan and Nayanika closer as he turns her poem into a song and offers friendship. Later, Nayanika helps him when his car breaks down.

episodesList.title: Ishaan Meets Nayanika's Family
episodesList.summary: Nayanika invites Ishaan for a special dinner with her family. As everyone warmly welcomes Ishaan, Ujjaini reveals a major truth about Nayanika's past marriage.

episodesList.title: Nayanika's Humble Request
episodesList.summary: Shreya starts doubting Nayanika's motives for hiding the truth from the family. Nayanika firmly pleads with Ishaan to stay away and never contact her again.

episodesList.title: Nayanika's Concern for Ishaan
episodesList.summary: Nayanika grows worried about Ishaan and feels guilty for being rude to him. She insists she can't stay away and recites the poem she wrote for Ishaan.

episodesList.title: Ujjaini's Unexpected Encounter
episodesList.summary: Ujjaini is shocked to find Nayanika in Ishaan's hotel room and asks him to attend the college freshers party. Indranil questions Nayanika about her absence at the hospital.

episodesList.title: Ujjaini's Heartfelt Apology to Nayanika
episodesList.summary: Overcome with regret, Ujjaini tearfully apologises to Nayanika for doubting her. She then reveals Sesho's love for her and urges Nayanika to meet him.

episodesList.title: Ujjaini Confronts Nayanika
episodesList.summary: Nayanika stays home for Ujjaini and Romeo's exams while the others decide to visit the Puri Jagannath Temple. Ujjaini questions Nayanika about Ishaan's intention in calling her.

episodesList.title: Nayanika Faces Humiliation
episodesList.summary: Nayanika's eyes well up as she watches Ishaan's concert on television. Tension rises during the family Puja when Nayanika is prevented from taking part in the rituals.

episodesList.title: Nayanika-Ishaan's Unspoken Emotions
episodesList.summary: At Ujjaini's insistence, Nayanika decides to attend the fresher's party. As the celebrations begin, she and Ishaan cross paths, stirring emotions they struggle to hide.

episodesList.title: Ishaan's Melodious Performance
episodesList.summary: At the event, Ishaan steals the spotlight with a heartwarming singing performance. As the audience praises his song lyrics, he reveals that Nayanika wrote them.

title: Sanai Chaughade
summary: Sanai Chaughade (transl. Wedding Bells) is an Indian Marathi language TV series which premiered from 16 March 2026 airing on Zee Marathi. It features Raj Hanchnale and Chinmayee Salvi in lead roles. The show is produced by Raju Sawant under the banner of One Day Creations. The series is an official remake of Zee Telugu's TV series Varudhini Parinayam.
plot: Jay Khanolkar, a highly disciplined businessman emotionally guarded by his parents' broken marriage, and Sharvari Parab, a fierce, strong-willed college graduate who fiercely guards her identity and traditional values. Hailing from entirely different socio-economic backgrounds and possessing contrasting personalities, the two are at constant loggerheads as their families’ paths intertwine due to their siblings Gautam and Asavari fall in love. Their intense clash of egos and ideals creates a simmer of emotional friction, pushing both to their limits. However, as they navigate underlying vulnerabilities, domestic duties, and societal pressure, destiny forces them into close proximity, gradually turning their initial animosity into an unexpected romance.

title: Sankalp
summary:
Sankalp is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language socio-political drama streaming television series directed by Prakash Jha and produced by Jyoti Deshpande and Dishaa Jha  under the banner of Jio Studios and PJP Films. It stars Nana Patekar, Mohammed Zeeshan Ayyub, Kubbra Sait, Sanjay Kapoor and Neeraj Kabi.

The series premiered on 11 March 2026 on Amazon MX Player.
plot:
Sankalp is an Indian socio-political drama that explores how power is manufactured not through elections, but through mentorship and institutional control. Inspired by the ancient Chanakya-Chandragupta chronicles, the series reimagines political strategy for modern India, where classrooms replace battlefields and bureaucrats replace soldiers. In short, this 10-episode drama reimagines the Chanakya-Chandragupta (mentor-mentee) relation in an imagined situation in contemporary India.
The large part of the serial is based in Patna (Bihar), while there are references to Delhi as well.
The series starts in a slow manner and it remains so all through.
reception:
Rahul Desai of The Hollywood Reporter India calls it a "A welcome return to basics," and as formulaic as Sankalp is, it's one of those uncannily sketched shows that mines a long-standing culture of reverence and obligation. Archika Khurana of The Times of India gave 3.5 stars out of 5 and said that "With its mix of strategy, ideology and personal conflict, Sankalp ultimately stands as a thought-provoking exploration of how power operates—not just in politics, but in the relationships that shape it."
Bollywood Hungama rated it 2.5/5 stars and writes that "SANKALP rests on a compelling storyline and strong performances by Nana Patekar and the other lead actors. However, the excessive length, silly goings-on and weak climax dilute the impact. Nevertheless, the show should manage to garner viewership due to its mass-appealing treatment and casting." BH Harsh of Cinema Express also gave 2.5 stars out of 5 and said that "The Prakash Jha series has its moments, but struggles to maintain momentum with its many subplots."
Deepa Gahlot of Rediff.com gave 3 stars out of 5 and noted that "'There is a fortune in stolen money, counterfeit notes floating around, and political skullduggery afoot, along with treachery, double dealing, kidnapping and all manner of wickedness packing the series so densely that the pace never flags and a profusion of twists keeps the story engaging even when it strains credibilit." Anuj Kumar of The Hindu observed that "The attempt at subversive social-political inquiry into mentorship and manipulation is diminished by overwriting and tiresome visual and creative contrivances."
Zinia Bandyopadhyay of Firstpost rated it 2.5/5 stars and said that "Sankalp is a show with ambition, ideas and a commanding central performance. But a sprawling narrative and uneven pacing dilute what could have been a far sharper political drama." Free Press Journal's Troy Ribeiro gave 3 stars out of 5 and said that "Sankalp is an engaging political thriller on mentorship, power and revenge, elevated by strong performances despite occasional narrative imbalance."
B H Harsh from the New Indian Express claimed that "Nana Patekar’s OTT debut lacks energy and coherence."

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: Prakash Jha announced a socio-political web series starring Nana Patekar and Sanjay Kapoor, which was initially reported under the working title "Laal Batti". The project marks Nana Patekar's debut in the OTT space and is set against a political backdrop, with the actor playing a lawyer-turned-politician while Sanjay Kapoor portrays his close associate. The series was officially unveiled by Jio Studios on 12 April 2023 during its large content slate announcement at the Jio World Convention Centre in Mumbai. Later in development, the show's title was changed and it is now known as "Sankalp".

title: Sangamarmar
summary:
Sangamarmar is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language Romantic drama TV series streaming on JioHotstar. It is directed by Vikram Ghai and produced by Jio Studios and Rajshree Productions. Sooraj R. Barjatya serves as the showrunner.
It stars Saurabh Raj Jain and Sheen Dass in the lead roles and the was released on 26 February 2026 on Jio Hotstar.
reception: Archika Khurana of The Times of India gave 2.5 stars out of 5 and said that "Sangamarmar is neither daring enough to challenge its own conventions nor regressive enough to fully embrace melodrama as spectacle. What remains is a handsomely mounted yet dramatically inert saga stretched thin across episodes." Siddartha Toleti of M9 News stated that it is a "A Fluffy, Soulless Romance."

title: Space Gen: Chandrayaan
summary:
Space Gen: Chandrayaan is a 2026 Hindi-language Indian television series created by Arunabh Kumar and produced by Premsheela Kumar and N. Kumar under the banner of The Viral Fever. Written by Shubham Sharma and Nitin Tiwari and directed by Anant Singh ‘Bhaatu’, the series stars Nakuul Mehta and Shriya Saran in lead roles.
Based on India’s Chandrayaan lunar exploration programme, the series dramatizes the period between the failure of the Chandrayaan-2 mission in 2019 and the successful soft landing of Chandrayaan-3 near the Moon’s south pole. It premiered on JioHotstar on 23 January 2026. The series received mixed reviews from critics, with praise directed towards its intent, performances, and emotional grounding, while criticism focused on its narrative depth, pacing, and execution.
plot:
Space Gen: Chandrayaan dramatizes events surrounding the Indian Space Research Organisation’s (ISRO) lunar exploration programme, focusing on the period between the failure of the Chandrayaan-2 lander in 2019 and the successful soft landing of Chandrayaan-3 near the Moon’s south pole. The series opens with the loss of the Vikram lander during the Chandrayaan-2 mission, depicting the immediate aftermath, including public scrutiny, internal evaluation, and the emotional impact on scientists and officials involved in the programme.
Across its five episodes, the narrative follows a group of ISRO scientists as they address organisational challenges, resource limitations, and the additional disruptions caused by the COVID-19 pandemic. As the team works to redesign and rebuild the lunar lander, the series portrays the process of refining mission protocols, managing setbacks, and maintaining morale, highlighting both the technical demands of space exploration and the human effort behind the mission.
The final episode centres on the critical hours leading up to the Chandrayaan-3 mission’s soft-landing sequence. It depicts the tense descent of the lander and the eventual confirmation of a successful touchdown at Shiv Shakti Point on the Moon’s south pole. The series concludes by underscoring themes of resilience, collective determination, and incremental progress following earlier failure.
reception:
Yatamanyu Narain of News18 rated the series 3.5 out of 5 stars, stating that “Space Gen: Chandrayaan leaves you with a particular kind of uplift: not the loud kind, but the earned kind, built from failure, humiliation, second chances, and stubborn competence.” Similarly, The Times of India critic Archika Khurana also awarded it 3.5 out of 5 stars, writing that “It is a respectful, engaging watch that leaves you not with awe alone, but with renewed appreciation for the people who quietly make history possible.”
Abhishek Srivastava of Moneycontrol gave the series 3 out of 5 stars, observing that “Space Gen: Chandrayaan is neither a perfect series nor a poor one. It succeeds in capturing the spirit of the people who made India proud in space exploration.” Divya Nair of Rediff.com, who rated it 2.5 out of 5 stars, remarked that “TVF deserves credit for breaking its mould of picking and sticking to favourable and comfortable genres. Space Gen could serve as a launch pad for more exciting content to come.” Vinamra Mathur of Firstpost echoed a similar sentiment with a 2.5 star rating, stating that “Space Gen: Chandrayaan could be a leap for TVF... They have always shone in telling stories about the ground realities of the nation. With their new show, they aim for the skies.”
Cinema Express reviewer BH Harsh rated the series 2 out of 5 stars, noting that “Except Prakash Belawadi’s sincere performance, there is very little to root for in TVF’s latest series.” Aishwarya Vasudevan of OTTplay, also giving it 2 out of 5 stars, wrote that “Space Gen: Chandrayaan humanises ISRO’s journey but suffers from a rushed, one-dimensional execution. Despite Nakuul Mehta’s strong acting, the series lacks depth and feels largely forgettable.” Rahul Desai of The Hollywood Reporter India was particularly critical, observing that “The TVF series dramatising ISRO’s landmark lunar mission is steeped in a lack of curiosity, craft and wonder.”
Writing for India Today, Shweta Keshri described the series as uneven, stating, “It’s a decent watch if you’re curious about India’s space journey, but it never fully takes off. TVF shows are known for keeping it real but this time they seem to have missed the mark.” Upma Singh of Navbharat Times rated the series 2 out of 5 stars and wrote that “overall, the series fails to do justice to its impressive subject.” Similarly, Kiran Jain of Amar Ujala also awarded it 2 out of 5 stars, stating that “the story lacks the depth it should have, and in some places, things feel rushed.”

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
summary:
Suttum Vizhi Sudare - Oru Chinanjiru Kuyilin Kadhai is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language drama television series starring Vinusha Devi, Tanishka and Yuvan Mayilsamy in lead roles. Produced by K. Jayalakshmi under Venus Infotainment, the series is a remake of Star Maa's Telugu language series Chinni.
The series explores the revolving around a young girl named Sudar and her deep bond with her mother, Abinaya. It premiered on Star Vijay on 5 January 2026 and is also available on the digital platform JioHotstar.
plot:
The story is about a young woman named Abi, who was wrongfully jailed for a murder she did not commit. In jail, she learns that she is pregnant and gives birth to a daughter, Sudar. After spending ten years in prison with her mother, Sudar is taken away by an NGO worker, Radhika, to go and live with her brother, Shanmugam.
Sudar faces hostility from Sarala, Shanmugam's wife. Abinaya continues to worry about her daughter's safety and future. As the story unfolds, secrets begin to unravel about her life, both in the past and present.

title: Single Papa
summary: Single Papa (lit. 'Single Dad') is a 2025 Indian Hindi-language comedy-drama television series created by Neeraj Udhwani and Ishita Moitra for Netflix. It features Kunal Khemu as Gaurav Gehlot, a lovable, confused man-child learning fatherhood after an unexpected adoption, alongside Manoj Pahwa, Ayesha Raza Mishra and Prajakta Koli.
plot: The series follows Gaurav "GG" Gehlot, whose life takes an unexpected turn when he adopts a baby soon after his divorce. His decision disrupts the dynamics of the Gehlot family, leading to a mix of conflicts, adjustments and emotional growth as they navigate the challenges of sudden parenthood.
reception:
Lachmi Deb Roy of Firstpost rated the series 3.5/5 stars and wrote, "Despite a few loose ends, Single Papa is indeed an enjoyable ride. Sometimes, the show does get loud trying to portray the lavish Gurugram culture, but at the end of the day it is thoughtful entertainment." Shreyas Pande of The Hindu wrote, "There is a fun, feel-good and festive vibe to the show, even though the sets and production design carry a sense of plasticity. It is a Netflix series after all and the grandness is up for show."
Sana Farzeen of India Today rated the series 3/5 stars and wrote, "It’s messy, stretched, sometimes clumsy. But it has its heart in the right place. And in a world where we’re still arguing over who should change the diaper, a show that spotlights men nurturing, crying, softening – and still being strong – feels like a conversation worth having." Shubhra Gupta of The Indian Express gave it 2.5/5 stars and wrote, "The premise of Kunal Kemmu show is interesting, and the setting is ripe for excavating societal hypocrisies revolving around parenthood, and while it’s at it, hoovering up issues like adoption, women’s rights, and of course, patriarchy."
Rahul Desai of The Hollywood Reporter India observed that "Despite a fun cast, the six-episode Netflix comedy is happy to be a rehashed portrait of single parenthood." A critic of Bollywood Hungama rated it 3.5/5 stars and said that "On the whole, SINGLE PAPA is a rare, clean, family-friendly web show that impresses thanks to its subject, performances, comic dialogues and emotional moments." Deepa Gahlot of Rediff.com gave 3 stars out of 5 and noted out that "In the midst of crime and cop shows all over, a family comedy comes as a relief."
Nandini Ramnath of Scroll.in said that "The sitcom-like humour is haphazard by design as well as without meaning to be. Single Papa is all over the place, but sharp casting, committed actors who have some great lines, and an excellent lead actor keep the show on the rails." Troy Ribeiro of Free Press Journal rated 3.5/5 stars and said that "Single Papa is not groundbreaking, but it is undoubtedly heartwarming. It offers a fresh Indian twist on single-parenting stories, blending melodrama with humour and emotion in equal measure.

episodesList.title: Deepa's Silent Fear
episodesList.summary: Deepa grows uneasy after spotting Karthik at Bhagyashree's house. Later, Bhagyashree asks Deepa about her husband and his work. She politely asks her not to ask for now.

episodesList.title: Deepa Faces Chitralekha's Scorn
episodesList.summary: Chitralekha slyly questions Deepa about the attacker's face, subtly humiliating her. Later, the police bring the goons for Deepa to identify.

episodesList.title: Kailashnath's Humble Request
episodesList.summary: Deepa questions Bhagyashree's motives, given their lack of a relationship. Later, as Deepa tries to leave, Kailashnath stops her and asks her to stay until the Pooja ends.

episodesList.title: Bhanu Faces a Shocking Surprise
episodesList.summary: Deepa distracts Jyoti with shopping to dodge her questions about her father. Later, Bhanu is shocked to see them returning with Karthik.

episodesList.title: Bhagyashree Invites Deepa for Puja
episodesList.summary: Bhagyashree gives Deepa a new saree and urges her to attend the Satyanarayan puja. Later, Bhanu grows worried about Deepa and Karthik's relationship and decides to spy on them.

episodesList.title: Kailashnath Honours Deepa
episodesList.summary: Karthik indirectly apologises to Deepa, while everyone thinks it's about the bitter food. Later, Kailashnath praises Deepa's cooking and rewards her with a gold necklace.

episodesList.title: Karthik Reprimands Bhanu
episodesList.summary: Karthik rebukes Bhanu for mistreating Deepa. Later, Bhagyashree insists Deepa and Jyoti stay with them, while Chitralekha urges Kailashnath to arrange Karthik and Kanika's match.

episodesList.title: Chitralekha Confronts Deepa
episodesList.summary: Chitralekha questions Deepa after misunderstanding her behaviour. Later, Bhagyashree gives Deepa full authority over the food arrangements for Kanika's birthday.

episodesList.title: Chitralekha Cautions Bantu
episodesList.summary: Chitralekha warns Bantu to be cautious of Deepa and stay out of her sight. Later, Jyoti urges Karthik to seek Deepa's permission to go out shopping.

episodesList.title: Vaijayanti Fumes at Mallesh
episodesList.summary: Bhanu grows suspicious when Karthik cares for Jyoti as Kanika asks about her father. Later, Vaijayanti lashes out at Mallesh for insulting her family.

episodesList.title: Jyoti's Surprise for Deepa
episodesList.summary: Deepa confronts Karthik and firmly warns him to keep his distance from Jyoti. Later, on Deepa's birthday, Jyoti surprises her and proudly shows her special drawing to Karthik.

episodesList.title: Deepa Takes a Stand
episodesList.summary: Kanika and the family ask Deepa and Jyoti to stay so Jyoti can continue her studies. Later, Deepa warns Chitralekha not to say anything against her father.

episodesList.title: Chitralekha Deceives Karthik
episodesList.summary: Deepa and Bhagyashree share a warm conversation about their bond. Meanwhile, Chitralekha secretly deceives Karthik with a false assurance to delay his wedding to Kanika.

episodesList.title: Deepa Confronts Bhanu
episodesList.summary: Bhagyashree urges Deepa to work as a chef in Karthik's restaurant. Later, Deepa confronts Bhanu as he tries to force her to leave Karthik's house.

episodesList.title: Karthik's Thoughts About Deepa
episodesList.summary: Shobha warns Bhanu to send Deepa back to her village, while Deepa agrees to stay at Bhagyashree's place. Later, at Kanika's birthday party, Karthik's thoughts turn to Deepa.

episodesList.title: Gautam Deceives Kanika
episodesList.summary: Gautam plants doubt in Kanika about Karthik's feelings for her. Later, Deepa tends to a drunk Kanika, while Vaijayanti arrives in the city searching for Bhanu.

episodesList.title: Kanika Faces Arrest
episodesList.summary: Kanika gets arrested for causing a serious accident while drunk, and Chitralekha blames Deepa for her arrest. Later, Karthik shields Kanika from the media.

episodesList.title: Chitralekha's Grip on Karthik
episodesList.summary: Chitralekha stands by Kanika amid the family's outrage over her actions affecting their reputation. Later, Chitralekha stops Karthik as he plans to reveal he doesn't love Kanika.

episodesList.title: Painful Moment for Kanika
episodesList.summary: Chitralekha provokes Kanika against Deepa, urging her to expel Deepa from the house. Later, Kanika's family feels tense as her drink-and-drive news airs on TV.

episodesList.title: Deepa's Silent Departure
episodesList.summary: Chitralekha bribes Deepa to leave the house, but Deepa walks away empty-handed. Later, Karthik spots Deepa and Jyoti on the road after Deepa leaves secretly.

episodesList.title: Vaijayanti Meets Deepa
episodesList.summary: Police arrive for Deepa, a witness in Kanika and Bhagyashree's case, so Karthik brings her back home. Later, Vaijayanti meets Deepa and shares her struggles finding her and Bhanu.

episodesList.title: Vaijayanti Learns Truth
episodesList.summary: Bhagyashree returns the chain to Jyoti, which Deepa had left behind before leaving the house. Later, Deepa reveals to Vaijayanti that Bhanu has remarried Shobha.

episodesList.title: Bhanu's Deceptive Tactics
episodesList.summary: Vaijayanti hits Bhanu for abandoning Deepa and marrying Shobha. Later, Bhanu emotionally manipulates Vaijayanti, making her resent Deepa's closeness with Karthik.

episodesList.title: Deepa Faces Abandonment
episodesList.summary: Driven by greed and Shobha's wealth, Vaijayanti sides with her and Bhanu against Deepa. Later, trusting Shobha to clear Bhanu's debt, Vaijayanti severs ties with Deepa.

episodesList.title: Deepa Comes to a Realisation
episodesList.summary: Deepa reflects on her past and realises that only Jyoti and God can give her strength. Later, Karthik and Deepa unexpectedly meet when he comes for tea at Laxman's stall.

episodesList.title: Deepa Faces New Accusations
episodesList.summary: Kanika grows upset as she sees Karthik standing near Deepa, having tea. Later, Kanika blames Deepa for her missing diamond necklace, gifted by Karthik on her last birthday.

episodesList.title: Jyoti Brings the Truth Out
episodesList.summary: Jyoti exposes the man who planted the necklace in her bag to frame her. Later, Deepa rejects Bantu's apology, saying that the truth matters more than an apology.

episodesList.title: Kanchan's Calculated Care
episodesList.summary: Kanchan suggests Deepa file a police complaint against Bhanu and her mother-in-law. Later, Bhanu publicly questions Karthik about his relationship with Deepa.

episodesList.title: Karthik Stands by Deepa
episodesList.summary: Kanika feels disheartened by Bhanu's arrogance and tells everyone she can't live without Karthik. Later, Karthik assures Deepa he will stand by her side and protect her.

episodesList.title: Kanika Doubts Karthik
episodesList.summary: Karthik asks Kanchan for more time regarding his marriage to Kanika. Later, Kanika senses that Karthik's behaviour toward Deepa is more than just help.

episodesList.title: Bhanu Faces Karthik's Wrath
episodesList.summary: The school principal humiliates Deepa and refuses Jyoti's admission. Later, Karthik warns Bhanu to stay away from Deepa and let her live her life.

episodesList.title: Karthik Ensures Jyoti's Admission
episodesList.summary: Chitralekha grows doubtful after learning that Deepa and Karthik knew each other. Later, Karthik speaks with the school principal and secures Jyoti's admission, angering Kanika.

episodesList.title: Kanika Raises Concern With Kanchan
episodesList.summary: Kanika complains to Kanchan about Karthik's growing interest in Deepa and Jyoti's lives. Later, Bhanu discovers that Karthik wrote his name as Jyoti's father on the admission form.

episodesList.title: Bhanu's Outburst Leads to Arrest
episodesList.summary: Bhanu angrily confronts Deepa, revealing Karthik's name on Jyoti's admission form, leading to a clash. Later, the police arrest Bhanu for physically harassing Deepa.

episodesList.title: Vaijayanti Blames Deepa
episodesList.summary: Despite Deepa's denial, Vaijayanti accuses her of filing a complaint against Bhanu. Later, Deepa supports Bhanu at the police station, leading to his release and Karthik's anger.

episodesList.title: Bhagyashree's Advice to Deepa
episodesList.summary: Bhagyashree tells Deepa to divorce Bhanu, while Kanika urges Karthik to accompany her to the temple. Later, Bhagyashree explains Deepa's predicament to Karthik.

episodesList.title: Bhanu's Demand for Jyoti
episodesList.summary: Karthik cheers Jyoti before her poetry competition. Later, Bhanu demands Jyoti's custody from Deepa, while Chitralekha discusses Kanika and Karthik's marriage with Bhagyashree.

episodesList.title: Deepa's Fierce Warning
episodesList.summary: Deepa gives Bhanu a stern warning to stay away from Jyoti after he tries to take her custody. Later, Kanika asks Kanchan to keep the Roka ceremony a secret to surprise Karthik.

episodesList.title: Deepa Demands Jyoti's Promise
episodesList.summary: Deepa makes Jyoti promise to inform her before taking any action or going anywhere. Later, she suspects a worker entering the home is someone she knows.

episodesList.title: Can Deepa Save Jyoti on Time?
episodesList.summary: Karthik and Deepa grow closer as they save the rangoli, while Kanika vows to win him despite his reluctance. Chaos erupts when Bhanu takes Jyoti away, forcing Deepa to rescue her.

episodesList.title: Karthik's Selfless Sacrifice
episodesList.summary: Deepa rushes injured Jyoti to the hospital whilst Karthik worries about her absence at his engagement. Later, Karthik gives his blood to save Jyoti after leaving his ceremony.

episodesList.title: Karthik Fights for Jyoti
episodesList.summary: Karthik stands up for Deepa and declares himself Jyoti's father when Bhanu arrives. Later, Deepa, in pain, recalls Kanika's words and prays to God for Jyoti's safety.

episodesList.title: Kanika's Deadly Threat
episodesList.summary: Kanika warns to end her life if Karthik refuses to marry her and vows revenge on Deepa. Later, Deepa apologises Karthik, blaming herself for his called-off engagement with Kanika.

episodesList.title: Karthik's Concern for Jyoti
episodesList.summary: Kanika demands Bhagyashree to set her engagement date with Karthik. Later, Karthik grows anxious upon learning that Deepa and Jyoti have left the hospital.

episodesList.title: Troubling News for Deepa
episodesList.summary: Deepa seeks shelter at a temple after escaping the hospital, but Karthik finds her. Later, Deepa grows anxious after receiving a legal notice from Bhanu regarding Jyoti's custody.

episodesList.title: Deepa's Fierce Stand
episodesList.summary: Karthik helps Jyoti with her maths and tells Deepa that she can ask for his help. Later, Deepa slaps the lawyer for his indecent and unprofessional proposal.

episodesList.title: Deepa's Fight for Jyoti's Custody
episodesList.summary: Kanika surprises Karthik with a sample of their wedding card. Later, Deepa meets a new lawyer who advises her to file for divorce against Bhanu and fight for Jyoti's custody.

episodesList.title: Deepa Draws the Line
episodesList.summary: Deepa confronts Karthik for interfering in her life, refusing his help. Later, Karthik insists that he is innocent in her father's death, forcing her toward a difficult choice.

episodesList.title: Deepa Learns the Truth
episodesList.summary: Deepa discovers that Karthik is innocent in Krishna's death and seeks his forgiveness. Later, Deepa thanks Karthik, who vows to stand by her and Jyoti.

episodesList.title: Karthik Challenges Authority
episodesList.summary: Karthik confronts the officials who demand Bhanu's signature for Jyoti's birth certificate. Later, Deepa grows emotional while revisiting her first home with Karthik.

episodesList.title: Chitralekha Pays the Price
episodesList.summary: Deepa shows Karthik her father's belongings at home, filled with nostalgia. Later, Kailashnath punishes Chitralekha by making her iron all the clothes for mistreating Jyoti.

episodesList.title: Bhanu's Revenge Plot
episodesList.summary: Bhanu vows to seek revenge on Deepa and plots to make her lose Jyoti's custody case. Meanwhile, Kanika anxiously waits for Karthik's arrival, worried about him.

episodesList.title: Deepa Faces False Claims
episodesList.summary: As the court begins Jyoti's custody case, Bhanu makes false accusations against Deepa. Later, Jaikanth questions Deepa about her relationship with Karthik, stunning everyone.

episodesList.title: Karthik Lashes Out at Bhanu
episodesList.summary: Chaos erupts in court as Deepa faints under false allegations, and Karthik fumes at Bhanu. Later, Ranjith declares Karthik's engagement to Kanika despite his refusal.

episodesList.title: Deepa Faces Kanika Boldly
episodesList.summary: Deepa firmly defends herself as Kanika accuses her of snatching Karthik from her life. Meanwhile, Vaijayanti realises Deepa's kindness after witnessing Shobha's mistreatment.

episodesList.title: Vaijayanti Exposes Bhanu
episodesList.summary: Kanika confronts Bhagyashree for prioritising Deepa over her. Later, Vaijayanti reveals that Bhanu married Shobha, and Karthik brings Jyoti to court to give her statement.

episodesList.title: Deepa Secures Jyoti's Custody
episodesList.summary: The judge awards Jyoti's custody to Deepa and finalises Deepa's divorce from Bhanu. Later, Kanika asks Deepa to oversee the preparations for her and Karthik's wedding.

episodesList.title: Karthik, Kanika's Ring Ceremony
episodesList.summary: Kanika secures Bhanu's bail, but he plots revenge on Deepa by targeting Karthik. Later, the family joyfully celebrates as Karthik and Kanika's engagement begins.

episodesList.title: Jyoti Discovers Bhanu's Truth
episodesList.summary: As Bhanu tries to attack Karthik, Deepa shields him and gets injured. Later, Jyoti faints on learning that Bhanu is her father, while Kanika vows revenge on Deepa.

episodesList.title: Jyoti's Naive Wish
episodesList.summary: Karthik and Kanika exchange rings, completing their unfinished engagement ceremony, while Deepa decides to return to her village. Later, Jyoti wishes for Karthik to be her father.

episodesList.title: Karthik Chooses Deepa
episodesList.summary: Deepa breaks down as Jyoti refuses to step away. Later, Karthik fills Deepa's hairline with Sindoor and rejects Kanika, leaving her shattered and vengeful.

episodesList.title: Deepa Demands Her Choice
episodesList.summary: Kanika exposes Karthik's secret marriage, shocking the family. Later, Deepa's heartbreaking confrontation erupts over the choice stolen from her.

episodesList.title: Karthik Defends His Choice
episodesList.summary: Deepa rejects Karthik as her husband, accepting him only as Jyoti's father. Later, Karthik justifies his actions to Kanchan, citing Jyoti's medical needs.

episodesList.title: Karthik Stands Up for Deepa
episodesList.summary: Karthik announces Deepa as his wife and takes her with him. Later, Deepa apologises to Jyoti for leaving her alone and promises not to do it again.

episodesList.title: Kanika's Moment of Courage
episodesList.summary: Deepa praises Karthik's loyalty to Jyoti. Inspired, Kanika decides to join the family business to prove her independence.

episodesList.title: Karthik's Final Stand
episodesList.summary: Enraged, Kanchan slaps Karthik for opposing her, prompting him to move out with Jyoti and Deepa. Later, Bhagyashree apologises to Kanika, blaming herself for trusting Deepa.

episodesList.title: Deepa Saves Kanchan's Life
episodesList.summary: Deepa pleads with Bhagyashree, seeking forgiveness for breaking her trust. Tensions escalate when Kanchan suffers a breathing emergency, and Deepa rushes to save her life.

episodesList.title: Karthik Accepts the Invitation
episodesList.summary: Ranjeet bans Karthik and Deepa from the house after tensions flare. Later, Karthik accepts Kanchan's invitation, choosing her happiness over conflict.

episodesList.title: Karthik Takes a Stand
episodesList.summary: Karthik challenges the gossiping guests to question him openly about Deepa. Later, Ranjeet cancels the prayer in anger, but Kanchan stands firm on her decision.

episodesList.title: Deepa Questions Her Fate
episodesList.summary: Kanchan urges Kartik to complete the ritual, sealing Deepa's place as his wife. Later, Deepa breaks down, questioning God and Kartik over her daughter's suffering.

episodesList.title: Bhagyashree Ends Ties With Kanchan
episodesList.summary: Bhagyashree confronts Kanchan for betraying her and ruining Kanika's life. Later, she breaks all ties with Kanchan, leaving her devastated and penniless.

episodesList.title: Deepa Discovers Ranjeet's Truth
episodesList.summary: Deepa sees Ranjeet with Kaveri and confronts him for cheating on Kanchan. Meanwhile, Karthik helps Sapna after a minor accident and takes her to the hospital for treatment.

episodesList.title: Deepa Hides a Dangerous Truth
episodesList.summary: Karthik feels a soul-deep bond with Sapna at the hospital, unaware of the hidden truth. Later, Deepa struggles with guilt as she hides that Sapna is his sister.

episodesList.title: Kanika's Obsession With Karthik
episodesList.summary: Kanika is hell-bent on winning back Karthik despite Bhagyashree and Chitralekha's efforts to convince her to move on. Later, Kailashnath insults Ravi when he comes to meet Kanika.

episodesList.title: Deepa Uncovers a Shocking Truth
episodesList.summary: Kanika declares war against Deepa, vowing to destroy her peace. Later, Deepa uncovers the truth about Jyoti's critical heart condition, leaving her shaken.

episodesList.title: Karthik Exposes Ranjeet
episodesList.summary: Kanika's digital trap leads to Karthik's shattering discovery of Ranjeet's true face. Later, Karthik's explosive confrontation unveils Ranjeet's secret second family.

episodesList.title: Kailashnath Reprimands Ranjeet
episodesList.summary: Kailashnath confronts Ranjeet for his extramarital affair and betrayal of Kanchan. Later, Kanchan apologises to Deepa and gifts her a necklace, accepting her as Karthik's wife.

episodesList.title: Kanika Confronts a Shocking Truth
episodesList.summary: Ravi reveals to Kanika that she is his daughter, leaving her shattered. Later, Chitralekha pressures her to secure the Kothari assets before the truth about her lineage is exposed.

episodesList.title: Kanika Clashes With Deepa
episodesList.summary: Kanika confronts Deepa over her presence in the house, reopening old wounds. Later, Chitralekha plots to use Kanchan to break the fragile bond between Deepa and Karthik.

episodesList.title: Deepa's Vow to Rebuild Trust
episodesList.summary: Kanika deliberately bumps into Deepa, stirring her insecurities. Later, Deepa determines to rebuild trust and patiently wait for Kailashnath and the family's forgiveness.

episodesList.title: Kanika Eyes the Family Legacy
episodesList.summary: Kanchan fiercely defends Deepa against Kanika's arrogance, deepening the family rift. Later, Kailashnath makes a shocking decision to hand the family legacy to Kanika.

episodesList.title: Kanika Deceives Karthik
episodesList.summary: Karthik rebukes Deepa for her unauthorized decision, deepening tensions at home. Later, Chitralekha sets a trap for Karthik as Kanika secretly carries out her dangerous plan.

episodesList.title: Deepa Saves Karthik
episodesList.summary: Deepa rescues a drugged Karthik from Kanika's trap and vows to protect him. Later, the family disowns Kanika for her crimes and Karthik severs ties, leaving everyone stunned.

episodesList.title: Kanika Seeks Forgiveness
episodesList.summary: Kanika apologises to Karthik and Deepa for her mistake and expresses regret. Deepa urges Ranjeet to reconsider accepting Kanchan into his life.

episodesList.title: Kanchan's Sweet Plan
episodesList.summary: Kanchan proposes a ceremonial remarriage for Karthik and Deepa, bringing hope to the family. Ravi soon uncovers the shocking truth behind the baby swap.

episodesList.title: Kanika Attacks Deepa
episodesList.summary: Ravi reveals a shocking childhood secret before the Kotharis. Kanika makes a lethal move that puts Deepa's life in danger, leaving the family shaken.

episodesList.title: Deepa Discovers the Truth
episodesList.summary: Deepa learns about her biological parents, while Kanika and Chitralekha realise their cruelty towards her and apologise. Later, Deepa, Karthik, and Jyoti live happily together.

title: Seher – Hone Ko Hai
summary: Seher Hone Ko Hai is an Indian Urdu-language television drama series that premiered on 2 December 2025 on Colors TV and streamed on JioHotstar. Produced by Richa Yamini under Ice-cream Dreams and Aarambh Entertainment. It stars Bhavika Sharma and Parth Samthaan. The series story is a loose adaptation of Turkish drama Kizil Goncalar.
plot:
Sixteen-year-old Seher Baig has a secret. In Husainpur, far from her father's crushing orthodoxy and cruelty, she studies in secret under her mother Kauser's guidance, nurturing a dream her father would never allow: to become a doctor.
But when she's forced to move to Lucknow and live under his roof, that fragile dream begins to slip through her fingers. And then her father makes a decision that tightens the bars: her engagement to Mahid Niyazi, the grandson of the city's revered mufti and a man whose name alone commands fear and respect. Mahid is principled, they say. Fair. Conservative. But he is also rigid, sharp-tongued, and morally unbending with a temper that keeps even his family at arm's length.
The narrative follows Seher as she enters an arranged marriage and adjusts to life within her husband’s household. The story explores her experiences with family expectations, social pressures, and differing views regarding her personal ambitions and independence.
Against all of it, Seher holds on to her dream. But in a world that has already decided who she should be, how far can one girl go to become who she is meant to be?
