articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: In late October 2025, Colors TV unveiled a teaser introducing the new show titled Seher Hone Ko Hai, featuring Rishita Kothari and Mahhi Vij. The series was released on 2 December 2025.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Parth Samthaan was confirmed to play male lead, Mahid. Mahhi Vij was reported join the cast as Kausar, and marks her return to TV after a 9-year hiatus. Apurva Agnihotri was signed for the role of Dr. Farid. Vaquar Shaikh were announced join as Parvez. In May 2026, Vij who played Kausar quit the series. In June 2026, Sumit Singh entered the series as Insha. In mid June 2026, the makers were struggling to find a new Seher Baig for the 7-year time leap. Actresses like Shivangi Joshi, Ashi Singh, Mallika Singh, Riya Sharma and Himanshi Parashar were approached for the role of Seher Baig and finally Bhavika Sharma was chosen to play the role of Seher Baig.

episodesList.title: Jab Seher Met Mahid
episodesList.summary: Seher, held back by society yet full of dreams, meets the rebellious Mahid. As opposites attract each other, will they draw closer or does fate have other plans?

episodesList.title: Kausar Comforts Seher
episodesList.summary: Parvez warns Kausar to stay away from Barqad, saying he has no ties with her. Later, Kausar encourages Seher to stay hopeful and pursue her dream of becoming a doctor.

episodesList.title: Kausar's New Beginning
episodesList.summary: Kausar meets Barqad at her workshop, where she arranges a new job for her. Later, when an auto driver misbehaves with Seher, she stands up for herself.

episodesList.title: Mahid - Seher's Alliance
episodesList.summary: Kausar tells Parvez she visited Chand Baba Mazaar to place a Shawl on his grave. Later, Moulana declares Mahid's match with Seher, leaving Nazima shattered.

episodesList.title: Kausar's Plea to Parvez
episodesList.summary: Kausar pleads with Parvez not to rush Seher into an early marriage. Later, chaos ensues as the flower decoration collapses on Mahid and Seher.

episodesList.title: Mahid Confronts Seher
episodesList.summary: Mahid lashes out at Seher when she urges him to think of his mother and prevents his suicide attempt. Moulana family leaves after learning that Mahid doesn't want the marriage.

episodesList.title: Moulana Stands Up for Seher
episodesList.summary: Moulana lashes out at Zahid for insulting Seher, declaring her their future daughter-in-law. Later, Wasim warns Parvez to be cautious as he is forming ties with the Niazi family.

episodesList.title: Parvez's Stern Warning
episodesList.summary: Parvez asks Saphia to cook Biryani for Seher and Mahid's match-making ceremony. Later, Parvez warns Kausar not to create any trouble until Seher's marriage is finalised.

episodesList.title: Mahid Remembers His Mother
episodesList.summary: Nazima feels deep remorse seeing Seher welcomed as Mahid's future wife in her place. Later, Mahid becomes violent after seeing the red cloth, recalling memories of Gazala.

episodesList.title: Kausar Saves Seher
episodesList.summary: Nazima leads Seher to Mahid with a red stole, hoping to enrage him. Meanwhile, Kausar disguises herself as a Moulana to protect Seher from a complaint.

episodesList.title: Mahid Loses Himself in Seher
episodesList.summary: Kausar urges Seher to meet Mahid, believing it is the only way to stop the wedding. Later, Mahid is captivated by Seher as he watches her gently tend to a wounded cat.

episodesList.title: Kausar's Fight for Seher
episodesList.summary: Mahid loses control and covers the fallen Kebabs with mud as memories of his mother resurface. Later, Kausar argues with Parvez, asserting her equal right to decide Seher's future.

episodesList.title: Seher Prays for Her Mother
episodesList.summary: Seher escapes from the locked room and prays at the mosque, begging for help to find her mother. Kausar shares her pain with Fareed, expressing her wish for her daughter to study.

episodesList.title: Mahid Invites Seher's Family
episodesList.summary: Mahid visits Seher's house and invites everyone to the Mufti's picnic. Later, tensions arise as Fareed heads to Parvez's house with the police.

episodesList.title: Seher Questions Kausar
episodesList.summary: Mahid steps in to confront Parvez for misbehaving with Kausar. Later, Seher questions Kausar about hiding the abuse and learns her true wish for her future.

episodesList.title: Secrets Surface at a Family Picnic
episodesList.summary: A picnic turns tense as Kausar secretly seeks Fareed’s help for Seher, while Nazima plots to frame her. Later, Mahid meets Seher alone, sparking hope amid a force marriage.

episodesList.title: Seher Flies a Kite With Mahid
episodesList.summary: Seher enjoys learning how to fly a kite with Mahid. Later, Seher panics on seeing Parvez searching for her and asks Asad to distract him with a snake alarm.

episodesList.title: Seher Diverts Mahid's Attention
episodesList.summary: Seher distracts Mahid while he searches her tent for the alcohol bottle. Later, she reflects on Kausar and Parvez's offer, as he mistakes her for Kausar.

episodesList.title: Kausar Feels Betrayed
episodesList.summary: Kausar gets angry and emotional seeing Seher and Mahid holding hands. Later, Seher breaks down and cries as Kausar refuses to talk to her.

episodesList.title: Mahid's Stern Warning to Nazima
episodesList.summary: Kausar urges Seher to chase her dream, while Mahid warns Nazima not to trap Seher for her own deeds. Later, Kausar tells Seher that Fareed will help them escape.

episodesList.title: Seher's Risky Move
episodesList.summary: Seher helps Ayesha escape from the Madrasa, but Mahid strikes Ayesha's lover for trying to take her away secretly. Meanwhile, Kausar feels grateful to Fareed for his help.

episodesList.title: Kausar, Seher Outsmart Safiya
episodesList.summary: Kausar and Seher cleverly turn the situation around and provoke Safiya when Parvez confronts them. Meanwhile, the community members thank Mahid for resolving Ayesha's conflict.

episodesList.title: Mahid Strikes Ayesha's Beau
episodesList.summary: Seher and Kausar head to the airport, escaping from the house. Meanwhile, Mahid finds Ayesha and her lover and hits him for trying to elope with her.

episodesList.title: Kausar's Advice to Seher
episodesList.summary: After failing to board the flight, Kausar insists that Seher escape alone to Delhi. Later, Seher crosses paths with Mahid at the airport. Will Seher escape safely?

episodesList.title: Mahid's Silent Protection
episodesList.summary: Parvez tortures Kausar, but Mahid's timely arrival exposes the truth. He then gently cares for an unconscious Seher, staying by her side and soothing her.

episodesList.title: Seher's Worry for Kausar
episodesList.summary: Hurt by Amal's words, Sultana attempts to end her life. Elsewhere, Mahid stands up for Ayesha against her forced marriage, while Seher grows anxious over Kausar's disappearance.

episodesList.title: Sultana's Shocking Revelation
episodesList.summary: Sultana shocks Fareed by revealing that Kausar is Amal's mother. Later, Parvez begins preparations for Seher's wedding, while Seher sets out to find Kausar.

episodesList.title: Mahid Faces Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Sultana insists Fareed keep Amal's identity from Kausar. Later, Husna arrives for Mahid's wedding, while Mahid worries Seher may not be willing to marry him.

episodesList.title: Seher's Secret Disguise
episodesList.summary: Safiya and Mahid continue their search for Seher, unaware that she is disguised as a man. Later, a neighbour informs Mahid's family that Seher has run away, unwilling to marry.

episodesList.title: Nazima's Sinister Plan
episodesList.summary: Nazima plots to stop Seher and Mahid's Mehendi ceremony using a snake to harm Seher, but the snake goes missing. Later, Mahid asks Seher if she is truly willing to marry him.

episodesList.title: Seher Hides Her True Feelings
episodesList.summary: Mahid asks Seher if she truly wants to marry him. Later, Kausar crashes the wedding by entering through the back door, shaking the celebrations.

episodesList.title: Moulana Cautions Parvez
episodesList.summary: Moulana reminds Parvez that Seher's age should be kept a secret from others. Later, Seher hesitates to join Mahid when he offers to drop her home.

episodesList.title: Seher's Forced Sacrifice
episodesList.summary: Kausar begs Seher to marry Mahid as Parvez tortures them. Later, Mahid visits his mother's grave and informs her he is getting married today.

episodesList.title: Seher's Dangerous Wedding Day
episodesList.summary: A group of transgender people who entered the event give Seher a Paan which contains something harmful. Later, Mahid confronts them by bluffing and catches them lying.

episodesList.title: Mahid Suspects Nazima
episodesList.summary: Husna confronts Parvez over Seher's disappearance. Later, Mahid questions Nazima about Seher's whereabouts, accusing her of deceiving him into marriage.

episodesList.title: Fareed Rescues Kausar
episodesList.summary: Husna and Nazima are disappointed by Seher's return, while Parvez thanks Mahid for bringing her back. Meanwhile, Fareed acts on Seher's hint and saves Kausar from Parvez's custody.

episodesList.title: Mahid, Seher Get Married
episodesList.summary: By the time Kausar reaches the venue, Mahid and Seher are already married, and the families congratulate them. Later, Seher apologises to Kausar for failing to stop the wedding.

episodesList.title: Mahid's World Crumbles
episodesList.summary: Seher feels remorseful for lying to Mahid and fleeing the wedding. Meanwhile, Mahid, believing she betrayed him, is left heartbroken.

episodesList.title: Mufti's Collapse Sparks Tension
episodesList.summary: Tensions rise as Mufti collapses and Fareed confirms a brain stroke, rushing him to the hospital. Later, Mahid accuses Seher of betrayal and blames her for Mufti's condition.

episodesList.title: Seher, Kausar in Danger
episodesList.summary: Kausar and Seher grow scared when they learn they are trapped in a girl trafficking ring. Later, Mahid feels relieved when Fareed informs them that Mufti's surgery is successful.

episodesList.title: Mahid Saves Seher's Life
episodesList.summary: Mahid saves Seher from a bullet whilst she escapes Kausar and other women. Later, Mahid threatens Seher with a hellish life as his wife filled with growing hatred.

episodesList.title: Seher Faces a Painful Moment
episodesList.summary: Mahid picks up Seher and takes her to the hospital to meet Mufti. Later, Seher grows vulnerable trying to wake the unconscious Kausar in the hospital.

episodesList.title: Seher Faces a Cold Welcome
episodesList.summary: Mahid asks Seher to return home with him, saying the family needs her, and instructs Parvez to look after Kausar. Later, Seher is insulted at the doorstep, leaving her shaken.

episodesList.title: Seher Trapped in Mahid's Rules
episodesList.summary: Mahid calls the hospital to reassure a tense Seher about Kausar's health. Later, Mahid orders Seher to stay inside the room, hiding their strained relationship from the world.

episodesList.title: A New Responsibility for Seher
episodesList.summary: Mufti gives Seher responsibility for the Niazi family, while Sultana apologises to Kausar. Later, Fareed is shocked to learn Mufti left the hospital without his approval.

episodesList.title: Can Seher Truly Hide Her Pain?
episodesList.summary: Mahid prays to take on the Mufti's struggles, silently choosing sacrifice. Later, Seher is asked to hide her pain and appear as the happiest bride at the event.

episodesList.title: Mahid and Seher's Reception
episodesList.summary: Seher rushes to Kausar, leaving Mahid's hand at the reception. Later, Mahid asks Kausar to introduce Seher, and the couple agrees to Tahir's idea for candid photos.

episodesList.title: Seher Reassures Kausar
episodesList.summary: Seher firmly assures Kausar that she will find a way to fulfil her dreams, which leads to an emotional moment. Later, Seher and Mufti share playful banter as they tease Mahid.

episodesList.title: Fareed Confides in Sultana
episodesList.summary: Parvez and Kausar bless Mahid and Seher at the reception. Later, Fareed informs Sultana that Seher and Kausar have been trapped by a women trafficking mafia.

episodesList.title: Seher's Freedom Put on Trial
episodesList.summary: Seher defends her integrity before Mufti, but doubts linger. Later, Mahid brutally reminds Seher of her lack of freedom in the house.

episodesList.title: Seher's Struggle to Prove Innocence
episodesList.summary: Mahid realises that Seher made the sweets to protect the family's reputation. Later, Seher decides to prove her innocence and confronts the shopkeeper about the groceries.

episodesList.title: Amaal's Artistic Aspirations
episodesList.summary: Mufti informs Mahid that Zafar Ali will visit him and Seher. Later, Amaal confides in Kausar about her passion for stories and writing over becoming a doctor.

episodesList.title: Seher Earns the Niazis' Trust
episodesList.summary: Zafar Ali blesses Seher and Mahid for their wedding, as Seher wins his heart with her knowledge of their ancestors. Later, Zafar Ali feels that Seher can uphold the Niazi name.

episodesList.title: Sultana's Concern for Amaal
episodesList.summary: Seher tries to convince Mahid that Huzma's compulsion made her steal the bridal safety pin. Later, Sultana fears Amaal meeting Kausar, as she is her biological mother.

episodesList.title: Mahid's Gift for Seher
episodesList.summary: At Kausar's request, Seher fills out her admission form and struggles to hide it from Mahid. Later, Mahid gifts Seher a phone, leaving her feeling delighted and surprised.

episodesList.title: Kausar's Concern for Seher
episodesList.summary: Mufti insists Seher and Mahid go on vacation as newlyweds, but Seher faints while packing. Meanwhile, Kausar feels sad as Seher doesn't turn up to submit the admission form.

episodesList.title: Seher's Risky Escape
episodesList.summary: Husna spikes Seher's drink to prevent her from going on the honeymoon. Meanwhile, Seher sneaks out of the house to submit her admission form, but faints on the road.

episodesList.title: Mahid Hunts for Seher
episodesList.summary: Mahid sets out to search for Seher after discovering she escaped the house. Meanwhile, Seher overcomes obstacles and reaches the education board to submit her admission form.

episodesList.title: Seher's Ambition Unveiled
episodesList.summary: Seher goes to the boarding school to apply for admission. Later, she confides in Mahid about her dream of becoming a doctor and reveals that she married him for Kausar's sake.

episodesList.title: Seher Stands Her Ground
episodesList.summary: Seher defends her dignity as Husna confronts her about the escape. Meanwhile, Mahid recalls his mother at her grave, and Safiya provokes Parvez over Kausar and Fareed's affair.

episodesList.title: Mahid Conceals Seher's Truth
episodesList.summary: Husna forces Seher to leave the house for sneaking out. Later, Mahid falsely claims to the family that he escorted Seher out, while she had actually escaped.

episodesList.title: Husna Forces Kausar to Reveal Truth
episodesList.summary: Seher firmly tells Mahid that she will leave the Niyazi house if he doesn't let her study. Later, Husna traps Kausar, pressing her to reveal the reason behind Seher's escape.

episodesList.title: Mahid Saves Seher
episodesList.summary: While Seher buys books, goons try to kidnap her, but Mahid arrives on time and rescues her. Meanwhile, Parvez confronts Kausar as she packs to leave for Husainpur.

episodesList.title: Mahid Fights Back
episodesList.summary: Haunted by memories at the fort, Mahid is tracked down as goons close in. Later, he snaps out of his pain and fiercely fights back to protect Seher.

episodesList.title: Seher, Mahid Face Forest Trouble
episodesList.summary: Amaal insists that Fareed take her and Kausar to Aadhum Gunj to check on Seher. Meanwhile, at night, Seher and Mahid make a bonfire in the forest to stay safe.

episodesList.title: Seher Faces the Jungle's Threat
episodesList.summary: A tiger approaches Seher and Mahid as they wake to danger in the jungle. Later, Mahid shoots at the tiger and carries a tired Seher to safety.

episodesList.title: Amaal Seeks the Truth
episodesList.summary: Seher informs Kausar that Mahid has allowed her to sit her board exams. Later, Amaal confronts Fareed, demanding the truth about whether she is adopted.

episodesList.title: Mahid Haunted by Memories
episodesList.summary: Kausar comforts Amaal as she worries about Sultana's betrayal. Later, Mahid recalls his mother at dinner, and Seher urges him to join the family.

episodesList.title: Wasim Schemes Against Mahid
episodesList.summary: Wasim plots to drive Mahid mad, while Fareed tells Sultana that Amaal knows she was adopted. Later, Seher diverts the family's attention from Mahid's anger.

episodesList.title: Seher in a Fix
episodesList.summary: Mahid suffers a sudden attack, leaving Seher panicked as she struggles to help him. Later, Mahid's unexpected gratitude pushes Seher to suspect hidden enemies behind the crisis.

episodesList.title: Kausar Confronts Parvez
episodesList.summary: Kausar questions Parvez about Munira, whom he claimed died at birth. Meanwhile, Seher warns Mahid that someone in his own family is secretly scheming against him.

episodesList.title: Seher Suspects Husna
episodesList.summary: Seher grows suspicious of Husna's sudden change in behaviour towards her. Later, Fareed reveals his memories to Amaal to prove that she is his daughter.

episodesList.title: Husna Turns Mahid Against Kausar
episodesList.summary: Kausar and Parvez arrive at Mahid's house with Sehri. Seher presents her preparation to them. Later, Husna provokes Mahid, saying Kausar followed him and Seher to Aadhum Gunj.

episodesList.title: Mahid's Heart in Turmoil
episodesList.summary: Tensions rise as Husna slyly tricks Mahid into believing Seher is exploiting his trauma. Meanwhile, Fareed panics as Kausar seeks information about her long-lost daughter.

episodesList.title: Seher in a Conundrum
episodesList.summary: Seher struggles with doubt after Mahid's actions shake her trust. Guided by Kausar's words, she decides to stay vigilant yet return to Mahid despite the turmoil.

episodesList.title: Kausar Receives Shocking News
episodesList.summary: Mahid confronts Seher over her lies as he comes to take her home. Elsewhere, Fareed tells Kausar that Munira is dead, while Seher is given responsibility for the Masjid's Iftari.

episodesList.title: Will Seher Sit for Exam?
episodesList.summary: Mahid denies Seher's request for help with managing her exams and Iftari preparations. Seher breaks down, unable to leave the house to attend her exam. Will she make it?

episodesList.title: Mahid Protects Seher's Secret
episodesList.summary: When Husna questions Mahid about Seher's whereabouts, he hides the truth about her exam. Kausar expresses her dismay at Seher, noticing her growing concern for Mahid.

episodesList.title: Seher Follows Mahid
episodesList.summary: Seher searches for Mahid as he slips away, ignoring warnings about him. She disguises herself to stay close, but his suspicion grows while her doubts begin to deepen.

episodesList.title: Seher Sparks Mahid's Anger
episodesList.summary: Seher disguises herself to protect Mahid but lands in chaos after his outburst. As tensions rise, egos clash and a heated standoff exposes cracks in their bond.

episodesList.title: Nazima's Hidden Delight
episodesList.summary: Nazima is quietly satisfied knowing that Seher and Mahid have barely shared a marital relationship. Elsewhere, Fareed strongly asserts to Kausar that Amaal is his daughter.

episodesList.title: Mahid's Promise to Seher
episodesList.summary: Mahid vows unwavering support to Seher through every challenge. Seher fiercely defends Mahid when Kausar questions his actions and intentions.

episodesList.title: Husna and Nazima's Scheme
episodesList.summary: Husna and Nazima plot to keep Seher away from Mahid, while Fareed urges Kausar to meet Amaal. Seher apologises to Kausar for her reckless words.

episodesList.title: Seher Fears Losing Mahid
episodesList.summary: Nazima fabricates a story about her closeness with Mahid to Seher, leaving her heartbroken. Mahid worries as he cannot find Seher, while Kausar urges Seher to focus on her exam.

episodesList.title: Mahid's Fear for Seher
episodesList.summary: Kausar tries to keep Mahid away from Seher. Mahid panics when he cannot find Seher, but feels relieved when she calls him to inform her whereabouts.

episodesList.title: Mahid Confronts Seher
episodesList.summary: Husna reveals to Mahid that Seher is a minor, prompting him to confront her about her age. Seher is asked to leave the house, while Parvez attempts to resolve the matter.

episodesList.title: Mahid Ends His Marriage With Seher
episodesList.summary: Mahid urges Seher to leave with a thirty lakh cheque to end their relationship. Kausar takes Seher away from Parvez to start a new life.

episodesList.title: Seher's Heartbreak
episodesList.summary: Mahid, hurt by memories of Seher, is admitted to the hospital in the bed next to hers. Seher feels remorse as she recalls Mahid's decision to divorce her.

episodesList.title: Parvez Reveals Hidden Truth
episodesList.summary: Seher meets Mahid, sparking tension as Husna blames her for his critical state. Parvez escapes from Fareed and reveals to Kausar that Munira is alive.

episodesList.title: Mahid Dwells on Seher
episodesList.summary: Mahid learns about Nazima and Husna's plot to ruin Seher's life. As everyone exchanges Chand Mubarak wishes, Mahid flies a kite, lost in memories of Seher.

episodesList.title: Parvez Targets Kausar
episodesList.summary: Parvez reveals his plan to bring down Kausar and isolates her. Mahid rescues Seher, and their encounter brings back memories. Later, Seher takes a defiant stand against Parvez.

episodesList.title: Seher Finds Her Freedom
episodesList.summary: Seher embraces her newfound freedom and shares joyful moments with Mahid. Tensions rise as Mahid confronts Nazima, demanding the truth behind hidden matters.

episodesList.title: Mahid's Frantic Search for Seher
episodesList.summary: Seher helps a girl hide from a frightening magician, while Mahid searches for Seher. Amaal asks Fareed and Sultana for a DNA test to confirm they are her parents.

episodesList.title: Mahid Urges Seher to Move On
episodesList.summary: Seher confronts Mahid about Nazima and accuses him of betrayal. But as she pours out her feelings, Mahid, with a heavy heart, asks her to forget him and focus on her career.

episodesList.title: Husna Showers Praise on Hyder
episodesList.summary: As Hyder arrives, Husna introduces and praises him before everyone. Elsewhere, Mahid struggles to find a way to escape from the terrace to take Seher to the hospital.

episodesList.title: Seher Fights for Life
episodesList.summary: As Seher battles for survival in the hospital, tensions explode between Mahid and Nazima over hidden truths. Fear and guilt spread as shocking secrets threaten to tear everyone.

episodesList.title: Mahid Senses Danger
episodesList.summary: As Seher fights for life, Mahid senses a sinister presence lurking within the hospital walls. A shocking truth unfolds when Mahid uncovers the deadly hand behind the attack.

episodesList.title: Mahid Saves Seher
episodesList.summary: Mahid races against time to protect Seher as Jaadugar attempts another deadly attack. With the truth unravelling, Jaadugar is caught, and Mahid makes a heartbreaking decision.

episodesList.title: Mahid's Shocking Decision
episodesList.summary: Seher regains consciousness and is shaken by memories of her words to Mahid last night. Mahid impulsively asks Nazima to get engaged with him.

episodesList.title: Kausar Confronts Parvez
episodesList.summary: Seher thanks Mahid for saving her and confides in him about her relationship pain. Meanwhile, Kausar and Parvez argue heatedly when she questions him about Munira's whereabouts.

episodesList.title: Seher Uncovers Ghazala's Diary
episodesList.summary: Mahid regrets hating his mother, Ghazala, after learning of her goodness. Soon, Seher finds Ghazala's diary, hinting at hidden secrets and the truth behind her death.

episodesList.title: Safiya's Advice to Parvez
episodesList.summary: Seher disguises herself as a worker in Mahid's house to uncover clues about Ghazala. Safiya urges Parvez to trace Munira's whereabouts from the hospital of her birth.

episodesList.title: Seher Guides Mahid's Path
episodesList.summary: Wasim learns Husna is plotting to make Hyder outshine Mahid before the Mufti. Seher distracts Mahid, urging him to attend the Mufti's meeting and take responsibility.

episodesList.title: Seher Finds a Hidden Letter
episodesList.summary: Seher tricks Mahid to stay behind and secretly searches his house for answers. As the family praises Mahid, she uncovers a hidden letter from his mother among his old belongings.

episodesList.title: Seher's Moment of Heartbreak
episodesList.summary: Nazima agrees to get engaged to Mahid, breaking Seher's heart. Mahid finds a letter from his mother and breaks down in tears.

episodesList.title: Mahid's Emotional Breakdown
episodesList.summary: Mahid is overwhelmed by grief as he imagines Ghazala's presence and breaks down. Seher comforts him, reminding him that Ghazala lives in his heart.

episodesList.title: Seher Uncovers a Deadly Plot
episodesList.summary: Seher seeks Tahir's help while Nazima shocks everyone with news of her engagement to Mahid. While escaping, Seher overhears a chilling plan to kill Mahid and gets caught by Hyder.

episodesList.title: Mahid's Quest for Ghazala
episodesList.summary: Seher feels happy about Mahid's alliance with Nazima, concealing her true emotions. Mahid seeks the truth from everyone about what Ghazala endured before her death.

episodesList.title: Seher Uncovers a Hidden Plot
episodesList.summary: Mahid questions his family about Ghazala's sudden departure, and Seher investigates a hidden plot against him. While Mufti cancels the alliance, Mahid stands firm on his decision.

episodesList.title: Seher's Plan With Tahir
episodesList.summary: Seher dismisses Mahid's engagement to Nazima and seeks Tahir's help to save him. Fareed admires Kausar's courage and strong vision despite her struggles.

episodesList.title: Fatima and Wasim's Web of Deceit
episodesList.summary: Kausar uncovers the true reason behind Mahid's engagement to Nazima, which distances him from Seher. Wasim and Fatima set their scheme into motion the moment Mahid arrives.

episodesList.title: Mahid's Unforgotten Love for Seher
episodesList.summary: Mahid envisions Seher and admits he can't forget her despite being engaged to Nazima. Seher tries to save Mahid from an assassination attempt during a dance performance.

episodesList.title: Seher cautions Mahid
episodesList.summary: Seher tells Mahid she's his wife and has a right to stay in the Niazi mansion. She warns Mahid of a threat, locks him in a room, and rushes to find his attacker.

episodesList.title: Seher rushes to save Mahid
episodesList.summary: Seher secretly enters Niyazi Manzil to rescue Mahid after his disappearance shocks Nazima and the guests. Seher finds Mahid unconscious due to cold and struggles to revive him.

episodesList.title: Seher and Mahid grow close
episodesList.summary: After saving Mahid's life, Seher apologises for her mistake while helping him recover in an unusual way. Mahid struggles between his feelings and his engagement to Nazima

episodesList.title: Mahid calls the police
episodesList.summary: Seher tells Mahid the secret that Ghazala wrote in her diary, and he calls the police to investigate the house. Everyone is shocked when Mahid demands Ghazala's case be reopened.

episodesList.title: Parvez plots against Kausar
episodesList.summary: Seher is shocked by Mahid's calmness after her mistake. Parvez, intent on killing Kausar, pushes her into the water tank, and Mahid later finds Kausar inside the tank.

episodesList.title: Mahid fumes at Parvez
episodesList.summary: Seher and Mahid rescue Kausar, while Amaal questions Sultana about her real parents. Furious with Parvez, Mahid vows to punish him for mistreating Kausar.

episodesList.title: Mahid gets Seher and Kausar home
episodesList.summary: Mahid publicly humiliates Parvez for harassing Kausar, and she boldly takes revenge on him. Mahid shocks the family by bringing Seher and Kausar home despite Husna's objections.

episodesList.title: Seher's unwavering promise to Mahid
episodesList.summary: Mahid shares memories of Ghazala with Seher. Later, Seher confides that the Niyazi family is trying to kill him and promises Mahid she will always stand by him.

episodesList.title: Kausar is impressed by Mahid
episodesList.summary: Kausar praises Mahid for his kind nature. Mahid refuses to marry Nazima, and then the police share a key detail of Ghazala's case with Mahid and Seher and hand over her file

episodesList.title: Seher and Mahid turn spies
episodesList.summary: Mahid and Seher plant spy cameras across Niyazi Manzil to uncover the truth behind Ghazala's murder. Meanwhile, emotions run high when Kausar discovers that Amaal is her daughter.

episodesList.title: Mahid and Wasim's Violent clash
episodesList.summary: Seher playfully scares Mahid with a fake gun, but the moment quickly turns serious after they uncover Wasim's secret. Mahid confronts Wasim, and they both get into a violent fight.

episodesList.title: Wasim kidnaps Seher
episodesList.summary: Seher's attempt to escape fails when Wasim catches and kidnaps her, putting her life in danger. Wasim threatens Mahid to return the camera if he wants Seher alive.

episodesList.title: Seher gives Mahid a clue
episodesList.summary: Mahid vows to save Seher, while Seher keeps Wasim engaged after his threat. Seher calls Mahid and gives him a tricky hint, but will he reach her in time?

episodesList.title: Wasim faces Mahid's fury
episodesList.summary: Parvez secretly overhears Kausar and Fareed at the hospital. Tensions rise as Wasim and Mahid fight fiercely, but Seher intervenes!

episodesList.title: Husna's big move to win Mahid's trust
episodesList.summary: As Wasim points a gun at Seher and Mahid, Husna deliberately gets shot to gain Mahid's trust. Mahid expresses his regret to Seher for misunderstanding Ghazala.

episodesList.title: Seher learns the hidden truth
episodesList.summary: At the police station, Wasim fumes at Husna for framing him in Ghazala's case. Mahid confesses to Seher that Nazima had intoxicated him and taken him to her room.

episodesList.title: Kasaur is overjoyed at Seher's result
episodesList.summary: Kausar feels overjoyed when Seher scores good grades in her tenth board exams. Mahid gifts Ghazala's book almirah to Seher and congratulates her warmly.

episodesList.title: Mufti opposes Seher's education
episodesList.summary: Mahid urges Seher to move on and pursue her dreams. Tensions rise as Mufti demands that Seher abandon her education, citing the Niyazi family's expectations.

episodesList.title: Seher fights for her education
episodesList.summary: Seher firmly stands up for her right to continue studying, while Mufti refuses to support her education. Parvez provokes Mufti and accuses Kausar of having an affair with Fareed.

episodesList.title: Seher leaves Niyazi Manzil
episodesList.summary: After leaving Niyazi Manzil, Seher and Kausar find themselves stranded on a deserted road, but Mahid comes for help. Meanwhile, Husna fuels Mufti's anger against Seher and Mahid.

episodesList.title: Mahid seeks forgiveness
episodesList.summary: Mahid and Seher share their plan with Tahir and Hyder and ask for their support. Then he apologises to Seher for Mufti's lack of support for her education.

episodesList.title: Mahid takes a bold stand
episodesList.summary: Fareed encourages Kausar to face life with confidence. Meanwhile, tensions between Mahid and Mufti escalate dramatically when Mahid challenges him to a public debate.

episodesList.title: Fareed comforts Kasaur
episodesList.summary: Fareed ensures Kausar feels comfortable and serves her a meal. Mahid and Seher agree to a mutual divorce, while Mahid stands up for Seher's education against Mufti.

episodesList.title: Kausar and Amaal finally reunite
episodesList.summary: Mahid and Seher prepare for the upcoming celebration and secretly gather supplies from Niyazi Manzil. Meanwhile, Fareed reveals to Amaal that Kausar is her real mother.

episodesList.title: Mahid and Seher's bonfire celebration
episodesList.summary: Mahid and Seher celebrate together by the bonfire as he realises how happy Seher makes him. Meanwhile, Husna secretly sets her deadly plan into motion to kill Mufti.

episodesList.title: Husna's deadly revenge
episodesList.summary: Seher reflects on her journey with Mahid as the two share heartfelt moments together, while Amaal publicly humiliates Parvez. However, Husna brutally kills Mufti.

episodesList.title: Kausar reassures Amaal
episodesList.summary: Kausar assures Amaal she won't let Parvez's shadow touch her. Seher confronts Mahid about the unexpected deposit of thirty lakhs into her bank account.

episodesList.title: Husna frames Kausar for murder
episodesList.summary: Husna plants evidence to frame Kausar and turns everyone against her. While Seher and Kausar happily settle into their new home, Husna fuels public anger against Kausar.

episodesList.title: Seher, Kausar run for their lives
episodesList.summary: Accused of Mufti's death, Seher and Kausar flee for their lives as an angry mob chases them. While Mahid performs Mufti's last rites, Husna sabotages his efforts to reach Seher.

episodesList.title: Mahid's promise to Seher
episodesList.summary: As Amaal chooses to stay with Kausar, Fareed stands by her decision. Elsewhere, Mahid hides Seher safely and assures her to bring Kausar back.

episodesList.title: Mahid's plea for forgiveness
episodesList.summary: Mahid explains to Seher that he did his best to rescue Kausar and apologises for his mistake. Sultana shares her past with Amaal and urges her to reconsider her decision.

episodesList.title: Husna plans Hyder's future
episodesList.summary: Husna celebrates the success of her plot and plans to make Hyder the Mufti. Elsewhere, late-night knocks on the door leave Seher and Amaal worried.

episodesList.title: Mahid faces the Nawab's decision
episodesList.summary: Mahid tries to comfort a devastated Seher, who is worried about Kausar. The Nawab informs Mahid that Hyder will take over the Mufti duties until Kausar's innocence is proven.

episodesList.title: Seher's bold stand for Kausar
episodesList.summary: Seher stands up to the crowd, vowing to seek revenge on the mob that attacked Kausar. The police arrest Parvez after Mahid exposes his actions against Kausar.

episodesList.title: Mahid against the Niyazi family
episodesList.summary: Mahid tells Seher that he has Parvez arrested to protect her and Amaal. Hyder informs Fareed that Mahid turned against their family after the Mufti's death.

episodesList.title: Mahid reassures Seher
episodesList.summary: Seher begs Mahid to find Kausar, desperate to see her again. Mahid assures Seher and urges her to attend her college interview, promising to bring Kausar back.

episodesList.title: Amaal and Tahir's bold move
episodesList.summary: Mahid urges Seher to pursue the interview, honouring Kausar's dream. Amaal and Tahir race to delay the interview, giving Seher a chance to secure her college admission.

episodesList.title: Husna warns Hyder
episodesList.summary: Husna warns Hyder not to underestimate Mahid. Meanwhile, Mahid secures Seher's safety by vacating nearby houses as Seher plans to track down Hussain.

episodesList.title: Mahid's hidden fears resurface
episodesList.summary: Mahid realises Kausar's cloth was purposely placed in the late Mufti's hands, raising his doubts. Soon, he opens up to Seher about his fear of failing to uphold the Niyazi family's legacy.

episodesList.title: Mahid's ascension as Mufti
episodesList.summary: The Nawab declares Mahid Niyazi as the next Mufti after Maulana Niyazi. Hyder confronts Husna for supporting the decision, igniting tension within the family.

episodesList.title: Mahid and Seher search for Kausar
episodesList.summary: As Husna forces Hussain to take the blame for Kausar's murder, Mahid and Seher confront him. Later Husna leads Mahid, Seher and the police to a jungle where Kausar's body is kept.

episodesList.title: Seher walks out of Mahid's life
episodesList.summary: Seher and Mahid find Kausar dead in the woods, leaving Seher devastated. She blames Mahid for failing to find Kausar and walks away as painful memories resurface.

plotHtml:
Sixteen-year-old Seher Baig has a secret. In Husainpur, far from her father's crushing orthodoxy and cruelty, she studies in secret under her mother Kauser's guidance, nurturing a dream her father would never allow: to become a doctor.
But when she's forced to move to Lucknow and live under his roof, that fragile dream begins to slip through her fingers. And then her father makes a decision that tightens the bars: her engagement to Mahid Niyazi, the grandson of the city's revered mufti and a man whose name alone commands fear and respect. Mahid is principled, they say. Fair. Conservative. But he is also rigid, sharp-tongued, and morally unbending with a temper that keeps even his family at arm's length.
The narrative follows Seher as she enters an arranged marriage and adjusts to life within her husband’s household. The story explores her experiences with family expectations, social pressures, and differing views regarding her personal ambitions and independence.
Against all of it, Seher holds on to her dream. But in a world that has already decided who she should be, how far can one girl go to become who she is meant to be?
tagline: Sixteen-year-old Seher Baig has a secret.

title: Search: The Naina Murder Case
summary:
Search: The Naina Murder Case is a 2025 Indian Hindi-language crime thriller web series streaming on JioHotstar. It is directed by Rohan Sippy and produced by Applause Entertainment and
Highgate Entertainment .
It stars Konkona Sen Sharma, Shraddha Das, Shiv Panditt and Surya Sharma and the was released on 10 October 2025.
It's based on the Danish TV Series The Killing.
reception:
Shubhra Gupta of The Indian Express gave 2.5 stars out of 5 and said that "Konkona Sen Sharma fronts classic conflict of a whodunit with domestic and professional pushes and pulls in play, even as murky details which shaped the crime begin emerging." Anurag Singh Bohra of India Today gave it 3 stars out of 5 and stated that "'Search: The Naina Murder Case' is a must-watch for cinephiles who like to study not just cinema, but also the versatility of actors like Konkona. It is also meant for those craving the human element and complex characters in crime-thrillers." Abhimanyu Mathur of Hindustan Times rated it 3/5 stars and said that "Konkona Sen Sharma's acting is one of the highlights of this gripping but uneven show."
Archika Khurana of The Times of India rated it 3/5 stars and observed that "A well-acted, atmospheric whodunit that grips in parts but leaves you wanting more." Nandini Ramnath of Scroll.in observed that "Search frustratingly turns off the tap just when the flow is the strongest, ending on a cliffhanger after six episodes. This ploy to keep viewers hooked interrupts the momentum that has been steadily building up. Fortunately, Search has enough reserve fuel to resume the journey." Rahul Desai of The Hollywood Reporter India commented that "The six-episode police procedural suffers from all the symptoms of the Indian Remake Syndrome."
Arkadev Ghoshal of Deccan Herald rated it 2/5 stars and siad that "The series is a lukewarm execution. It manages to deliver a balanced narrative, with the execution partly rising beyond the average police procedural." Divya Nair of Rediff.com gave 3.5 stars out of 5 and stated that "In just five tightly packed episodes, Search: The Naina Murder Case takes you through a whirlwind of theories, emotions and shocking revelations, making it a compelling Indian crime drama." Yatamanyu Narain of News 18 rated it 3/5 stars and said that "Search: The Naina Murder Case is gripping and intriguing in parts, enriched by strong performances and an intelligent premise, but it never quite achieves the narrative cohesion it strives for."
Lachmi Deb Roy of Firstpost gave 3.5 stars out of 5 and writes in her review that "Search: The Naina Murder Case is immersive and engaging. Most importantly even though it is a series with all its twists and turns, it is crisp." Aishwarya Vasudevan of OTT Play rated it 3/5 stars and said that "This Indian adaptation of Nordic noir The Killing is a mixed bag. Konkona Sen Sharma is brilliant as the lead detective, but the plot is overstuffed with suspects and remains frustratingly unresolved." Subhash K Jha of news 24 4 stars out of 5 and writes that "The narration is pacy but never out of breath.What really elevates the show are the performances.
__TOC__

title: Sampoorna
summary: Sampoorna is an Indian Hindi-language drama television series that aired from 8 September 2025 to 9 December 2025 on StarPlus. Produced by Shree Venkatesh Films, it stars Sandipta Sen, Aham Sharma and Vishal Aditya Singh, marking the Hindi television debut of Sen and return of Sharma to television after a hiatus of six years. It is the Hindi remake of the Bengali web series Noshtoneer starring Sen herself as the protagonist. As a planned finite series, the show completed its run on 9 December 2025 completing 85 episodes.
plot:
The series revolves around the life of a happily married businesswoman Mitti Kapoor Malhotra. Her husband Dr. Aakash Malhotra, whom she married going against her family is the top heart surgeon of Chandigarh. Aakash is a man of high morals, respects women and helped Mitti establish her boutique business. The couple lives a happy life with their son, Chirag. Soon Aakash helps Mitti reconcile with her family. However their happiness is short lived, when amidst the celebration of their seventh wedding anniversary, Aakash's former intern Naina Singh attempts suicide after accusing him of exploiting her for his sexual needs after having a brief extramarital affair and ghosting her after she got impregnated with his unwanted child and blacklisting her from job opportunities through the misuse of his position which leads to immediate arrest of Aakash.
However Mitti refuses to believe her and blames her of exploiting Aakash for money extortion while assuming that the Investigating Officer SI Satyendra Prasad Lohar, who also happens to be her former college friend and one-sided lover is intentionally torturing Aakash as a punishment for not getting her. Mitti's in-laws start detesting her for her breaking familiar rules and unusual ways to get Aakash bailed out while Naina demands for a DNA test in court to prove herself. However due to Aakash's junior Prithvi's goons harassing her family, Naina takes the complaint back claiming she did everything for money extortion and moves back to her hometown thus clearing Aakash of all charges.
While Naina slips into coma due to harassment by Prithvi's goons, Mitti starts noticing strange behavioral changes in Aakash and starts suspecting him and comes across Naina's cousin Simran who reveals how Aakash indeed used Naina by lying about his unhappy marriage and starting an affair in the pretext of divorce proceedings, false promise of marriage, a secret engagement and then leaving her after getting her impregnated. Simran also reveals that Aakash and Prithvi bribed her greedy father with a large sum of money to keep Naina away. Soon it is revealed that Prithvi, who happens to be the son of a local politician, works on Aakash's commands to keep his forged MBBS degree hidden.
Shattered Mitti decides to expose and divorce Aakash and get Naina justice but she is also revealed to be pregnant with another child of Aakash and decides to hold back until collecting proves against him. While collecting the proves she rekindles her old friendship with Satyendra. Soon Suhana, a nurse and another former victim of being used by Aakash for his sexual needs comes to the picture and exposes Aakash in front of his family and colleagues. An enraged Aakash locks Mitti and Chirag but his mother helps them escape. However he kidnaps Chirag which leads to Chirag's resentment towards him after the rescue.
Soon he tries to kill Naina twice but his plans fail after Naina is first shifted to Satyendra's home and then Suhana's home for her safety. When Naina goes into a pre-mature labour he decides to kill Naina and Mitti for once and all but his scheme gets overheard by his brother Rohit. Naina succumbs to her injuries but not before delivering her daughter who gets adopted by Mitti who survives but miscarries. Mitti names the baby Sampoorna and decides to hide about her existence which is known only to her, Suhana and Satyendra until the investigation against Aakash reopens.
When the investigation reopens, Prithvi burdened by guilt, confesses to his crimes in court and exposes Aakash while Rohit too exposes him and court orders the DNA test of Sampoorna and Aakash on Mitti's insistence. Aakash's paternity gets proven and he gets lifetime imprisonment thus prevailing Naina her justice. In the final chapter Mitti decides to raise her both children Chirag and Sampoorna as a proud mother and make them strong enough to fight for right and live their lives with dignity.

title: Saare Jahan Se Accha
wikiTitle: Saare Jahan Se Accha (2025 TV series)
summary: Saare Jahan Se Accha is an Indian Hindi-language action thriller spy television series created by Gaurav Shukla. The series was developed by Netflix and released on 13 August 2025. A resilient Indian spy must defeat his counterpart across the border in Pakistan, in a battle of wits and tradecraft to sabotage its nuclear program.
plot:
In 1960s, after India has endured two conflicts within a space of five years, renowned Indian nuclear physicist, Dr. Homi J. Bhabha, makes a public statement advocating India to become a nuclear power. This draws the attention of the CIA, which begins covert operations to sabotage India's nuclear program.
A junior operative in Indian Intelligence Bureau, Vishnu Shankar uncovers the classified details about Bhabha's travel plans having been leaked to American agents, he races to thwart an impending assassination plot. Despite his efforts, Bhabha dies when his flight to Geneva explodes in 1966, effectively stalling India's nuclear program. This event leads to creation of Research & Analysis Wing, India's specialised espionage organisation in enemy territories, headed by R. N. Kao.
In 1972, in the aftermath of the Shimla Agreement, Pakistan's Prime Minister Zulfikar Ali Bhutto decides to scale up his country's nuclear program. Kao gets this intelligence from his counterpart in Mossad, and sends his intelligence officer, Vishnu Shankar to Islamabad on a covert mission to sabotage Pakistan's nuclear program. Once in Islamabad, Vishnu gets to work in finding out where Pakistan is building its nuclear facilities.
Meanwhile, Murtaza Malik, head of ISI, has taken on the task of cleaning out foreign secret operatives in Pakistan. He is brother-in-law and colleague of brigadier Naushad Ahmed, a high ranking official in the Pakistani Army. Naushad is an informant to R&AW under duress, and supplies the crucial information to Vishnu Shankar that Pakistan is buying nuclear reactors instead of creating them from scratch as previously assumed. Soon after, Naushad is caught and killed by Murtaza.
Naushad's intel changes the focus of Vishnu's mission to tracking down who Pakistan is buying the reactors from. Through his covert operatives, Sukhbir (operating under the false identity of Karachi Stock Trader, Rafiq) and Vikram operating in Paris, he figures out that Pakistan is making secret payments to a French company, HGN, to secure these reactors. Vikram, collaborates with his Mossad counterpart, Maria, and two other R&AW agents in Paris to track and murder the ISI agent in charge overseeing these payments.
In Islamabad, Vishnu seeks to fill the void left by Naushad's death. He recruits Fatima Khan, the Editor of Haqeeqat newspaper who is critical of the ongoing regime and is the niece of Munir Khan, the nuclear physicist leading Pakistan's nuclear mission. With Fatima's intel, Vishnu obtains the time and location of the incoming shipment from France that contains disassembled nuclear reactor, and blows up the ship, losing four Indian agents and several Pakistani soldiers in the process.
The end credits chronicle that India tested its first nuclear weapon shortly afterwards, in 1974, and Pakistan in 1998 - 24 years later.
reception:
Deepa Gahlot of Rediff.com gave 3.5 stars and observed that "The always dependable Pratik Gandhi finds a match in Sunny Hinduja and they are surrounded by a top notch supporting cast." Shubhra Gupta of The Indian Express gave 2.5 stars out of 5 and said that "The best thing about the handsomely-mounted show is that it steers clear of vicious jingoism while waving the flag. You wish it didn’t peter off towards the end." Lachmi Deb Roy of Firstpost rated 3.5/5 stars and said that "The show may be wanting in many departments, but it mostly gets everything right and that’s what makes it a must-watch."
Anuj Kumar of The Hindu observed that "Despite strong performances and a powerful premise, the six-episode espionage drama ‘Saare Jahan Se Accha’ feels like a mission that has been compromised." Rashmi Vasudeva of Deccan Herald rated it 3/5 stars and said that "It has got quite the perfectly-timed release. Although far from perfect, it is atmospheric in parts and largely engaging." Sana Farzeen of India Today gave 3.5 stars outof 5 and said that "In the end, 'Saare Jahan Se Accha' works because it's not the story of any James Bond but regular-looking, Indian family men, who believe serving their country is their only duty. It also understands that espionage is not just about pointing guns or indulging in mindless killings."
Rahul Desai of The Hollywood Reporter India commeneted that "The six-episode spy thriller is compromised by its own mixed identity". Shreyanka Mazumdar of News 18 rated 3.5/5 stars and said that "A sharp, edge-of-the-seat political thriller driven by powerhouse performances. You will want to watch it in one go." Aishwarya Vasudevan of OTT Play rated 2.5/5 stars and said that "Saare Jahan Se Accha boasts strong performances by Pratik Gandhi and Sunny Hinduja, but safe execution, predictable plot, & lack of real thrills keep this espionage drama from reaching its potential."
Dhaval Roy of The Times of India gave 3.5 stars out of 5 and commented that "The spy drama is a must-watch for its pulse-pounding tension, taut narrative, and stellar performances that leave a lasting impression." Subhash K Jha of News 24 gave rated it 2/5 stars and said that "Everyone tries to look involved and busy. But the lame execution of the plot fells any lofty aspirations. The lack of funds is visible everywhere: Islamabad looks like Chandni Chowk on a dry day." Nandini Ramnath of Scroll.in observed that "Saare Jahan Se Accha goes into fantasy mode at times to assert RAW’s Mossad-like prowess. The factor of doubt over the human cost of espionage survives the imperative to show Pakistan on the back foot yet again."

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text:
The series features several true events in its storyline during the nuclear tensions between Indian and Pakistan in 1960s and 1970s, including:
Dr. Homi J. Bhabha's claims to build India's nuclear weapons within 18 months and his death in a plane crash in 1966, and the allegations of assassination. * Creation of R&AW in 1968. * The Shimla Agreement in 1972. * Zulfikar Ali Bhutto's establishment of Project 706, which brought over several Pakistani nuclear physicists living abroad including Munir Ahmad Khan.

title: Single Pasanga
summary:
Single Pasanga is a 2025 Indian Tamil-language relationship entertainment reality television series that premiered on Zee Tamil on 10 August 2025. The show features a group of single men from diverse professional backgrounds trying to find the perfect partner for them. It is hosted by Manimegalai. The show was judged by R. Parthiban, Shrutika Arjun and Alya Manasa. R. Parthiban judge the first 3 episodes, while T. Rajendar judge from after episode 4. 
This show was ended at 21 December 2025 with 19 Episodes. The Title Winner is Thangapandian while Raavanan as the runner up of the show.

title: Salakaar
summary: Salakaar is an Indian Hindi-language action espionage thriller series created and directed by Faruk Kabir starring Naveen Kasturia, Mouni Roy, Mukesh Rishi, Purnendu Bhattacharya, Ashwath Bhatt, and Surya Sharma. It was released as JioHotstar-original on 8 August 2025.

articleSections.title: Review
articleSections.text: Writing review for India Today, Shweta Keshri raised the concern of logic in the script, and wrote "For instance, a dramatic explosion at the nuclear plant leaves Dayal with just a few scratches. Security in a high-alert zone like Kahuta seems inconsistent. Dayal faced a lot of scrutiny while entering the territory, but how did he return and then come back again?" Shubhra Gupta for The Indian Express stated the series is a cringe. Reviewing for The Free Press Journal, critic Troy Ribeiro wrote, "While the series flirts with rewriting history (or veers into patriotic fan fiction), Salakaar leaves you wondering—does it stir pride or resurface old wounds? Either way, it’s audacious—and in the world of espionage, audacity counts." Nandini Ramnath of Scroll.in wrote "Salakaar claims to be inspired by actual events. But the show is too dumbed-down, amateurish and contrived to be credible. The five-episode series doesn’t give any real sense of how espionage is conducted or how officials and leaders in both countries behave." Rahul Desai for The Hollywood Reporter India stated "sounds like a great show - a long-form Raazi perfaps." Vinamra Mathur of Firstpost praised performance of Mouni Roy and Mukesh Rishi. Nonika Singh for The Tribune wrote "Much of the India-Pakistan action does not rouse patriotic sentiments, nor is it adrenaline pumping." Chirag Sehgal for News18 stated "The show’s dialogues are another major letdown, often feeling forced and unnatural."

writtenBy: Faruk Kabir, Spandan Mishra, Srinivas Abrol,Swati Tripathi

episodesList.summary: Trapped in Ashfaq's mansion, Mariam must follow the NSA's dangerous extraction plan. In 1978, Jyoti falls victim to an attack, and Adhir finds an ally to stop Zia's nuclear plans.

episodesList.title: Turup ka Ikka
episodesList.summary: In 1978, Adhir enters Zia's highly secure nuclear plant to ruin the test. In 2025, following the NSA's instructions, Mariam tries to escape Ashfaq's clutches at the airport.

title: Sivarapalli
summary:
Sivarapalli is an Indian Telugu-language comedy drama television series and an official remake of the Hindi-language series Panchayat. The series is written by Shanmukha Prashanth and directed by Bhaskhar Maurya for Amazon Prime Video. It featured Rag Mayur, Muralidhar Goud, Rupa Lakshmi, Uday Gurrala, Sunny Palle in primary roles. 
Produced by Arunabh Kumar under the banner of TVF, the show revolves around Shyam, a young engineering graduate from Hyderabad who reluctantly accepts a job as the Panchayat Secretary in the remote village of Sivarapalli, Telangana. It premiered on 24 January 2025 on Amazon Prime Video and consists of eight episodes.
reception:
Calling it an "polished execution", Srivathsan Nadadhur of The Hindu opined that the series had "strong cast", and appreciated cinematography and score. Sasidhar Adivi of Times Now gave a rating of 3 out of 5 and stated, "For those who have watched Panchayat Season 1, Sivarapalli might come across as slightly underwhelming in comparison. However, if one overlooks the slow pace, this village drama offers some delightful moments worth cherishing". Anisha Rao of India Today gave a rating of 2.5 out of 5 and stated "The performances in Sivarapalli are what makes the show watchable, with Rag Mayur portraying Shyam's frustration and eventual acceptance of his situation." Tanya Garg from Jagaran said "Sivarapalli tells original, humorous tales set in rural India. The series transports you to a busy Telangana village where the intricacies of rural life are unfolded."
Avad Mohammad of OTTplay gave a rating of 3.5 out of 5 and said "The Rag Mayur series is earthy, entertaining and honest."

title: Soul Stories
summary: Soul Stories is a 2024 Malayalam-language anthology drama web series with five episodes where each story focus on a socially relevant subject that affects the life of women like sexuality, class difference, gender discrimination and consent. It is directed by Sanil Kalathil.
plot: The anthology series is divided into five short stories, each exploring the female psyche and body.
reception:
"Soul Stories" garnered a generally positive reception upon its release on manoramaMAX, with critics and audiences praising its focus on diverse female experiences and its thought-provoking narratives.
Critical Response:
* Themes and Storytelling: The web series was lauded for its exploration of socially relevant subjects impacting women, such as sexuality, class differences, gender discrimination, and consent. Reviewers noted how the anthology format allowed for a sensitive and sensible, though not always smooth, portrayal of the female psyche and body. For instance, a review by Onmanorama highlighted the series' attempt to provide a "short guide to understanding women." * Direction: Sanil Kalathil's direction was commended for its honest approach to depicting the travails of women and for staying true to the core idea of the series. As noted by OTTPlay, Kalathil "stays honest to the core idea as it portrays the travails of women." and Onmanorama. "Neeril Veezhum Pookkal" was noted for its bold exploration of a same-sex relationship, with Onmanorama acknowledging its "daring" nature.

title: Shekhar Home
summary: Shekhar Home is an Indian Hindi-language crime drama television series created by Aniruddha Guha and Srijit Mukherji and directed by Rohan Sippy and Mukherji.  An adaptation of Arthur Conan Doyle’s canon of Sherlock Holmes stories, the series is produced by BBC Studios Productions, and stars Kay Kay Menon, Ranvir Shorey, Rasika Dugal, Kirti Kulhari and Dibyendu Bhattacharya. The dialogues of the show are written by Vaibhav Vishal. The series premiered on JioCinema on 14 August 2024.
reception:
The Times of India critic gave the series 3.5 stars, saying, “ ‘Shekhar Home,’ created by Aniruddha Guha and Sriijit Mukherji, and directed by Mukherji and Rohan Sippy, is a compelling series inspired by Arthur Conan Doyle's ‘Sherlock Holmes’. The creators have excelled in crafting a world that captivates from the very first frame.”
In another 3.5 star-rated review, the India Today critic Trisha Bhattacharya said, “The screenplay is tight, with well-researched cases and dialogues that stay true to the spirit of Doyle's stories. The Bengali representation is top-notch.”
In her review for Scroll, critic Nandini Ramnath said, “Breezy and irreverent, Shekhar Home's attitude is best captured by its high-performing hero's high-pitched giggle whenever a breakthrough occurs. Menon's detective is brilliant without being overbearing, a genial class topper rather than an insufferable genius.”
The Livemint review called Shekhar Home a deft Conan Doyle adaptation. “The adaptation of Doyle's stories (originally written in the late 1800s) by Srijit Mukherji and Aniruddha Guha skillfully integrates classic detective elements into an Indian context.”
The Free Press Journal rated the series 3.5 stars, and said: “This is a well-crafted series that offers a nostalgic ride through the labyrinthine mysteries of 1990s.”
Shubhra Gupta of The Indian Express gave the series 2/5 stars. Deepa Gahlot of Rediff.com rated the series 3/5 stars.

title: Sadhi Manasa
summary: Sadhi Manasa (transl. Innocent People) is an Indian Marathi language television series that airs on Star Pravah. It stars Akash Nalawade and Shivani Baokar in lead roles. It is produced under the banner of Frames Production. It premiered from 18 March 2024 by replacing Kunya Rajachi Ga Tu Rani. It is an official remake of Tamil TV series Siragadikka Aasai.
plot:
Meera, a woman deeply devoted to her family, and Satya, a rebellious young man burdened by a troubled past, live in worlds that couldn't be more different. Meera spends her days tirelessly selling flowers at the temple alongside her family, while Satya numbs his pain with alcohol and violence, frequently clashing with his disapproving mother. Despite their contrasting lives, their paths keep crossing, and each encounter only deepens their mutual dislike.
When Meera's family faces financial hardship and is struck by tragedy as her brother, entangled with the wrong crowd, takes his own life, the situation becomes dire. Guilt-ridden, Satya's father, a retired train conductor, suggests a marriage alliance between Meera and Satya, hoping it might bring stability to their lives. However, on the day of the wedding, chaos ensues when Meera's greedy brother vanishes with the family's savings, leaving Meera with no choice but to marry Satya.

title: Showtime
summary: Showtime is an Indian Hindi-language drama television series created by Sumit Roy. It delves into the world of Bollywood, production houses and how they function. It features the power struggles and off-camera fights occurring in the backstage areas of Bollywood. Produced by Dharmatic Entertainment the show premiered on 8 March 2024 on Disney+ Hotstar.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: The first teaser featuring all the star cast was released on 20 December 2023. Further, on 9 February 2024, the release date was announced to be 8 March. On 13 February 2024, the trailer featuring star cast was launched.

articleSections.title: Broadcast
articleSections.text: The first four episodes were released on 8 March 2024. Next three episodes were released on 12 July 2024.

articleSections.title: Critical reception
articleSections.text:
Showtime received mixed reviews from critics, who praised its production design, dialogues and performances, but were polarised about its writing. Saibal Chatterjee of NDTV gave the series a 2.5 rating stating, "The principal quintet of actors in Showtime is a diverse lot who bring different performative styles to bear upon the characters that they play." Devansh Sharma of Hindustan Times says, "Showtime also works as a spot-the-reference spectator sport because of how zeitgeisty it is. Dialogue writers Jehan Handa and Karan Sharma oscillate from bombarding the audience with the obvious to allowing them to read between the lines."
Sukanya Verma of Rediff.com rates the show 2.5 and states, "But with only four episodes out and a loose sense of a conflict, it's hard to form a definite opinion about a show that is always watchable but never engrossing." While Nandini Ramnath of Scroll.in states, "There isn’t enough hard work, at least from the available episodes, to understand just yet whether Showtime is the expose we have been waiting for or yet another half-hearted effort to lure us in by promising dirt. The series fares well when it aims for low-hanging fruit, such as the silly things that Bollywood people do because they can’t see beyond their noses."
Rahul Desai of Film Companion in the Part 1 review says, "Somewhere along the way, intent morphs into blind-item content - content that makes it hard to tell a publicity spot from actual series." Shubhra Gupta from The Indian Express rated the show 2 stars, and stated, "Karan Johar’s by-the-number series on Bollywood’s inner workings lacks bite." Snigdha Nalini from Outlook India rates the show 2.5 stars and says, "There are no revelations, nothing too dramatic."

articleSections.title: Viewership
articleSections.text: Showtime appeared twice in the top 5 most-viewed list shows of the week clocking 5.7 million views and 4.4 million views, respectively.

title: Shaitani Rasmein
summary: Shaitani Rasmein is an Indian Hindi-language romantic horror fantasy series that premiered on 15 January 2024 on Star Bharat. It is digitally available on Disney+ Hotstar. The first season starred Naqiyah Haji and Vibhav Roy as leads. Sumit Singh and Reyaansh Vir Chdha played the lead roles in the second season.
plot:
Nikki, an orphan from Goa, marries Piyush and is taken to Bhurangarh, where his royal family secretly worships the demon Malik. She is forced to perform the Shaitani Rasmein—dark rituals meant to restore Malik’s power—under deception and pressure. As deaths and supernatural events unfold, Nikki learns that Piyush’s ancestor made a blood pact with Malik, binding generations of daughters-in-law to serve him. Despite resisting, Nikki continues the rituals to protect the family, unknowingly strengthening Malik while slowly discovering her own hidden divine connection.
Kapalika, Malik’s devoted but jealous follower, drives much of the early conflict. She ensures Nikki completes the rituals, orchestrates sacrifices, and eliminates anyone who threatens Malik. However, when Malik declares Nikki as the “Chosen One,” Kapalika’s jealousy intensifies. She later discovers that Nikki is the reincarnation of Swarnaprabha, a divine being destined to destroy Malik. Her growing obsession and independent actions lead to her downfall, as Malik turns her into stone. Through Kapalika’s arc, the truth about Nikki’s identity and her divine purpose begins to surface.
As Nikki embraces her destiny, the story reveals the past of Swarnaprabha and Akaal Shatru—Malik’s original human form. In ancient times, Akaal Shatru sought immortality and targeted Swarnaprabha, a powerful divine entity. To stop him, Nikki travels back in time and witnesses their story, even influencing events by bringing Swarnaprabha and Piyush’s past incarnation, Kadam, together. Despite her efforts, Akaal Shatru nearly succeeds in becoming immortal, leading to his transformation into Malik. Nikki ultimately intervenes in the past and disrupts this process, but the battle results in her own death. Around this phase, she also faces Chhaya, Malik’s dangerous sister, and defeats her through strategy. Netra, Kapalika’s sister, is introduced as a rising dark force who will later continue the legacy of evil.
Before the final war, Nikki gathers divine artifacts and unlocks her true identity. Through the Arth Swarn Pustika and deep meditation, she fully transforms into Swarnaprabha, regaining her complete divine powers. Alongside Piyush, who becomes the Naagdevta Takshak, she prepares for a final battle against Malik. However, the battle ends tragically—Piyush sacrifices himself to save Nikki, and in a moment of immense rage and divine awakening, Nikki unleashes her full power and destroys Malik. Though victorious, she later dies, and her powers are preserved by Baaldevi for the future.
Twenty-one years later, their daughter Pinni grows up away from Bhurangarh, unaware of her past, until Malik reincarnates as Veer. Through manipulation by Netra, Pinni is married to Veer as part of a plan to complete Malik’s rebirth. She is forced to perform dark rituals just like Nikki, but soon uncovers the truth about her parents, her lineage, and her destiny as a Shatbeeja. With guidance from Baaldevi and her grandparents, Pinni learns that Nikki had hidden Swarnaprabha’s divine powers inside a sacred prism located within a mystical dimension called Brahmantar. As Malik regains strength and eliminates his enemies, Pinni embarks on a dangerous journey involving ancient libraries, riddles, supernatural realms, and deadly entities to locate Brahmantar before Malik can claim the powers for himself.
In the climax, Pinni discovers that Brahmantar is hidden within the palace itself, activated at the site where Nikki once placed a divine idol. As Malik confronts her and tries to stop her, Pinni enters Brahmantar and absorbs Swarnaprabha’s divine energy, fully awakening her true form. With her powers restored, she fights Malik in a final battle and destroys him permanently, ending generations of terror and breaking the curse on the Gehlot family. With Malik gone, Nikki and Swarnaprabha’s souls attain peace, and Pinni accepts her role as their successor. She steps forward not just as a survivor, but as a protector, eventually entering Brahmantar to eliminate remaining evil forces and restore balance to the world.

plotHtml:
Nikki, an orphan from Goa, marries Piyush and is taken to Bhurangarh, where his royal family secretly worships the demon Malik. She is forced to perform the Shaitani Rasmein—dark rituals meant to restore Malik’s power—under deception and pressure. As deaths and supernatural events unfold, Nikki learns that Piyush’s ancestor made a blood pact with Malik, binding generations of daughters-in-law to serve him. Despite resisting, Nikki continues the rituals to protect the family, unknowingly strengthening Malik while slowly discovering her own hidden divine connection.
Kapalika, Malik’s devoted but jealous follower, drives much of the early conflict. She ensures Nikki completes the rituals, orchestrates sacrifices, and eliminates anyone who threatens Malik. However, when Malik declares Nikki as the “Chosen One,” Kapalika’s jealousy intensifies. She later discovers that Nikki is the reincarnation of Swarnaprabha, a divine being destined to destroy Malik. Her growing obsession and independent actions lead to her downfall, as Malik turns her into stone. Through Kapalika’s arc, the truth about Nikki’s identity and her divine purpose begins to surface.
As Nikki embraces her destiny, the story reveals the past of Swarnaprabha and Akaal Shatru—Malik’s original human form. In ancient times, Akaal Shatru sought immortality and targeted Swarnaprabha, a powerful divine entity. To stop him, Nikki travels back in time and witnesses their story, even influencing events by bringing Swarnaprabha and Piyush’s past incarnation, Kadam, together. Despite her efforts, Akaal Shatru nearly succeeds in becoming immortal, leading to his transformation into Malik. Nikki ultimately intervenes in the past and disrupts this process, but the battle results in her own death. Around this phase, she also faces Chhaya, Malik’s dangerous sister, and defeats her through strategy. Netra, Kapalika’s sister, is introduced as a rising dark force who will later continue the legacy of evil.
Before the final war, Nikki gathers divine artifacts and unlocks her true identity. Through the Arth Swarn Pustika and deep meditation, she fully transforms into Swarnaprabha, regaining her complete divine powers. Alongside Piyush, who becomes the Naagdevta Takshak, she prepares for a final battle against Malik. However, the battle ends tragically—Piyush sacrifices himself to save Nikki, and in a moment of immense rage and divine awakening, Nikki unleashes her full power and destroys Malik. Though victorious, she later dies, and her powers are preserved by Baaldevi for the future.
Twenty-one years later, their daughter Pinni grows up away from Bhurangarh, unaware of her past, until Malik reincarnates as Veer. Through manipulation by Netra, Pinni is married to Veer as part of a plan to complete Malik’s rebirth. She is forced to perform dark rituals just like Nikki, but soon uncovers the truth about her parents, her lineage, and her destiny as a Shatbeeja. With guidance from Baaldevi and her grandparents, Pinni learns that Nikki had hidden Swarnaprabha’s divine powers inside a sacred prism located within a mystical dimension called Brahmantar. As Malik regains strength and eliminates his enemies, Pinni embarks on a dangerous journey involving ancient libraries, riddles, supernatural realms, and deadly entities to locate Brahmantar before Malik can claim the powers for himself.
In the climax, Pinni discovers that Brahmantar is hidden within the palace itself, activated at the site where Nikki once placed a divine idol. As Malik confronts her and tries to stop her, Pinni enters Brahmantar and absorbs Swarnaprabha’s divine energy, fully awakening her true form. With her powers restored, she fights Malik in a final battle and destroys him permanently, ending generations of terror and breaking the curse on the Gehlot family. With Malik gone, Nikki and Swarnaprabha’s souls attain peace, and Pinni accepts her role as their successor. She steps forward not just as a survivor, but as a protector, eventually entering Brahmantar to eliminate remaining evil forces and restore balance to the world.
tagline: Nikki, an orphan from Goa, marries Piyush and is taken to Bhurangarh, where his royal family secretly worships the demon Malik.

title: Shrimad Ramayan
summary: Shrimad Ramayan (transl. Holy Ramayana) is an Indian Hindi-language  television series that premiered from 1 January 2024 to 9 August 2024 on Sony TV and from 12 August 2024 to 10 March 2025 on Sony SAB. Produced by Siddharth Kumar Tewary under the banner of Swastik Productions, the series is based on the epic Ramayana. It starred Sujay Reu as Rama and Prachi Bansal as Sita.
plot: The series showcases the life of Rama, the 7th incarnation of Lord Vishnu. It shows how he dealt with hardships in his life and how his life became an inspiration. It also showcases the ordeal and journey he went through to free his beloved wife, Sita (Incarnation of Goddess Lakshmi), from the rakshasa king Ravana, who abducted her. Lord Ram is born to King Dasharatha and Kaushalya while Bharat (incarnation of Vishnu's Shankha) is born to Kaikeyi and Lakshman (Sheshanaga) and Shatrughan (Sudarshan Chakra) are born to Sumitra. King Janak and Queen Sunayana get Sita from the Land. She grows up with her sister Urmila (Nagalakshmi) and cousins Mandavi (Lakshmi's Shankha) and Shrutkirti (Lakshmi's Chakra) and Sita lifts Lord Mahadev's Bow pinaka. After growing up Ram and Lakshman defeat Tataka and her sons with the guidance of Sage Vishwamitra and reaches Mithila. Ram - Sita, Bharat - Mandavi, Lakshman - Urmila and Shatrughan - Shrutkirti get married. Manthara, along with Kaikeyi sends them to exile. The rest of the story is about the difficulties and hardships they faced during and after the exile and how Lord Ram defeated Ravan without leaving Dharma(righteousness).The show then focuses on Lav and Kush, The sons of Lord Ram And Goddess Sita and their Reunion. Goddess Sita spends 12 years into the forest nurturing Lav and Kush as Sita is sent once again on exile when a launder questions Sita's purity. She lives in Lord Valmiki's Aashram. Lav and Kush eventually engage in war with Lord Ram without knowing Goddess Sita is their mother and Lord Ram is their father, this leads to the family's reunion but Sita's purity is once again in question so Sita returns to mother earth. As the time of Lord Ram's departure from mortal world nears, lakshman takes jal samadhi and returns to Sheshnaag form. Lord Ram later crowns Lav as King of North Ayodhya with Lavpuri as his capital kingdom and Kush is crowned as King of South Ayodhya with Kushavati as his capital kingdom. The sons of Bharat, Lakshman and Shatrughan are also given their respective kingdom's to rule. Bharat's son elder Pushkala ruled over Pushkalavati and younger son Taksha ruled over Takshila. Lakshman' s elder son Angad was given kingdom of Karupada and younger son Chandraketu ruled over a Kingdom named Chandrakanta. Shatrughna's elder son Subahu ruled over Madhupur and younger son, Shatrughati was crowned as King of Vidisha. At last Ram, Bharat and Shatrughna take jal samadhi while Hanuman and Vibhishan are asked to stay in mortal world until Lord Vishnu takes their final avatar in Kal Yug and help him in re-establish dharma in Kal Yug.
reception: Gayatri Nirmal from Pinkvilla stated, "The surprisingly fresh and convincing cast works. The rich storytelling and the VFX (visual effects) literally added life to the characters, and the dialogues, drawn from the original scripture of Valmiki, are both powerful and thought-provoking."

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text:
Siddharth Kumar Tewary announced Shrimad Ramayan, that is produced under his banner Swastik Productions in August 2023. It is an adaptation of the epic Ramayana, and is based on Valmiki's Ramayana and Tulsidas's Ramcharitmanas. In December 2023, Tewary stated that criticism to film Adipurush, was one of the reason to make the show. He added,
The team of Shrimad Ramayan also visited Ayodhya, before the launch of the series.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Sujay Reu and Prachi Bansal were cast as Rama and Sita respectively. The series marks Reu's third and Bansal's second project with the production house. Basant Bhatt and Vaidehi Nair were cast as Lakshmana and Urmila. Nirbhay Wadhwa was cast as Hanuman, in his fourth on-screen portrayal of the character.
In October 2023, Nikitin Dheer joined the cast as Ravana, marking his television comeback after 5 year. Aarav Chowdhary was cast as Dashratha. Nikhilesh Rathore was then cast as Bharata and Samarthya Gupta was cast as Shatrughna. Later, Anandi Tripathi was cast as Kaushalya, Bhawna Aneja as Sumitra and Shilpa Saklani as Kaikeyi. Neetu Pandey was cast as Kaikasi.
In January 2024, Gurpreet Bedi was cast to play Mandodari and Garima Jain was cast to play Ahalya. Sangeeta Odwani was cast to play Shurpanakha and Arjun Kumar was cast to play Vidyutjiva. Later, in February 2024, Rushiraj Pawar was cast to play Meghanada. In March 2024, Malhar Pandya was cast in the dual role of brothers Sugriva and Vali. In September 2024, Atharv J Jhony and Shourya Mandoriya were cast as Kusha and Lava respectively.

articleSections.title: Design
articleSections.text: The series set covering 10 acres of land in Umargam, Valsad, Gujarat, is designed by art director Omung Kumar. Costume designer of the series is Shibapriya Sen. articleSections.title: Filming
articleSections.text: Shrimad Ramayan is mainly shot in Umargam in Gujarat and has a high production and VFX value.

articleSections.title: Dubbed versions
articleSections.text: Since May 2024, Shrimad Ramayan has been dubbed in other languages such as in Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam and Bangla. It is broadcast on Sun TV Network's group of channels in the respective languages. The show is also dubbed in Bengali language and is broadcast on Sony Aath since October 2024.

articleSections.title: Reception
articleSections.text: Gayatri Nirmal from Pinkvilla stated, "The surprisingly fresh and convincing cast works. episodesList.title: Shri Ram Ki Katha
episodesList.summary: Dasharatha prays to the gods to bless him with a son and an heir. His friend, Jatayu, asks for his help to fight a war and save the Devatas. Will he agree to help him?

episodesList.title: Tapasya Ka Vardaan
episodesList.summary: Dasharatha accidentally kills Shravan Kumar during a hunting expedition and gets cursed by his parents. Meanwhile, Ravan prays to Lord Brahma and asks to grant him immortality so that he can defeat Kuber and take over Lanka.

episodesList.title: Putrakameshti Yagya
episodesList.summary: King Dasharatha performs a Yagya in the hope of being blessed with a son. Meanwhile, Ravan challenges Lord Shiva and is punished for his arrogance.
