plotHtml: ; In the fictional town of Sambaloor but actually set up in Poombarai, Dindigul district, Tamil Nadu, lives a community that worships Goddess Angalamman. The community celebrates the Mayana Kollai festival over 10 days every year, and it is in these 10 days that this story unfolds. What starts out as parallel stories of kidnapping and arson of Nandhini (starring Aishwarya Rajesh) and her sister, Fire Accident taking place at The Cement Factory, The Sub Inspector Chakravarthy (alias) Sakkarai (starring Kathir) sets out to unveil the suspense and knots tied to both the incidents, later unfolds into childhood trauma and conspiracy. ; Chakravarthy, being disturbed by the incidents and guilty feeling of inability of him to find Justice to Nandhini, seeks the help of Chellappa, his well wisher. Chellappa, the distinguished lawyer and senior Social activist and a public prosecutor renowned for his unwavering support in advocating for Nandini's defense, is tragically discovered dead under mysterious circumstances, Sakkarai is urgently summoned to offer his assistance to the grieving family during their time of shock and loss. As the investigation unfolds, it is set against the vibrant and festive backdrop of the grand Ashtakaali Festival, held annually in the charming town of Kaalipattanam. With each passing day, the inquiry delves deeper into the past, gradually revealing long-buried secrets and unresolved tensions that threaten to resurface, casting an ominous and unsettling shadow over the present and complicating the pursuit of justice.
tagline: The Vortex

title: Salt City
summary: Salt City is an Indian Hindi-language family-drama web television series which was premiered on SonyLIV, on 16 June 2022. It is produced by Applause Entertainment & Sunshine Productions and directed by Rishabh Anupam Sahay.
plot: Salt City traces the journey of the Bajpai family, through the pressures that life in a big city puts on their relationships. The story revolves around 5 siblings & how their lives cross each others, exposing their past and unfolding their future. Their journeys make them realise their bitter realities, motivating them to confront it without fear and get closer to themselves.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: Web television series which was premiered on SonyLIV, on 16 June 2022.

episodesList.title: Subah Ka Bhoola
episodesList.summary: Saurabh has towed his eldest brother Aman's Mercedes unknowingly. Aman is a bit startled to learn about Ela's marriage from Gunjan. As the Bajpai family gears up for the occasion, Harish returns home to his wife Triveni, who is oblivious of his extramarital relationship with Vibha. Believing in the bond shared by Harish and Triveni, Nikhil decides to throw an anniversary party for them. While Gunjan flirts with Nikhil at the party, Aman gets a kick after Sukesh, his brother-in-law appreciates his business pitch.

episodesList.title: Angeethi Ki Chingari
episodesList.summary: Harish reflects on how the humidity in the city rusts everything. Nikhil's home is raided by his landlords where he clandestinely stays with his girlfriend. Gunjan secretly practises pole dancing and continues her moves towards Nikhil to lure him. On the other hand, Esha, Harish's daughter feels a deep disconnect with her husband Sukesh. Harish gets a call from the police station regarding Saurabh.

episodesList.title: Zip It Up
episodesList.summary: Harish feels embarrassed at the police station to know about Saurabh's involvement in drugs. Harish speaks with Rohit to help Saurabh find a job. Saurabh gets the job and is sent on an assignment. Gunjan invites Nikhil to her dance studio but things go out of hand when a moral policing tirade creates a ruckus. Fortunately, Saurabh comes to rescue his kin after leaving his field assignment. As a result, he is fired from the job.

episodesList.title: Shaadi Wala Ghar
episodesList.summary: Harish lashes out at Saurabh when he gets to know that he has been laid off by the company. Sukesh, Esha, Aman and Gunjan come to the Bajpai house for Ela's wedding. Aman seems to butter up Sukesh for investing in his project. Nikhil on the other hand begs Sukesh for money as he is in severe debt. An argument breaks out between Aman and Harish again as he forgets to print Saurabh's name on Ela's wedding card.

episodesList.title: Dark Chocolate
episodesList.summary: Ela feels a bit uncomfortable in Sukesh's presence in the house. To make it worse, Esha, Sukesh's wife confesses to her mother that she wants a divorce from Sukesh. As Ela's marriage gets closer, Rohit is infuriated to learn that Saurabh's people have been spying on him to learn about his past. Ela disappears from a beauty parlour, where Esha has brought her for the bridal make-up.

episodesList.title: Ab Bacha Kya
episodesList.summary: As Ela returns to the engagement location with Saurabh, Sukesh goes into Ela's room to console her when Ela starts yelling. As Sukesh tags Ela as being mentally unstable, an infuriated Saurabh beats Sukesh black and blue. Sukesh is shocked to learn that Esha was pregnant and was taking abortion pills. He visits Harish and Triveni to complain about their daughter. Triveni asks Sukesh to get out and never come near her family.

episodesList.title: Kaun Hoon Main
episodesList.summary: Triveni goes to meet Vibha at her office and raises profound questions about the status and safety of girls in their homes and society. Harish comes to Vibha's house a broken man, reflecting on everything that went wrong. He questions their relationship and its future. Saurabh takes off on a journey of self-discovery trying to figure out who he is.

title: Shubh Shagun
summary: Shubh Shagun is an Indian drama series produced by Smita Thackeray, Swati Thanawala and Kundan Singh. launched under Rahul Media And Production LLP, broadcast on Dangal. It premiered on 2 May 2022 and ended abruptly on 31 October 2022 after completing 157 episodes and starred Krishna Mukherjee and Shehzada Dhami.
plot:
Shubh Jaiswal is an arrogant, greedy businessman in Mumbai and Shagun Shinde is a devotee of Lord Ganesha who values her family more than anything. Shagun works in Shubh's factory.
The situation worsens when Shubh's younger sister Navya falls in love with Shagun's younger brother Yug. Due to their social differences, Shagun dislikes her, while Shubh tries to have Yug marry Navya and make him home-husband as he cannot deny his sister's wish. Shagun tries to have Yug marry Ria, younger sister of her fiancé, Ashok. Shubh later learns about it and kidnaps Shagun into the godown and tries to burn her, but she narrowly escapes. Shagun tells Yug about this, and he calls off his marriage with Navya, and both Shagun and Yug set off to marry Ashok and Ria, respectively. As the preparation begins Shubh and Navya replace the Ashok and Ria and Shagun marries Shubh and Yug marries Navya unknowingly. Yug comes as a househusband, while Shagun comes there for her brother. Shubh locks Shagun in a room and tries to kill her by bursting the air conditioner but later saves her.
Kanika's husband Brijesh Jaiswal tries to kill Shubh but Shubh is saved by Shagun. Shagun shows Brijesh's real face to the family. Naina, Shubh's mentally challenged first wife, enters the house and creates many problems inside the family. She also tries to separate Shubh from Shagun along with Navya and Bindiya but fails. Later, Shubh discovers her sister's plans and slaps her and blames her for trying to separate him from Shagun. Shagun realises her husband's sister's evil games, blames herself, and tries to kill herself by jumping off the building, but Shubh saves her and confesses his love for Shagun.

title: Spy Bahu
summary: Spy Bahu (transl. A Spy daughter-in-law) is an Indian Hindi-language television spy drama series that premiered on 14 March 2022 on Colors TV. It is digitally available on Voot. Produced by Ashvini Yardi under the banner of Viniyard Films, it stars Sana Sayyad and Sehban Azim. The series went off-air on 30 September 2022.
plot:
Mahira Mirza is a young girl from Kashmir, whose parents Sharif and Aayat were killed in a terrorist attack and she got separated from her brother. She gets adopted by Saras and Minal Kotadia, who changes her name to Sejal Kotadia. While, her brother Fareed is adopted by Shera and becomes Abhishek Singh.
Yohan Nanda, is the son of rich businessman Arun Nanda, his mother Aarti died when he was young and he hates his step-mother and aunt Veera Nanda. He lives with his brothers Shail and Krish, sister Drishti and sister-in-law Shalini. Veera in reality is a terrorist and runs a group named "Mission Azaadi".
Sejal eventually join RAW with the help of S.K. and Tanha. She enters the Nanda mansion in order to spy on Yohan, who is suspected. She eventually learns that Yohan is innocent and Veera is the real culprit. She also learns that her brother, Abhishek is married to Yohan's sister Drishti. Abhishek loses his life in a mission to avenge his family's death, leaving Drishti in deep shock. She later give birth to Fareed's(aka Abhishek) son Aditya.
Veera makes her assistant Ahana enter the Nanda house as fake Mahira. They together prove Sejal as a terrorist and she is arrested. During court's hearing, Sejal's police van is forced to fall off the cliff by Ahana and Sejal is presumed dead.

articleSections.title: 6 months later
articleSections.text:
Sejal disguises as Paro and is pregnant. She re-enters the Nanda house faking memory loss. With her constant efforts, Yohan finds out that his mother was killed by Veera. They also found that Veera and Ahana were giving wrong medicines to Drishti. They together decides to expose Veera.
Veera tries to kill Shalini when she finds out her truth. Shalini is however, saved by Yohan and Sejal. Veera plans to kill the Nandas in a blast during Ganpati. But, Sejal saves everyone on time. Veera is exposed and is arrested by SK. Yohan is arrested on false charges of rape, through a plan made by Ahana and Veera.
During the court hearing, Yohan proves himself innocent, but Ahana turns the table around. Veera escapes police custody with Arbaaz's help and SK sir is killed by a bomb planted in the court. Sejal promises to catch Veera. Sejal is finally able to capture Veera who is killed while escaping. Ahana and Arbaaz are arrested.
Sejal is awarded for her bravery. She later gives birth to a baby girl, Hichki. Yohan is asked by Tanha to join as a spy. He and Sejal are assigned their new mission in Lucknow. The show ends on a happy note with Sejal, Yohan and Hichki enjoying their family time.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Sana Sayyad as Mahira Mirza Nanda / Sejal Saras Kottadia Nanda: Sharif and Aayat's daughter; Saras and Minal's adopted daughter; Abhishek's sister; Bumba's adopted sister; Yohan's wife; Hichki's mother ** Hardika Sharma as Child Mahira Mirza * Sehban Azim as Yohan Nanda: Arun and Aarti's younger son; Veera's nephew/step-son; Shail and Drishti's brother; Krish's half-brother; Sejal's husband; Hichki's father

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text:
Ashvini Yardi roped in actress Kareena Kapoor Khan as the narrator for the promos and the show. On her part, Kapoor said, "Spy Bahu is a fascinating love story that has left me captivated. The audience is going to love Sejal and Yohan's chemistry and enjoy this power-packed show."
Sana Sayyad on her role and shows comparison to Raazi said, "While the story is about an undercover agent, it has nothing to do with Raazi or even Ek Tha Tiger. With our show, we want to pay tribute to the many unnamed detectives, who are no less than soldiers for us. Sejal's flaws make her different. Honestly, I have always wanted to play a RAW agent or a spy and I feel I manifested this project."

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Sana Sayyad was cast to portray Mahira Mirza/Sejal Kotadia opposite Azim. Sana had to gain weight for her role of a spy. Sehban Azim was chosen to portray Yohan Nanda opposite Sayyad. He had to lose 8 kgs for his role of a businessman.
Parineeta Borthakur was cast as the main antagonist Veera Nanda. Wasim Mushtaq was roped in to portray Sejal's brother Fareed/Abhishek. But his track ended within 4 months. In July 2022, Sara Khan entered the show as Ahana.

articleSections.title: Filming
articleSections.text: The series is set in New Delhi and in Kashmir. It is mainly shot at the Film City, Mumbai. Some initial sequences were shot in Kashmir. The team also shot in Srinagar, including Lal Chowk.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: The series promos were released in February 2022, where Kareena Kapoor Khan introduced the characters of Sejal and Yohan. Spy Bahu premiered on 14 March 2022 on Colors TV and digitally on Voot.

articleSections.title: Cancellation
articleSections.text: The series went off-air on 30 September 2022. Sehban Azim said, "Everyone was obviously sad on the last day of the shoot, as we were expecting the show to run longer. The story was nice and so were the cast and the production house. In fact, even the ratings were decent as compared to other shows on the channel. I think there are more shows in the offing. They might come come up with a 2.0 and I would love to take it up if it's the same team."

articleSections.title: Critical reception
articleSections.text: Spy Bahu generally received positive reviews from critics. Rasika Deshpande said, " It is pretty intriguing and keeps you hooked onto it. It looks promising and moreover very interesting. Spy Bahu brings on board something different yet strong on Television after a pretty long time."

plotHtml:
Mahira Mirza is a young girl from Kashmir, whose parents Sharif and Aayat were killed in a terrorist attack and she got separated from her brother. She gets adopted by Saras and Minal Kotadia, who changes her name to Sejal Kotadia. While, her brother Fareed is adopted by Shera and becomes Abhishek Singh.
Yohan Nanda, is the son of rich businessman Arun Nanda, his mother Aarti died when he was young and he hates his step-mother and aunt Veera Nanda. He lives with his brothers Shail and Krish, sister Drishti and sister-in-law Shalini. Veera in reality is a terrorist and runs a group named "Mission Azaadi".
Sejal eventually join RAW with the help of S.K. and Tanha. She enters the Nanda mansion in order to spy on Yohan, who is suspected. She eventually learns that Yohan is innocent and Veera is the real culprit. She also learns that her brother, Abhishek is married to Yohan's sister Drishti. Abhishek loses his life in a mission to avenge his family's death, leaving Drishti in deep shock. She later give birth to Fareed's(aka Abhishek) son Aditya.
Veera makes her assistant Ahana enter the Nanda house as fake Mahira. They together prove Sejal as a terrorist and she is arrested. During court's hearing, Sejal's police van is forced to fall off the cliff by Ahana and Sejal is presumed dead.
tagline: Mahira Mirza is a young girl from Kashmir, whose parents Sharif and Aayat were killed in a terrorist attack and she got separated from her brother.

title: Sutliyan
summary: Sutliyan is an Indian web-series on ZEE5 starring Plabita Borthakur, Ayesha Raza, Shiv Panditt and Vivaan Shah. Sutliyan is created by Karan Raj Kohli / Viraj Kapur and Directed by Shree Narayan Singh. The eight part series is written by Sudeep Nigam and Abhishek Chatterjee and is produced by Manor Rama Pictures. Sutliyan released on 4 March 2022 on ZEE5.
plot: Sutliyan is a warm and fuzzy family drama set in the city of lakes and gardens, Bhopal. The Chandel family gets together after a long interval for Diwali, but unlike other years, everything is different now. Rajan (Shiv Panditt), Ramni(Plabita Borthakur) and Raman(Vivaan Shah) lost their father at the beginning of the early lockdowns and none of them could make it to his funeral, much to the angst of their mother Supriya (Ayesha Raza). The family reunites and while there is joy and nostalgia, as often happens with families, there is a fair share of angst and drama. The threads that bind us all together – Sutliyan – keep the family tied, yet we see an unspooling and unravelling at the same time.
reception: Archika Khurrana from Times of India gave three star and wrote" This heart-warming family reunion is well worth your time." Nandini Ramnath from Scroll.in wrote "Family ties bind and gag in well-performed drama".

title: Sab Satrangi
summary: Sab Satrangi (transl. Everything Colorful) is a Hindi-language slice of life comedy television series produced by Saurabh Tiwari under the banner Parin Multimedia. It aired on Sony SAB from 7 February 2022 to 25 June 2022.
plot:
Set in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, the show revolves around Mankameshwar "Manu" Maurya and his colourful family. Manu is honest, sincere, hardworking and noble person and is a believer in his grandmother's philosophy: "If you haven't done anything wrong to anyone, then nothing wrong would happen to you either."
Manu marries Shweta, as arranged by his family. The festive atmosphere turns sour as Shweta elopes soon after the wedding, leaving behind a letter in which she falsely accuses the Maurya family of asking for a dowry. (Shweta is involved in an affair with her boyfriend). A police inspector bribed by Shweta arrests Manu. After Manu's innocence is proven and he is released, his manager fires him from his job. Dejected but still hopeful, Manu decides to re-open 'Jai Mataji Tenthouse', which was owned by his grandfather and closed abruptly after his death.

episodesList.summary: Deepak comes to know the real name Gajodhar which is Vishvas Gupta. Gargi and Mannu get shocked to listen to this from Deepak. Deepak asks Vishvas what is going on in our house, one guy is residing in our house that too hiding his identity. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Vishvas Is Happy
episodesList.summary: Mannu enters the room and is feeling shy, Gargi asks her to say what he wants to but before he would say anything Gargi apologizes to Mannu for what Vishvas has done before. Mannu interrupted her in between and says I wanted to say that I'm so happy today because you showed trust in me. How this relationship will take a turn in Mannu and Gargi's life?

episodesList.title: Mannu's Plan
episodesList.summary: Mannu devises a plan with Daddy to provoke Vishwas into doing something outrageous. He wants to deceive Vishvas by announcing Gargi's pregnancy. Vishwas falls for the trap and calls Gargi to meet him. Will she see the real Vishwas? How will this change the relationship between Mannu and Gargi?

episodesList.title: Gargi Is Broken
episodesList.summary: Gargi comes to meet Vishvas and slaps him and suddenly Vishvas holds Gargi and hurts her by holding her violently. Besides, Mannu comes there and shouts at him saying that you aren't capable of Gargi Ji and also says, if you ever think of following Gargi Ji then that will be the last day of your life. Here, Gargi gives her final verdict to Vishvas, she is breaking her relationship with him.

episodesList.title: Mannu Shares His Past
episodesList.summary: Mannu reveals the truth in front of his family, Gargi Isn't pregnant. The doctor has made the wrong report by mistake. Listening to him Deepu shouts at Mannu to which hospital you've gone for the checkup? Besides, Mannu feels sorry and apologizes to Gargi but Gargi is upset and is reckoning the past days spent with Vishvas.

episodesList.title: A Trip To Nainital
episodesList.summary: Mannu and his family are off for a picnic in Nainital. They all play dumcherades. Hence, Gargi's father insists on Mannu to act and Gargi will identify the name of a movie. After a while, the bus gets punctured. Will this trip will be memorable for Gargi and Mannu?

episodesList.title: Does Gargi Feels For Mannu
episodesList.summary: Gargi feels low because of whatever happened in past with Vishvas. Her father tells her to forget whatever happened before and restart her life with Mankameshwar. But, Gargi says how can I think of only myself because I was the only one who confessed my love in front of Mankameshwar the very next day of our marriage. Will Mannu and Gargi restart their life?

episodesList.title: Deepu's Weird Question
episodesList.summary: Mannu and his family plays truth and dare all together. While spinning the bottle the bottle's tip stops at Mannu's father's side. Thereupon, Kanak asks his father what he will prefer truth or dare? But, Deepu interrupted in between and he asks his father a question, that have you ever given anything to your family or have you done anything for them? Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Deepu and Kanak's Bonding
episodesList.summary: Maurya family gets into the lift to reach their new flat. Kanak is so happy to come into the new flat and she decides to keep everything accordingly and also, she takes everyone's suggestions. Here, Deepu gets senti because now Kanak is shifting to a new house, Deepu asks Kanak to come back to home and give this flat to someone on rent. Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Mannu And Gargi's Sentimental Moment
episodesList.summary: Gargi asks Mannu why he hasn't told her about the contract. Mannu says to Gargi that the days of your freedom are closer. Because after getting the amount from this I will return the money to daddy Ji. Mannu gets emotional while saying this. Will Mannu and Gargi will be separated? Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Mannu's Confession
episodesList.summary: Shyamlal gives an idea to Mannu and gives him a rose and says, give this rose to Gargi and take a chance. Who knows she might take the decision of not going anywhere. This is love and love can do miracles. How will Mannu confess his feeling to Gargi?  Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Daddy's Announcement
episodesList.summary: Daddy announces that he would delegate his business to Gargi and Mannu while he is away. The cops arrive shortly after to take Daddy into custody. How will the Maurya family deal with this situation?  Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Daddy Ji's Belief In Mannu
episodesList.summary: Daddy Ji tells Mannu secretly that the situation is worst, even, I don't know when I'll be coming out from the prison. Also, Daddy Ji shows his belief in Mannu and says, I know you will take care of my business and my daughter as well.  Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Gargi And Mannu Appreciate Each Other
episodesList.summary: Mannu pampers Gargi by offering her a tea and says that the stress on your face isn't looking nice so, you just be relaxed and believe in yourself because I know you have that much potential that you can handle everything effortlessly.  Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Happiness Of The Maurya Family
episodesList.summary: Mannu and Roshan were talking suddenly, Gargi comes and sees samosas were kept she misunderstood Mannu. Later, they both went home together. Besides, Maurya family saw a news headline o taking care of the business of  Daddy Ji. Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Daddy Ji Came To Meet Gargi
episodesList.summary: Daddy Ji came out of prison to meet Gargi and Mannu. Also, daddy Ji tells them the biggest enemy of anyone is their close one because they know each and everything about you, So, be aware of that. Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Gargi's Surprise For Mannu
episodesList.summary: when Gargi and Maurya's family were having lunch, Gargi is waiting for Mannu. Here, Mannu comes into the hall running and tells Gargi that I came running very fast just to reach fast so that we both can have lunch together. Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Is Gargi In Love With Mannu?
episodesList.summary: while Mannu is busy with his own work, Gargi is staring at him and reckoning the previous day's statements Mannu said to her, which says, that he loves Gargi. Is Gargi also in love with Mannu? Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: A Potential Tragedy?
episodesList.summary: Shikkha is upset and frustrated because of the lies she is being fed about Vishwas. Meanwhile, on the other hand, there is a real gun present in the bag of children. Will the gun bring a tragedy to the house by getting someone injured? Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Gargi Is Helpless
episodesList.summary: when Gargi was out with emergency Ji, Daddy Ji called emergency ji and asks about Gargi that is she safe or not. Later, daddy Ji called Mannu and asks him to be with Gargi, So Mannu goes to Gargi, and as soon as he reached Gargi, someone shooted at Mannu. Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Is Mannu Out Of Danger?
episodesList.summary: when Gargi was out with emergency Ji, Daddy Ji called emergency ji and asks about Gargi that is she safe or not. Later, daddy Ji called Mannu and asks him to be with Gargi, So Mannu goes to Gargi, and as soon as he reached Gargi, someone shooted at Mannu. Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Gargi's Statement
episodesList.summary: when Gargi was out with emergency Ji, Daddy Ji called emergency ji and asks about Gargi that is she safe or not. Later, daddy Ji called Mannu and asks him to be with Gargi, So Mannu goes to Gargi, and as soon as he reached Gargi, someone shooted at Mannu. Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Will Gargi Be Able To Convey Her Feelings?
episodesList.summary: Mannu gets discharged from the hospital, and he waits for Gargi to come to the hospital. Mannu comes home and asks for Gargi, everyone keeps quiet. As Mannu enters his room, he gets a surprise from Gargi who had decorated the whole room for him. At night, Gargi opens a page and starts reading about her feelings for him. Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Gargi Is Missing Mannu
episodesList.summary: Deepu reads the letter which Gargi wrote for Mannu and shows it to everyone. Gargi feels shy and reads the paper herself. Later, Gargi goes alone to the party hence, Mannu also wanted to go with Gargi but Gargi tells him to stay at home. Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Gargi And Mannu Promised Each Other
episodesList.summary: Gargi and Mannu take seven rounds of fire to complete their seven promises. They both promise each other happily. Hence, the next morning Gargi and Mannu have a conversation about their marriage. Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Gargi Turns Things Around
episodesList.summary: Mannu and Roshan converse about that how they will send Gargi to Daddy Ji's office. Later, Mannu opened the almirah and he saw a card on which was written a love quote and he recited the line written on the card. When will Gargi confess her feeling openly to Mannu? Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Will Mannu And Gargi Get Exposed?
episodesList.summary: Mannu and Gargi return to the house from Daddy's office. Kanak catches them coming together from the balcony. She confronts Gargi for lying to her as she is in charge of the house after Daadi. She tells her that Daadi had strictly asked not to visit or interfere in Daddy's business. She also calls Emergency to know about the truth but gets teh same response as Gargi and Mannu had informed. Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Pinky's Misconception
episodesList.summary: Mannu asks everyone in the house to sleep soon. Besides, Deepu also says the same. Hence, everyone is unknown of the fact that there is a plan behind this. Later, Pinky goes to her room and sees the gifts kept in the room that Deepu brought for Mannu. Thus, Mannu is super excited for today's night. Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Gargi And Mannu Getting Closer
episodesList.summary: early in the morning when Gargi comes into the room and awakes Mannu. Mannu praises Gargi for her beauty. Gargi and Mannu spend time together. Therefore, they both questions each other about their bachelor's life. Gargi and Mannu are gradually making a strong bond between them. Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Gargi Is Stucked
episodesList.summary: Gargi comes to the office for talking about Daddy Ji's discharge. When Gargi was talking suddenly he started taking advantage of that moment. Meanwhile, Mannu arrived and saved Gargi. Later, Gargi and Mannu converse about the situation and say we'll not share anything in our house with anyone. Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Detective Kanak And Pinky
episodesList.summary: Pinky tells Kanak about the last night that all three, Mannu, Gargi, and, Jiyaji were planning something but, Kanak acts as if this didn't affect her. When Pinky left the kitchen then Kanak thinks about the same. Later, Gargi and Mannu were going somewhere and Kanak's husband was also joining them. Are they going to the same place? Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Deepu Defends Mannu And Gargi
episodesList.summary: Pinky tells everyone that Mannu and Gargi always go out of the house. Not a single day has gone when they haven't gone anywhere. To defend Mannu and Gargi, Deepu takes a stand for both. Will Dadi know about Mannu and Gargi? What are they up to? Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Daddy Ji Is Released
episodesList.summary: while the Maurya family was having a conversation, Deepu heard a noise from outside so, he went out to see what is happening outside, he saw everyone is welcoming Daddy Ji. Deepu called everyone from the house and welcomes Daddy Ji home. Gargi feels so happy to have her Daddy back. Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Mannu's Notion
episodesList.summary: Mannu shares his thoughts to Gargi, I always thought of marrying a girl to whom my Dadi will choose. Hence, Gargi tells him because of this we are together. Also, Gargi tells him because of Vishvas's behavior we met each other and we are together but I am also angry because of him I shouted at you and irritated you. Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Mannu Is Pissed Off
episodesList.summary: Mannu gets angry at a girl, why did she do these things. The girl said just because she wants to become a heroine she did all these things. Also, she asks whether he will send her to jail or not? But, Dadi says that we cannot send her to jail. Hence, the rest all the family members decide to file an FIR against her. Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Is Gargi Insecure?
episodesList.summary: Mannu went out of the house in anger too without having his breakfast. How will Gargi make Mannu come back to his normal mood? Besides, Shweta comes to Mannu and asks him to give her some work. How will Mannu react to this? Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Will Shweta Succeed In Her Plan?
episodesList.summary: Shweta jumps into a manhole to gain the sympathy of the Maurya family. Shweta comes out of the manhole and hugs Mannu, the media covers the whole thing. Daddy arrives at the scene and controls the whole situation. Gargi assures Mannu that she would always be by his side, no matter what. Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Why Is Daddy Ji Silent?
episodesList.summary: Shweta communicates with Daddy Ji and tells him that I'm Mannu's First wife and without taking a divorce having a second marriage is a crime. Hence, for this illegal crime, your helpless son-in-law will again go to jail, that too because of me. How will daddy Ji save his daughter's marriage? Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Gargi's Concern For Mannu
episodesList.summary: Gargi and Mannu were coming back home, Shweta saw them they are coming, and also, Mannu was shivering so she brought a blanket with her and tries to show a sweet gesture in front of Mannu. But, Mannu gets angry at Shweta and tells her that my wife Gargi is enough for me to keep my temperature parallel. What is Shweta's plan? Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: A Lovely Moment
episodesList.summary: Daddy Ji made a plan against Shweta's mom and asks Emergency Ji to offer her a film. Shweta's mother shares this good news with Shweta with full excitement. But, she isn't aware that Daddy Ji is behind this plan and he is only calling her indirectly to record her statement. Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Sting Operation
episodesList.summary: Daddy Ji has a solid plan for their sting operation. He asks his lawyer to disguise himself as a lawyer and asks Shweta'smmum to record everything. Shweta tells Mannu that she will ruin his connection with Gargi. But will she succeed in doing so?

episodesList.title: Shweta Tells The Truth To Gargi
episodesList.summary: Daddy Ji has a solid plan for their sting operation. He asks his lawyer to disguise himself as a lawyer and asks Shweta'smmum to record everything. Shweta tells Mannu that she will ruin his connection with Gargi. But will she succeed in doing so?

episodesList.title: Daddy Ji's Remorse
episodesList.summary: Daddy Ji tells the veracity of Shweta to Mannu. He tells him how she is blackmailing him by saying about her and Mannu's marriage, also, she says I can send Mannu back to the jail in the evidence of our marriage as we are still not divorced. Hence, Mannu asks Daddy Ji, why he hasn't said anything to him till now? Daddy Ji seems tensed. What is the reason behind it? Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: An Apologetic Feeling
episodesList.summary: Pinky sees Mannu coming home so late, so she asked him but Mannu ignored her without saying anything. Thereafter, Shweta also comes. Thus, Pinky asks her, was she with Mannu Bhaiya? Shweta purposely gives a shy reaction so that Pinky suspects her and Mannu. Later, Mannu feels so bad about the incident that happened the same day with Shweta.

episodesList.title: A Romantic Moment
episodesList.summary: Shweta and her mom are drunk and unconscious. Besides, Mannu and Gargi create a romantic moment. Thus, Gargi tells him I read somewhere if husbands show so much love then it is the indication that they are hiding something. Suddenly, Mannu gets silent and thinks about the last night with Shreya which he hasn't shared with Gargi. Will Mannu be able to hide this from Gargi for a long time? Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: A Hidden Truth
episodesList.summary: Mannu looks upset seeing him, Gargi asks him if something is hurting him. Mannu remembers the bygone moment and tells Gargi, I don't know why but whatever grandmother taught me I'm forgetting everything. Today whatever condition is of Shweta it's because of me. I feel like I'm changing day by day. When will Mannu and Gargi's happiness be back? Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Will Mannu fall In Shweta's Trap?
episodesList.summary: Dadi asks Mannu to go to the go-down and bring the rest of the dishes. Here, Shweta sees Mannu going towards the go-down and follows him back. When Mannu reached to take the things, he sees Shweta behind him. He asked what is she doing here? Shweta tells him that she wants to ask him some questions. Why Is Shweta pretending to be nice? Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: A Love Confession
episodesList.summary: Mannu and Gargi were ready for the puja and were happy. Suddenly, Shweta comes to Mannu and holds his hand, and confesses her feeling. Besides, Daddy Ji has planned something against Shweta. Daddy Ji comes to the pandal and tries to find out who is supporting Shweta? Will Daddy Ji find out who is behind the supporter of Shweta? Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Shweta Enters Mannu's Room
episodesList.summary: As the women of the colony decide to watch for the 'black monkey', Shweta takes the opportunity to spend some time with Mannu. Gargi sees a shadow in her room and thinks it to be the monkey. Mannu is shocked to see Shweta on his bed. Mannu accuses her to be greedy, and she tries to tell Mannu her feelings. Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: A Wife's Suspicion
episodesList.summary: Shweta's mom insists Shweta to eat food but Shweta refuses to eat. Besides, Gargi keeps an eye on Shweta and thinks why isn't she eating anything and doubts whether she kept a fast for Mannu. Here, Shweta takes a plate from her mom and pretends as if she will eat but she knock down the plate. Does Shweta kept a fast for Mannu? Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: A Strange Fear
episodesList.summary: Shweta entraps Mannu in front of the police by saying that he is my husband and says that he is not breaking my fast. Thereupon, Mannu shouted and asked her If you call yourself my wife then tell me where is the mark of a wound in my body? Shweta gets confused and couldn't answer him. Thereafter, Mannu left and goes to Gargi but there he saw Gargi is upset and is crying. On asking, she tells that she was feeling a strange fear, so she is sitting here outside the house. Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Mannu's Loyalty
episodesList.summary: Mannu asks Gargi where did she go and why are you crying? Gargi tells that papa has told her everything that Shweta is troubling him and you were alone facing her and hiding things from me. Don't you think me worthy Mannu? Mannu says yes I hid but I am worried that they will go away with daddy Ji's money. Later, Gargi thanks Mannu for coming into her life. Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Daddy Ji Caught Emergency Red-Handed
episodesList.summary: Emergency Ji takes Shweta, and her mother safely and ties Mannu, and Gargi with a rope. Here, Daddy Ji's news informer tells Daddy Ji about where Shweta and her mother have gone. Daddy Ji reached the place where Shweta and her mother are and together he sees Emergency is also with them. What step will daddy Ji take against Emergency? Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Shweta Is Harassing Mannu
episodesList.summary: Mannu comes home and asks what is Shweta and her mother doing to her? Hence, Gargi says, that this condition of Papa is because of both of them, they both blackmailed papa for fifty crores. And If he doesn't, then she will file a case that Shweta is the daughter-in-law of this house and Mannu's wife. Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: An Open Challenge
episodesList.summary: Gargi holds Mannu's hand and tells Shweta, do whatever you want to do, do as much try you can but you cannot separate us. Hence, Shweta says, you don't have such rights to give me a challenge. Instead, I'll give you a challenge. Within 12 hours you yourself will give Mannu's hand to mine. Or else I'll tell everyone that you kept your boyfriend with you under one roof.  Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Shweta Reveals The Truth Of Vishvas
episodesList.summary: Shweta discloses the truth about Vishvas in front of the family members. Therefore, Pinky taunts Gargi for hiding Vishvas's identity, also, she tells Dadi not to worry her elder daughter-in-law is still here. Meanwhile, Dadi asks Shweta to leave the place and not to say anything about Gargi and slapped Shweta. Also, warns her this shouldn't be repeated again. And, Gargi herself had said to me about Vishvas earlier so don't you dare to talk about her character. Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Will Gargi Leave The House?
episodesList.summary: Shweta says, this time Mannu is going to jail because of you not because of me, Gargi. Then Gargi says if I have to pay this price to save Mannu then I am ready to leave this house. Meanwhile, Deepu comes and shows a video to the inspector in which he is taking a bribe from Shweta. Thereafter, Dadi questions Gargi about how can you think of leaving the house? Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Shweta Buys Mannu's Shop
episodesList.summary: Shweta buys the shop which was rented by Mannu, he challenges him and tells Mannu that her husband can use the shop if he wants. Everyone in the family is shocked as the tent house was a dream of the family. Shweta's mother confronts her for spending such an amount on the shop. Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: The Locker Key
episodesList.summary: The family members wait for Shweta to leave the house so they can search for the locker keys. Deepu and other members of the family are eager to see Shweta leave the house and she comes back for her bottle. Daadi Maa and Gargi plan to call Shweta's mom and distract her while Mannu and other members of the house try to search for the keys. Daadi Maa invites Shweta's mother to have mango with the family.

episodesList.title: Shweta's Plan
episodesList.summary: The Mauryas attempt to gain entry to Shweta's locker using a duplicate key, but the receptionist refuses to give access to them. Shweta takes out all the money from the locker and hides it under her bed. Shweta challenges all the members of the family and accuses them to be the villain. Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Daadi Maa Orders To Start The Shop Again
episodesList.summary: Shweta's mother warns her not to steep so low to win. She also warns her about the consequences of her actions. Daadi Maa is broken after Shweta burns all the papers, and all the family members come to her rescue. She orders Mannu to start the tent house again,  Mannu who is filled with anger seeing Daadi Maa confronts Shweta. Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Shweta's Truth Exposed
episodesList.summary: Shweta's mother and Shweta understand Pinky's plan when they saw the Bluetooth fall from Pinky's ear. Shweta asks her what is all this? Were you spying on us? Besides, Mannu, Deepu, and Gargi came upstairs and played the recording of Shweta in which she was telling the truth that how did she execute her plan every time. Hence, Gargi gives Shweta the last chance to leave the house or else she will call the police. Will Shweta leave the house? Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: A Condition Placed
episodesList.summary: Dadi gives all the responsibility of worship to Shweta and says you will do everything from calling the priest to preparing prasad. Hence, Shweta takes all the responsibility for Worship and tells I'll do everything alone. But, Shweta keeps one condition. She says Mannu will sit with me while worshipping. Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: A Fear Of Consequence
episodesList.summary: a day back, Mannu challenged Shweta to prove that you are a good wife and If you complete this challenge then will leave Gargi's hand. Mannu thinks about the same thing and says what If my challenge weighs heavily on me then? Mannu talks to Gargi about the same and says that he is so frightened of the consequence. Gargi, at the same time, gives courage to Mannu and says that our love is true, not a liar like Shweta. Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: The Next Challenge For Shweta
episodesList.summary: Dadi's next challenge is bothering Shweta, In which Dadi asked her how will you provide nutritious food to the whole family in three hundred rupees and what? Shweta tells her mom that Dadi has given her the challenge intentionally so that I lose the challenge. Her mom gives her some ideas but Shweta didn't like her plan. Later, Shweta brings the food of three hundred rupees by herself. Is the food nutritious? Will she pass the challenge? Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Mannu Prepares To Plan A Baby
episodesList.summary: Mannu tells Gargi that they should plan a baby, Gargi suggests that her elder brother-in-law should have a baby first. Mannu tells him about the competition he had with his brother and how much he wants to win this competition. Daadi gives a lecture about equality to Shweta and makes her agree to take on the task of finding a customer for the Jai Mata Di Tent House. Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Will Shweta Succeed In The Task?
episodesList.summary: Shweta fails to impress the client, who refuses to grant Jai Mata Di Tent House the contract. Gargi, on the other hand, swoops in to salvage the company's reputation and tries to persuade the client. Will she be able to succeed in her plan? Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Mannu And Gargi's Relationship At Stake
episodesList.summary: Kanak interrogates Gargi for whatever she did for the tent house. Gargi tells her our tent house was dying to save it I had to do these things. Also, this tent house is a dream for all of us. Hence, Kanak tells for the sake of our happiness you put your relationship at stake. Besides, Shweta and her mom try to take the credit for saving the tent house. Will Mannu and Gargi get separated? Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Will Daddy Ji Be Able To Expose Shweta?
episodesList.summary: Daddy is angry as he feels helpless for not being able to help the relationship between Gargi and Mannu. he tries to move from his wheelchair and help his daughter. He falls from his chair and asks Deepu and Shyam Ji to take him to his office as he has the signed confession of Shweta which can save the relationship. Shweta tries to show off her win in front of Gargi, but Gargi asks her to love Mannu so that he forgets her for his entire life. Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Will Daddy Forgive Emergency?
episodesList.summary: Emergency apologizes to Daddy and asks Daddy to shoot him. Daddy got angry and moves forward to shoot Emergency but, Shyam Ji stopped Daddy from doing so. Also, Shyam Ji tells Daddy that you are not a murderer you are Daddy. And there are tears of remorse in Emergency's eyes so forgive him. Will Daddy forgive Emergency? Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: Is All Going To Be Good?
episodesList.summary: Deewakar Ji gets a call from Dipu and then after the call declination, Deewakar starts dancing happily. Also, he threatens Shweta, If you have the guts then get Gargi out of the house. Dadi and Kanak ask the reason behind his happiness. Then, Deewakar reveals the truth about Shweta that she had signed a document worth fifty crores and the same document Daddy Ji, papa, and Deepu are bringing along with them. Stay tuned and.

episodesList.title: Mannu Is Grateful To Daddy Ji
episodesList.summary: Deewakar tells Daddy Ji, we have invested all our life's capital in our flat, we were not even sure whether we would get our money or not. And one day you came and we got our house. Also, all the debt has been removed from our heads. Hence, Daddy says, you are misunderstanding, you all have caused a lot of trouble because of me, for which I apologize to you. Stay tuned and

episodesList.title: A Good News
episodesList.summary: Gargi suddenly fell ill so Mannu called the doctor. Gargi stares at Mannu and then says I am not pregnant. Mannu tells, that only a doctor can tell this whether you're pregnant or not. Just then, the doctor says to Mannu there's good news you are going to be a father. The whole family jumped with joy. stay tuned and

plotHtml:
Set in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, the show revolves around Mankameshwar "Manu" Maurya and his colourful family. Manu is honest, sincere, hardworking and noble person and is a believer in his grandmother's philosophy: "If you haven't done anything wrong to anyone, then nothing wrong would happen to you either."
Manu marries Shweta, as arranged by his family. The festive atmosphere turns sour as Shweta elopes soon after the wedding, leaving behind a letter in which she falsely accuses the Maurya family of asking for a dowry. (Shweta is involved in an affair with her boyfriend). A police inspector bribed by Shweta arrests Manu. After Manu's innocence is proven and he is released, his manager fires him from his job. Dejected but still hopeful, Manu decides to re-open 'Jai Mataji Tenthouse', which was owned by his grandfather and closed abruptly after his death.
tagline: Set in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, the show revolves around Mankameshwar "Manu" Maurya and his colourful family.

title: Sona Roder Gaan
summary: Sona Roder Gaan is a Bengali daily soap which aired on Colors Bangla from 24 January 2022. It stars Payel De and Rishi Kaushik. It is the remake of Colors TV's Thodasa Badal Thodasa Paani.
plot:
Anandi is a responsible girl who lives in a joint family with her parents and other family members. She is set to marry her love interest Bikram. Bikram's family demand dowry from Anandi's father Bishwanath. Biswanath takes a loan to pay dowry and when Anandi discovers this, she refuses to marry. Later, on Biswanath's persuasion, she agrees to the marriage. Meanwhile, Anandi meets Dr. Anubhab, who is Bikram's cousin and also Biswanath's doctor. Anubhab helps Anandi every time. Anandi suspects that Bikram is having an affair with his sister-in-law Shreya.
Biswanath dies on the wedding day due to stress and Anandi breaks her marriage with Bikram. Anandi's mother and sister blame Anandi for Biswanath's death. To help her family and to pay off debt, Anandi starts work. Meanwhile, Anubhav falls in love with Anandi. Bikram lures Nanda into his fake love to take revenge on Anandi. Nanda marries Bikram despite Anandi's warning. Shreya starts creating trouble for Nanda. Meanwhile, Anubhab's friend Diya, who is in love with Anubhab, gets jealous of Anandi. Diya creates misunderstanding in Anandi and Anubhav's relationship but it eventually improves anyway.
Meanwhile, Anandi's brother Apu falls in love with Bikram's sister, Bulti, but no one agrees to their relationship, but Anandi gets them married. Anubhab meets with an accident and becomes disabled, Anandi helps him.

title: Shaaticup
summary: Shaaticup (Bengali: শাটিকাপ) is a Bangladeshi crime drama streaming television series directed by Mohammad Touqir Islam. The eight-episode series was released on 13 January 2022 on Chorki.
plot: Hannan and Joynal plan to invade drug lord Sohel's monopoly kingdom. Sohel assigns Uttam, the most influential Investigation Officer in the area, to capture Hannan and Joynal. Several complex moves come one after another in this SnakeLudo game. Who will win this game? Drug lord, new traders, cunning officer, or anyone beyond imagination?
reception:
Shadique Mahbub Islam of The Financial Express praised the series, commenting, "The series has retained its local flavour in its dialogues and character development, so much so that it feels like an authentic visual experience of the city, the char, the Padma river".
Sayed Arafat Zubayer of The Business Standard, praised the Chorki series Shaaticup for its realistic portrayal of Rajshahi's drug-trafficking underbelly. He highlighted director Mohammad Touqir Islam's effective screenplay and the decision to use a local cast and regional dialect, concluding that the show delivers an authentic and unique regional viewing experience despite minor character flaws.

articleSections.text: Principal photography has taken place in different locations of Rajshahi, Bangladesh from October 2020 to August 2021.

title: Sampurna
summary:
Sampurna is an Indian Bengali social drama web series streaming on Hoichoi. Directed by Sayantan Ghosal, the series has been written by Anuja Chatterjee along with Soumyabrata Rakshit. Produced by Follow Focus Films and Shree Venkatesh Films, the series deals with the themes of marital rape against a woman and unequal consent for the female counterpart in a marriage.
The series stars Sohini Sarkar in the titular role of "Sampurna". She plays the role of a woman who fights to protect her sister-in-law from marital rape, a largely unrecognised issue in the society. Rajnandini Paul plays a parallel lead while Anubhav Kanjilal and Prantik Chatterjee play other pivotal roles. Pravatendu Mondal did the cinematography while Subhajit Singha handled the editing. Two seasons of the series has been released and they are streaming on the Bengali OTT platform "Hoichoi".

articleSections.title: Overview
articleSections.text:
Sampurna revolves around two sister-in-laws, Nandini and Sampurna, whose lives fall into turmoil due to domestic violence. Nandini's new marriage turns into a nightmare for her, as husband Raktim abused her sexually. She becomes a victim of marital rape as she is forced to engage in sexual activity with her husband, without her consent. Raktim's parents gives more priority to their social image, instead of helping Nandini. Raktim's mother fails to recognise her son's fault and blames it on Raktim and Nandini's non-matching kundli. Aggrieved by Nandini's suffering, Sampurna takes on the task to help Nandini come out of the traumatic cycle of marital rape.
The second season primarily focuses on Sampurna's traumatic past, where she has been a victim of molestation by her maternal uncle. To help Nandini, she seeks help from her maternal uncle Hirak Lahiri, a renowned lawyer. He resolves Nandini's marital rape issue through legal procedure. But his presence triggers back the childhood trauma in Sampurna, which she had kept secret for so many years. Her uncle had molested her while she was a teenager. Besides fighting for Nandini, she also fights for herself in an unequal battle against her uncle, who outpowers her using his economic strength and social outreach.

articleSections.title: Announcement and development
articleSections.text:
The second season of Sampurna was announced in early 2023, at the seventh slate of "Hoichoi" announcements in early 2023.
The first look pictures of Sohini Sarkar and Prantik Banerjee from their wedding sequence in the second season were released on 11 August 2023.

articleSections.title: Pre production
articleSections.text: Sohini Sarkar mentioned in an interview with ABP Ananda that she said "yes" to her role in Sampurna after hearing the script the first time. She also said that she believes, women should readily agree for such web series which serves a social message through it, specially regarding sensuous and less spoken matters like marital rape.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: The first season of Sampurna was streamed on "Hoichoi" on 29 July 2022. The second season was streamed on "Hoichoi" on 29 September 2023.

articleSections.title: Audience reception
articleSections.text: The first season of Sampurna emerged as the most viewed show on "Hoichoi" in a single month; in August 2022.

articleSections.title: Remake
articleSections.text: JioHotstar bought the remake rights of the series for the Hindi remake. Sampurna marked the first Bengali web series, which has been remade in Hindi. The series Chiraiya was streamed on JioHotstar, on 20 March 2026.

title: Sasural Genda Phool 2
summary: Sasural Genda Phool 2 is an Indian television action romance drama thriller series that aired on Star Bharat, starring Jay Soni and Shagun Sharma. It is a sequel of StarPlus's show, Sasural Genda Phool, which earlier starred Jay Soni and Ragini Khanna. It is digitally available on Disney+ Hotstar. The show premiered on 7 December 2021. The show went off air on 15 April 2022.
plot:
The show takes place seven years after the events of Sasural Genda Phool, revolving around Ishaan who is now a widower as Suhana has died. Ishaan is living with Suhana's memories and does not wish to remarry as per the promise he made to her. The Kashyap family is worried for him and keeps insisting him to remarry, bringing new marriage proposals for Ishaan everyday which annoys him; Ishaan manages to reject them with excuses.
Soon, Ishaan crosses paths with Tanya aka Titlee, a street-smart thief and con-woman, who hates relationships and doesn't believe in love as her dreams were shattered by her drunkard father. Ishaan and Titlee make a deal: Titlee would pretend to be Ishaan's girlfriend in front of his family and purposefully create a bad impression on them, to make them quit the thought of getting Ishaan remarried; while Ishaan would pay her in return for her help. They execute their plan and successfully manage to turn everyone against Titlee. Ishaan thanks Titlee for her help and pays her as promised, parting ways with her. Titlee slowly realises that while pretending to have feelings for Ishaan, she has actually fallen in love with him.
Jagdish, Titlee's father, gets drunk and accidentally exposes Ishaan and Titlee's secret to the Kashyaps. Shocked, the Kashyaps try to make Ishaan confess this but fail. Meanwhile, Ishaan stands by Titlee's side in her personal battles and emotionally supports her. He falls in love with her but feels guilty for betraying Suhana. Unwilling to move on from Suhana, a scared Ishaan confesses the truth to his family that Titlee is not his girlfriend and that he was putting up an act in front of them. Titlee breaks into tears after overhearing Ishaan declaring to his family that he doesn't love her.

plotHtml: The show takes place seven years after the events of Sasural Genda Phool, revolving around Ishaan who is now a widower as Suhana has died. Ishaan is living with Suhana's memories and does not wish to remarry as per the promise he made to her. The Kashyap family is worried for him and keeps insisting him to remarry, bringing new marriage proposals for Ishaan everyday which annoys him; Ishaan manages to reject them with excuses. Soon, Ishaan crosses paths with Tanya aka Titlee, a street-smart thief and con-woman, who hates relationships and doesn't believe in love as her dreams were shattered by her drunkard father. Ishaan and Titlee make a deal: Titlee would pretend to be Ishaan's girlfriend in front of his family and purposefully create a bad impression on them, to make them quit the thought of getting Ishaan remarried; while Ishaan would pay her in return for her help. They execute their plan and successfully manage to turn everyone against Titlee. Ishaan thanks Titlee for her help and pays her as promised, parting ways with her. Titlee slowly realises that while pretending to have feelings for Ishaan, she has actually fallen in love with him. Jagdish, Titlee's father, gets drunk and accidentally exposes Ishaan and Titlee's secret to the Kashyaps. Shocked, the Kashyaps try to make Ishaan confess this but fail. Meanwhile, Ishaan stands by Titlee's side in her personal battles and emotionally supports her. He falls in love with her but feels guilty for betraying Suhana. Unwilling to move on from Suhana, a scared Ishaan confesses the truth to his family that Titlee is not his girlfriend and that he was putting up an act in front of them. Titlee breaks into tears after overhearing Ishaan declaring to his family that he doesn't love her.
