articleSections.title: Super Singer season 1
articleSections.text:
The first season premiered on 28 April 2006, with a series of episodes which telecasted auditions for the show. Auditions were held across the state of Tamil Nadu in the cities of Coimbatore, Chennai, and Madurai. Performances by auditioning contestants were judged by singers S. P. Sailaja, Jency, Malaysia Vasudevan, Sirkazhi Sivachidambaram, Mahathi, and music director D. Imman.
The show was hosted by playback singer Chinmayi. Later stages of the competition were held at a specially designed studio set, and performances were judged by a panel of permanent judges consisting of playback singers Anuradha Sriram, P. Unnikrishnan, and Srinivas. Season 1 runner up and viewer's choice, Anitha V. (now known as Anitha Karthikeyan) was formally introduced as a playback singer in the Tamil film Marudhamalai by music director D. Imman.

articleSections.title: Super Singer season 2
articleSections.text:
The second season premiered on 7 July 2008; It held a series of episodes that telecast auditions for the show. Auditions for the show, which commenced on 27 June 2008, were held across three cities in the state of Tamil Nadu. Performances by auditioning contestants were judged by playback singers S. P. Sailaja and Srilekha Parthasarathy in the city of Coimbatore, Sunitha Sarathy and Deepan Chakravarthy in the city of Chennai, as well as Mahathi and Mathangi in the city of Trichy.
Playback singer Chinmayi returned as a permanent host of the show up to and including 21 January 2009, following which she left the show much to the disappointment of many fans of the show. She was replaced by a duo, singer-actor Yugendran and his wife, Malini, for the remainder of the show in 2009. Playback singers P. Unnikrishnan and Srinivas returned as permanent judges of the show, and a new permanent judge, playback singer Sujatha replaced Anuradha Sriram (who instead appeared as a guest judge through the season). Contestants were eliminated during the competition, and finalists received special training from voice expert Ananth Vaidyanathan in the final stages of the competition.
The Grand Finale was held on 3 June 2009 at YMCA Royapettah, Chennai. At the finals, Ajeesh won the competition and was chosen by Yuvan Shankar Raja to sing the song Idhu Varai for the soundtrack of Tamil film, Goa.

articleSections.title: Super Singer season 3
articleSections.text:
Airtel Super Singer 3, the third season of the Airtel Super Singer show, premiered on 12 July 2010. The third season was hosted by Divya Vijayagopal and Sivakarthikeyan. The auditions were held in various parts of Tamil Nadu, and were judged by singers including S. P. Sailaja, Nithyasree Mahadevan, Unni Menon, Sowmya, Harish Raghavendra, Pop Shalini, Mahathi, and Malgudi Subha. Sujatha, P. Unnikrishnan and Srinivas continued to be the permanent judges for the third consecutive season.
The grand finale was held on 23 September 2011 at Chennai Trade Centre and was broadcast live. Saicharan won the competition, and was chosen by A. R. Rahman and D. Imman to sing in the films Godfather, Manam Kothi Paravai, and Saattai.

articleSections.title: Super Singer season 4
articleSections.text:
Airtel Super Singer 4, the fourth season of the Airtel Super Singer show, premiered on 4 February 2013. The fourth season was hosted by Makapa Anand, Priyanka Deshpande, and Bhavana Balakrishnan.
The auditions were held in various parts of Tamil Nadu, and were judged by singers including S. P. Sailaja, Nithyasree Mahadevan, Unni Menon, Sowmya, Devan Ekambaram, Pop Shalini, Mahathi, Malgudi Subha and Rajinderpal Singh. Playback singers, Sujatha Mohan, Mano, P. Unnikrishnan and Srinivas, were the judges for the fourth season.
Diwakar won the competition, and was chosen by music directors D. Imman, Vivek-Mervin, and Kannan to sing in the films Panjumittai, Vadacurry, and Kalkandu.

articleSections.title: Super Singer season 5
articleSections.text:
Airtel Super Singer 5, the fifth season of the Airtel Super Singer show, premiered on 1 June 2015. The fifth season was hosted by Makapa Anand, Priyanka Deshpande, and Bhavana Balakrishnan.
The auditions were held in various parts of Tamil Nadu and were telecast until 3 July 2015. First-round audition judges included season 3 winner Saisharan, season 4 winner Diwakar, and former contestants from those seasons such as D. Sathyaprakash, Pooja Vaidyanath, Santhosh Hariharan, and Sonia. Second and third round audition judges included S. P. Charan, Pushpavanam Kuppusamy, Devan Ekambaram, James Vasanthan, Mahathi, S. Sowmya, and Pop Shalini. Zonal audition judges were permanent judges from the junior version of the show, Malgudi Subha, Mano, and K. S. Chithra. A total of 33 contestants were selected for the finals, including local, international, and former contestants.
Playback singers, P. Unnikrishnan, Srinivas, Mano, and Usha Uthup, were the judges for the fifth season. At the finale of the show, contestant Anand Aravindakshan was declared the winner of the season, while contestant Fareedha was declared first runner-up. Both finalists were promised an opportunity to sing for one of the upcoming films of music director Santhosh Narayanan. Contestant Rajaganapathy was chosen as the judge's choice scoring the highest marks and being declared the second runner-up of the season.
The season landed in controversy as social media users accused the STAR Vijay Indian TV channel of wrongdoing. Social media users expressed concern that audiences who spent time and money to support talented youngsters were the victim of unethical practices and criticised the channel for not being upfront about the fact that the winning contestant was already a professional playback singer - which was defended by the channel.

articleSections.title: Super Singer season 6
articleSections.text:
Nippon Paint Super Singer 6 was hosted by Makapa Anand and Priyanka Deshpande, which ran from 21 January 2018 to 15 July 2018 and was broadcast by Star Vijay.
All the episodes of Super Singer 6 are available on the OTT platform Hotstar.
The judging panel includes, Anuradha Sriram, P. Unnikrishnan, Benny Dayal, and Shweta Mohan. A.R. Rahman was the Ambassador for this season. The top 6 finalists were Rakshitha, Sreekanth, Sakthi, Anirudh, Malavika, and Senthil Ganesh. The results of the finale are given as:
Senthil Ganesh was declared the Winner of the Super Singer 6 * Rakshitha Suresh became the first runner up of the season and gets applauded by everyone for being the "Golden Voice of the Season". * Malavika Rajesh Vaidya was the second runner up of the season. * Suswaram Anirudh, Sakthi Amaran, Sreekanth Hariharan were the other finalists

articleSections.title: Super Singer season 7
articleSections.text:
Asian Paints Super Singer 7 started on 27 April 2019 and finished on 10 November 2019 on Star Vijay and was telecast from 8 PM onwards. Makapa Anand and Priyanka Deshpande return as the hosts for this season.
This season returns with the same judges' panel including, Anuradha Sriram, Unnikrishnan, Shweta Mohan, and Benny Dayal. Anirudh Ravichandran is the Ambassador for this season. The top 5 were Mookuthi Murugan (SS3), Sam Vishal (SS7), Vikram (SS13), Gowtham, and Punya(SS 6).
Winners:
Murugan was declared the Winner of the Super Singer Season 7 and received a 50 lakh worth house by Arun Excello. * Vikram was the first runner up of the season and was awarded 25 lakh gold by Gold one. * Sam Vishal and Punya were tied as the second runner up of the season. * Gowtham was the third runner up of the season.
All of the episodes of this season are available on the OTT Platform-Hotstar.

articleSections.title: Super Singer season 8
articleSections.text:
Asian Paints Super Singer 8 premiered on 24 January 2021 with a Grand Launch of a nine-hour program on Star Vijay with grace performances of Hariharan, Shankar Mahadevan, Anuradha Sriram, P. Unnikrishnan, Sid Sriram, Sakthisree Gopalan, Saindhavi, Vijay Prakash, Karthik, Anthony Daasan Shashaa Tirupati, Benny Dayal, Kalpana Raghavendar, Pradeep, Vijay Yesudas, S. P. Charan, Gana Bala, Chinnaponnu, Karunas. All the episodes will be available on the OTT Platform-Hotstar.
The judging panel was often shuffled with Anuradha Sriram, P. Unnikrishnan, Benny Dayal, Shweta Mohan, S. P. Charan, Shakthisree Gopalan and Kalpana Raghavendar. Once again, the eighth season was hosted by Makapa Anand and Priyanka Deshpande.
The Grand Finale aired on 26 September 2021. At the finals, Sridhar Sena won the title.
Prize Winners:
Sridhar Sena was announced the Winner of the Super Singer 8 and received a 10 lakh award by Vijay TV. He has also been provided the opportunity to sing in a future film song composed by Anirudh Ravichander. * Bharat K Rajesh (announced by Mervin Solomon) was the runner up of the season and was awarded an amount of 3 lakhs and an additional amount of Rs 50,000. * Abhilash Venkatachalam was announced third place by Santhosh Narayanan. He received a cash prize of Rs 2 lakh, and stated that the money was going to be spent for those who were affected by the COVID - 19 Pandemic situation. * Muthusirpi was awarded the title of Differentiator of the Season and received an amount of Rs 1 lakh, presented by K. S. Chithra.

articleSections.title: Super Singer season 9
articleSections.text:
MRF Vapocure Paints Super Singer Season 9 started on 19 November 2022 on Star Vijay and was telecast from every Saturday and Sunday at 6:30 PM. Makapa Anand and Priyanka Deshpande returns as the hosts for this season. This season returns with the same judges' panel including, Anuradha Sriram, P. Unnikrishnan, Benny Dayal, and Shweta Mohan.
Super Singer Season 9 Grand Finale was held on 25 June 2023 at Jawaharlal Nehru Indoor Stadium, Chennai.
Before the grand finale took place and during the contestants' tenure at Super Singer 9, several finalists, were offered to sing in film albums. Music directors, such as Sam C. S. and Hiphop Tamizha Adhi gave these splendid opportunities to the finalists. First, Pooja Venkatraman was offered to sing a song under Sam C. S's direction. Then Abhijith Anilkumar was offered to co-sing a song with Shreya Ghoshal in the film Thiruvin Kural, and the lyrics were written by the songwriter Vairamuthu. Finally, Aruna Sivaya was offered to sing a song under the music direction of Hiphop Tamizha Adhi .
The five finalists of Super Singer 9 are Abhijith Anilkumar, Aruna Sivaya, Pooja Venkatraman, Priya Jerson and Prasanna Adhisesha. Prassana Adhisesha was nominated from the wildcard round.
Several guests that included in the grand finale are Harris Jayaraj, Kalpana Raghavendar, Ananth Vaidyanathan, Pushpavanam Kuppusamy, Binni Krishnakumar.
The grand finale consisted of two rounds. The first round and the second round enabled the contestants to choose their own songs and sing them in front of the wide audience. Several contestants merged two songs, during the second round.
Prize Winners: * Aruna Sivaya, who was announced by Harris Jayaraj, won Super Singer 9. So she was gifted with an apartment worth 60 Rs lakhs and received a Rs 10 lakhs cash prize award by Star Vijay. * Priya Jerson was announced by Harris Jayaraj, as the first runner-up of Super Singer 9 and was awarded a Rs 10 lakhs cash prize award by Star Vijay. * Prasanna Adhisesha was announced as the second runner-up of Super Singer 9 and was awarded a Rs 5 lakhs cash prize award by Star Vijay.

articleSections.title: Super Singer season 10
articleSections.text:
Super Singer Season 10, the tenth season of the Airtel Super Singer show, premiered on Star Vijay on 16 December 2023, and telecasts every Saturday and Sunday. KAG Tiles is the sponsor for this season. Once again, this season is hosted by Makapa Anand and Priyanka Deshpande. The judging panel of this season is, Anuradha Sriram, Sean Roldan, Mano, and Sujatha Mohan.
The Grand Finale was on 23 June 2024. At the finals, John Jerome was the title winner. Jeevitha became the first runner-up, and Vaishanvi became the second runner-up.

articleSections.title: Super Singer Season 11
articleSections.text:
Super Singer Season 11, the eleventh season of the Airtel Super Singer show, premiered on Star Vijay on 2nd August 2025, telecasting every Saturday and Sunday. KAG Tiles is once again the sponsor for this season. Once again, the eleventh season will be hosted by the dynamic duo Makapa Anand and Priyanka Deshpande. The judging panel includes composer Thaman S, filmmaker Mysskin, and popular playback singers Anuradha Sriram, and P. Unnikrishnan.
The first promo was released on 14th July 2025.
The 7 Finalists were 1.Nikhil 2.Dishathana 3.Saran Raja 4.Meenakshi 5.Thavaseeli 6.Dharshana 7.Abraham
The Title winner of Season 11 was Nikhil , The First Runner Up was both Saran Raja and Dishathana The Second Runner Up was Meenakshi
This was the first season to have 7 finalists

articleSections.title: Super Singer T20
articleSections.text: Super Singer T20 (சூப்பர் சிங்கர் T20) is a 2012-2015 Indian Tamil-language reality television singing competition, which aired on Star Vijay. Former contestants from previous seasons of the Super Singer and Airtel Super Singer Junior shows were divided into 6 teams. 15 league matches were held where each team competed against the other five teams. 4 teams were selected for the knockout semi-finals, before the remaining 2 teams competed against each other in the finals. The show was hosted by Divyadarshini.

articleSections.title: Super Singer - Champion of Champions
articleSections.text:
Super Singer - Champion of Champions is a 2020 Indian Tamil-language reality television singing competition, which aired on Star Vijay.
Shankar Mahadevan, Sudha Ragunathan, K. S. Chithra, Chinmayi, Anuradha Sriram, Benny Dayal, Kalpana Raghavendar, Vijay Yesudas, Shweta Mohan and Sikkil Gurucharan as the judges, take turns to watch their performance live, albeit, from their homes. The show was hosted by Ma Ka Pa Anand and Priyanka Deshpande. Super Singer Champion Of Champions Winner is Hari Priya.

articleSections.title: Bakthi Super Singer
articleSections.text:
Bakthi Super Singer (பக்தி சூப்பர் சிங்கர்) is a 2025 Indian Tamil-language reality television devotional singing competition show, which aired on Star Vijay. The show is part of Super Singer and focus exclusively on Tamil devotional songs, bringing spiritual music to television screens across Tamil Nadu. Anuradha Sriram and Akshatha Das were hosts of the show which was judged by Mahathi, T. L. Maharajan and Pushpavanam Kuppusamy are the judges of the show. The show has 12 singers. The show was aired from 31 May to 27 July 2025 and ended with 18 Episodes.
The Grand Finale was held on 26th and 27th July 2025 on Saturday and Sunday. The show was won by Shravan Narayan, while Alaina Sajith emerged as the first runner up of the show.

episodesList.title: The Journey Begins
episodesList.summary: Season 5 of Airtel Super singer kicks off with the Trichy zonal auditions. A few among the hundreds of people auditioning for the show talk about their journey and their passion for singing. Super singers from the previous seasons judge the candidates as host Bhavana entertains the crowd.

episodesList.title: One Minute Challenge
episodesList.summary: Host Bhavana and Priyanka start the day two auditions with judges T L Maharajan, Sasirekha, Pop Shalini and SPB Charan. The participants give their performances in One Minute to Impress challenge.

episodesList.title: A Firefighter's Dream to Sing
episodesList.summary: The next batch enters the auditions, ready to showcase their talent and follow their dreams. Mr. Ramesh, a firefighter by profession, auditions with a hope to fulfill his aspiration of becoming a professional singer. Let us see if he will move on to the next level.

episodesList.title: Irwin Victoria Shines
episodesList.summary: The auditions continue as hundreds of candidates go through the selection process, judged precisely by the playback singers. A few of the candidates stand out from the crowd, Irwin Victoria being one of them. He impresses the judges with his soulful singing and moves on to the next round.

episodesList.title: The Talented Mr. Ragavan
episodesList.summary: The next batch enter the auditions, ready to showcase their talent and follow their dreams. Mr. Ragavan, a middle aged candidate, auditions with the hopes of achieving what he couldn't in his younger days. Will he move on to the next level or will his journey come to an end?

episodesList.title: Coimbatore Auditions
episodesList.summary: Super singer comes knocking to Coimbatore, with hundreds of hopefuls waiting to prove their mettle. Hosts Priyanka and Bhavana help the participants relax and keep them motivated and in high spirits. The super singer stars who judge the participants talk about their experiences.

episodesList.title: Bhairavi's Magic Tricks
episodesList.summary: Hosts Bhavana and Priyanka kick start the auditions of Super Singer 5. Bhairavi mesmerises the judges with her magic tricks. Ranjini, Athira, Ganesh, Murugan, and Roshini sing to impress the judges. Judges select the best out of the performers.

episodesList.title: Second Level Auditions
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, Sreeraj K Shajan, Dhanush, Sumeda, Sreerag perform to mesmerise the judges. Watch to know who makes it into the next level.

episodesList.title: Auditions Galore
episodesList.summary: The participants continue to showcase their performance in the One Minute Challenge, to impress Pop Shalini and SPB Charan. How many participants will get lucky?

episodesList.title: Coimbatore Auditions
episodesList.summary: Host Bhavana kick starts the final day of auditions in Coimbatore. Sreeram, Ramakrishna, Srivarsha, Vaisakh, Jyothi, Minija, Niranjana perform to impress the judges. Who comes out victorious?

episodesList.title: Chennai Auditions Begins
episodesList.summary: Host Bhavana kick starts the Chennai auditions with a bang. Hundreds of people try to impress the judges with their singing skills. Watch out to know who gets into the show.

episodesList.title: Chennai Auditions-2
episodesList.summary: Hosts Ma Ka Pa Anand and Priyanka start off this episode of Chennai auditions. Participants give their heart and soul to impress the judges. Watch out for some mesmerising performances.

episodesList.title: Chennai Auditions-3
episodesList.summary: Varalakshmi, Soundarya, Swati, Bhavani, Shayalima try to impress the judges in the Chennai auditions. Who comes out victorious?

episodesList.title: Mesmerising Performances
episodesList.summary: As the days go by, the competition is getting tough. Hundreds of people try to impress the judges. Watch out for some mesmerising performances.

episodesList.title: Impressing the Judges
episodesList.summary: The auditions continue. Host Ma Ka Pa Anand and Priyanka start the One Minute Challenge. The participants perform to impress the judges and move on to the next level. How many will succeed?

episodesList.title: Inter Zonal Competition
episodesList.summary: Host Ma Ka Pa Anand kick starts today's episode with a bang. Inter zonal competition starts off today, where the participants try to impress the judges. Who comes out victorious?

episodesList.title: Inter Zonal Competition-2
episodesList.summary: Today's episode features Sreenivasan, Kuruma, Aravind, Ramesh, Ramya at the inter zonal level. This episode is full of some enthralling performances.

episodesList.title: The Celebration of Music
episodesList.summary: Hosts Ma Ka Pa Anand and Priyanka kick start today's episode with a bang. While a few make it to the next level, few get rejected as well. Watch the full episode for some amazing performances.

episodesList.title: Inzamam Stuns the Judges
episodesList.summary: Hosts Ma Ka Pa Anand-Priyanka start the show with the inter zonal selections. Contestants showcase their performances to impress the judges, get selected and move on to the next round. Inzamam stuns the judges with his rap performance. Who will be the lucky ones?

episodesList.title: Who Will Be Selected?
episodesList.summary: Host Ma Pa Ka starts today's zonal auditions. Lakshmi, Priyanka, Pikash,Vishnu, and Arul are some of the singers who win the judges' appreciation. The best singers are selected by the judges in the audition.

episodesList.title: Top Thirty Selection Begins
episodesList.summary: Hosts Bavana and Priyanka kick start today's TopThirty selection. The judges Chitra, Manoj, and Shuba appreciate the performances of Latha, Arjun, Sreeraj and Lakshmi. Some of the contestants are kept in the waiting list by the judges.

episodesList.title: Race to the Top thirty
episodesList.summary: Shakti, Vikram, Sukesh,  are a few contestants who win accolades from the judges and some of the mediocre performers are kept in the waiting list. From this ocean of talent who will reach the top thirty?

episodesList.title: The Race to Top Thirty continues
episodesList.summary: Fareedha, Prashanth, Aswin, Visakhare are some of the performers who win the judges' heart with their extraordinary performances. A few of the performers, owing to their errors, are kept in the waiting list.

episodesList.title: Top 30 Selection Round
episodesList.summary: Host Priyanka starts off the show with the Top 30 selections along with judges Mano, Chithra and Subha. Contestants showcase their performances with a hope to secure a position amongst the top 30 participants.

episodesList.title: Top 30 Selection Results
episodesList.summary: Host Priyanka starts off the show with the continuation of the Top 30 selections along with judges Mano, Chithra and Subha. Contestants showcase their performance to secure a slot amongst the top 30 participants. The results are announced. From Top 30, it's Top 33. Who are the 'Top 33' contestants?

episodesList.title: Judges Given a Task
episodesList.summary: Hosts Priyanka and Bhavana start the show with the Top 33 contestants alongside judges Srinivas, Unnikrishnan and Mano. The judges are given the task of forming their teams by choosing ten contestants each, based on their performance.

episodesList.title: Judges Choose Their Team
episodesList.summary: Hosts Priyanka and Bhavana start the show with the Top 33 contestants alongside judges Srinivas, Unnikrishnan and Mano. The judges are given the task of forming their teams by choosing ten contestants each, based on their performance.

episodesList.title: Ten Singers Per Team
episodesList.summary: Hosts Priyanka and Bhavana start the show with the Top 33 contestants alongside judges Srinivas, Unnikrishnan and Mano. The judges are given the task of forming their teams by choosing ten contestants each, based on their performance.

episodesList.title: Performance-based Team Selected
episodesList.summary: Hosts Priyanka and Bhavana start the show with the Top 33 contestants alongside judges Srinivas, Unnikrishnan and Mano. The judges are given the task of forming their teams by choosing ten contestants each, based on their performance.

episodesList.title: Judges and Their Teams
episodesList.summary: Hosts Priyanka and Bhavana start the show with the Top 33 contestants alongside judges Srinivas, Unnikrishnan and Mano. The judges are given the task of forming their teams by choosing ten contestants each, based on their performance.

episodesList.title: The Battle Begins!
episodesList.summary: Hosts Ma Ka Pa Anand, Priyanka and Bhavana start the show with the Top 33 contestants alongside judges Srinivas, Unnikrishnan and Mano. Top 33 contestants commence the battle to secure their slot in the Top 30 with their performance.

episodesList.title: The Competition is Tough
episodesList.summary: Hosts Ma Ka Pa Anand, Bhavana and Priyanka start off today's episode with contestants Vignesh, Uthara, Nikitha Raj, Sukesh Kuttan, Arjun Adapalli, Shibi and Anand Aravindakshan. The contestants battle it out against each other. Who will come out victorious?

episodesList.title: Mesmerising Performances
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, contestants Kiran Sravan, Govind Prasad, Dhanusha Anil, Latha Krishna, Janaki M Nair, Bikash Sunar and Faridha compete among each other.

episodesList.title: The Celebration of Music
episodesList.summary: Contestants Aravind Mukundan, Lakshmi Pradeep, Shreya, Aravind K, Sreeraj K Shajan, Priya Jerson and Ragavan mesmerise the judges with their soothing songs. Who will get into the safe zone?

episodesList.title: Music to the Ears
episodesList.summary: This episode features contestants Kirthana, Vaisakh, Shivali, Irwin Victoria, Sherley Joy, Siyad. Who will come out victorious?

episodesList.title: A Musical Treat
episodesList.summary: Hosts Ma Ka Pa Anand and Priyanka start off today's episode with contestants Sreeraj K Sahajan, Kirthana, Shivali, Aravind Mukundan, Irwin Victoria and Siyad. The contestants battle it out against each other.

episodesList.title: One-on-One Round Begins
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, contestants Faridha, Bhargavi, Sowmya, Lakshmi Pradeep and Irwin Victoria compete among each other in the One-on-One round.

episodesList.title: Judges are Mesmerised
episodesList.summary: Contestants Aravind Mukundan, Janaki M Nair, Bikash Sunar, Sravani Kiran, Shibi, and Faridha mesmerise the judges with their soothing songs. Who will get into the safe zone?

episodesList.title: The Set Intro Round
episodesList.summary: This episode features contestants Anand Aravindakshan, Latha Krishna, Vidnesh, Nikitha, Sukesh and Rajaganapathy in the set intro round. Who will come out victorious?

episodesList.title: The First Competitive Round
episodesList.summary: The top 30 contestants are facing their first competitive round. Bhargavi, Nirujan, Sowmya, Arjun Adapalli, Hari and Devika from judge Unnikrishnan's team perform with the weakest performer facing elimination along with the weakest performers from the other teams.

episodesList.title: Tribute to MSV
episodesList.summary: This week has the contestants performing late maestro MSV's best songs in the Tribute to MSV round. Latha Krishna, Sowmya, Shibi, Anand Aravindakshan, Sreeraj and Raghavan give amazing performances as MSV's closest musicians and the judges share anecdotes about the music legend.

episodesList.title: The Tribute Continues
episodesList.summary: The tribute to MSV continues as Vignesh, Nirujan, Vaishak, Rajaganapathy and Aravind perform evergreen songs of the late legend. Contestants from previous seasons and MSV's own musicians perform and share their experiences with the legend, MSV.

episodesList.title: Singer L R Eswari on the Show
episodesList.summary: Singer L R Eswari graces the show as a special guest. She shares her memories of the legend MSV and performs a few of her favorite songs. Shivaali, Nikitha, Sukesh, Kirthana, Bhargavi and Govind sing beautifully as the Super Singer juniors perform a soulful medley as a special tribute performance.

episodesList.title: Vani Jayaram Talks about MSV
episodesList.summary: The episode starts off with an AV of A R Rahman reminiscing about the legend MSV. Special guest Vani Jayaram performs and shares her experiences of working with MSV as Kiran Shravan, Devika, Bikash, Priya Jerson and Siyad continue to give touching tributes to the maestro.

episodesList.title: MSV Week Comes to a Closure
episodesList.summary: The Super Singer juniors and Super Singer stars give splendid special performances as a tribute to maestro MSV. Aravind K, Faridha, Irwin Victoria, Hari, Lakshmi and Arjun Adapalli render some hit songs of MSV, with the weakest performer of the week facing elimination.

episodesList.title: Western Round Begins
episodesList.summary: Following the MSV tribute week, the western round kicks off with Aravind, Latha Krishna, Shibi, Kiran Shravan, Anand Aravindakshan and Prasad Govind from judge Mano's team delivering stellar performances, motivated by the threat of the impending multiple eliminations by the end of the week.

episodesList.title: Team Srinivas Performs Well
episodesList.summary: Team Mano's Faridha, Bikash and Lakshmi give their performances. The weakest performer of the team is placed in the waiting zone with a chance of elimination. Raghavan, Vaisakh and Sherley from judge Srinivas' team perform amazingly as the western round blazes on.

episodesList.title: Battle for the Safe Zone
episodesList.summary: Special guests, actress Radha and Kalyan Master grace the show as Aravind K, Shivali, Kirthana, Irwin Victoria, Siyad and Priya Jerson from judge Srinivas' team rock the stage with stellar performances, each trying to outdo the other in this battle for the safe zone.

episodesList.title: Rajaganapathy is Amazing
episodesList.summary: The western round rolls on with Sreeraj completing Team Srinivas' performances. The weakest performer from the team is chosen. Team Unnikrishnan follows with performances by Hari, Devika, Sowmya, Nirujan and finally Rajaganapathy, who shines out with an amazing rendition of "Nangaai".

episodesList.title: Double Elimination
episodesList.summary: The western round finally reaches its climax with Vignesh, Arjun Adapalli, Bhargavi, Sukesh and Nikitha from Team Unnikrishnan performing. The weakest performers from the three teams are assembled and two of them face elimination. Who will leave the competition?

episodesList.title: Latest Hits Round
episodesList.summary: This week follows with the contestants performing the latest hit songs. In a boys vs. girls style challenge, Team Unnikrishnan starts the game with Sowmya, Vignesh, Arjun Adapalli,  Nikitha and Rajaganapathy performing foot-tapping numbers, making for a very lively show.

episodesList.title: Team Srinivas Performs
episodesList.summary: The latest hits round continues as Team Unnikrishnan's Hari, Nirujan, Devika and Bhargavi perform.The weakest contestant enters the danger zone, facing the possibility of elimination. Following Team Unnikrishnan, Vaisakh begins the score for Team Srinivas.

episodesList.title: Competition Heats Up
episodesList.summary: Aravind K kicks off the show with a breezy rendition of "Azhaipaaya" as Team Srinivas continues to perform in the latest hits round. Shivali, Priya Jerson, Ragavan, Irwin Victoria and Siyad sing their hearts out as the competition heats up.

episodesList.title: Enter Team Mano
episodesList.summary: Sherley and Sreeraj give the last performances for Team Srinivas, with the weakest performer moving into the danger zone. Finally, Team Mano steps up with Govind, Anand Aravindakshan and Faridha performing their renditions of latest hits.

episodesList.title: Facing Elimination
episodesList.summary: The latest hits round finally comes to an end with Lakshmi, Shibi, Kiran Sravan, Arvind and Latha Krishna from Team Mano performing. The weakest performers from all three teams are assembled and one faces elimination. Who will it be?

episodesList.title: Dance Attack Round
episodesList.summary: The top 26 contestants enter the dance attack round, with singer Usha Uthup entering as a new judge. Contestants Aravind K, Sherley, Siyad, Irwin Victoria and Priya Jerson perform foot-tapping numbers as the renditions live up to the round's name.

episodesList.title: Govind Rocks the Show
episodesList.summary: The dance attack round continues as Sreeraj, Raghavan, Vaisakh and Shivali from Team Srinivas perform with the weakest performer placed in the danger zone. Team Usha Uthup takes the mantle with Lakshmi and Govind rocking the stage with impressive performances.

episodesList.title: Anand Steals the Thunder
episodesList.summary: Anand Aravindakshan steals the show in today's dance attack round with a brilliant rendition of "Potu thaaku", making the crowd dance in merriment. He is followed by Shibi, Latha Krishna, Faridha and Arvind who give their best, aiming to impress the judges and make it to the safe zone.

episodesList.title: Team Usha Uthup Takes Charge
episodesList.summary: Kiran Shravan gives the last performance for Team Usha Uthup in the dance attack round and the weakest performer of the team is selected. Team Unnikrishnan follows with an amazing performance by Rajaganapathy. Sukesh Kuttan, Hari and Vignesh continue with some inspiring performances.

episodesList.title: The Top 25 are Chosen
episodesList.summary: The dance attack round reaches a climax with Bhargavi, Nikitha, Arjun Adapalli, Sowmya and Nirujan finishing the score for Team Unnikrishnan. The weakest performer from the three teams are chosen, with one of them facing elimination. Who will move on to the top 25 position?

episodesList.title: Hip Hop, Disco Special
episodesList.summary: Ma Pa Ka Anand and Bhavana kick-start today's Hip hop, remix and disco round. Arvind, Lakshmi, Kiran, Anand and Govind croon disco songs.

episodesList.title: Hip Hop Fun Round Continues
episodesList.summary: In today's round two of Hip hop and Disco, Faridha, Shibhi, Latha and Nirujan sing some popular songs. Later, actors from the show Sarvanan and Meenakshi take the center stage to sing and entertain the audience.

episodesList.title: More of Hip Hop
episodesList.summary: In today's show, Sowmya, Bhargavi, Arjun, Vignesh and Nikitha sing some popular numbers. Later, the actors from the serial Pudhu Kavithai take center stage and entertain everybody.

episodesList.title: Some Brilliant Performances
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, Hari, Siyad, Rajaganapathy and Sreeraj set the stage on fire with their brilliant performances. Later, the actors from the serial Kalyanam Mudhal Kaadal Vara entertain everybody.

episodesList.title: Who Will Be Eliminated?
episodesList.summary: Shivali, Irwin, Aravind, Vaisakh and Priya sing some popular Hip hop numbers. One of the contestants, who is in the danger zone, will get eliminated.

episodesList.title: It's Duet Time
episodesList.summary: Ma Pa Ka Ravi and Priyanka kick-start today's round of Duet with Super Singer Stars. The participants of Super Singer Four croon romantic duets with the Super Singer Five contestants. Aravind-Anu, Vaisakh-Srinisha, Siyad-Priyanka and Raghavan-Usha sing some romantic duets.

episodesList.title: Romantic Duets Continue
episodesList.summary: The Super Singer Duet round continues. The Super Singer Four participants join Super Singer Five contestants in singing duets. Irwin-Sayad, Sreeraj-Rakshitha, Priya-Kaushik and Govind-Pooja render some romantic songs.

episodesList.title: Duets Galore
episodesList.summary: The Super Singer Duet round continues. The Super Singer Four participants join Super Singer Five contestants in singing duets. Faridha-Satya, Lakshmi-Sai, Arvind-Malika, Latha-Nivas and Kiran-Arvind give extraordinary performances, thus impressing the judges.

episodesList.title: Duet with the Stars Round
episodesList.summary: Hosts Ma Ka Pa Anand and Bhavana start off the show with Duet with SS Stars round. Anand Aravindakshan-SS Star Pooja, Rajaganapathy-SS Star Shravan, Nikitha-SS Star Sathyaprakash, Arjun Adapalli-SS Star Parvathy and Bhargavi-SS Star Sai Charan showcase their performances.

episodesList.title: It's Elimination Time
episodesList.summary: Hosts Ma Ka Pa Anand and Bhavana start off the show with Duet with SS Stars round. Hari-SS Star Haripriya, Nirujan-SS Star Sreesha, Sowmya-SS Star Santhosh and Vignesh-SS Star Deepthi battle it out against each other. Vignesh, Raghavan and Kiran Shravan face elimination.

episodesList.title: Top 20 Selection – Trio Challenge
episodesList.summary: Hosts Ma Ka Pa Anand and Bhavana start the show with Top 20 Selection, Trio Challenge between Judge Unni Krinshnan vs. Usha Uthup vs. Srinivas' team. The first trio challenge is between Hari, Faridha and Vaishak. In the second trio challenge, it is a clash between Govind, Erwin and Nirujan.

episodesList.title: Intense Trio Challenge
episodesList.summary: Hosts Ma Ka Pa Anand and Bhavana start the show with the continuation of the Top 20 Selection, Trio Challenge. Govind sums up the second trio challenge with his performance. Nikitha, Priya and Latha leave the judges awestruck with their performances in the third trio challenge round.

episodesList.title: The Judges Are Spellbound
episodesList.summary: Top 20 Selection, Trio Challenge continues. Aravind, Sri Raj and Rajaganapathy's performance in the fourth trio challenge leaves the judges spellbound and each win their spot in the top 20 slot. Shivali, Bhargavi and Kiran battle it out against each other in the fifth trio challenge.

episodesList.title: Siyad Impresses All
episodesList.summary: Hosts Ma Ka Pa Anand and Bhavana start the show with the continuation of the Top 20 Selection, Trio Challenge. Kiran sums up the fifth trio challenge with her performance. Lakshmi, Siyad and Sowmya battle it out in the sixth trio challenge round. Siyad's performance leaves the judges overwhelmed.

episodesList.title: 90 Seconds To Impress
episodesList.summary: Top 20 Selection, Trio Challenge continues. The last trio challenge round has Aravind, Anand Aravindakshan and Arjun battling against each other to secure a spot in the top 20. The six contestants in the danger zone are given 90 seconds to seal their spot in the five slots vacant in the top 20.

episodesList.title: Folk Round Special
episodesList.summary: Hosts Ma Ka Pa Anand and Priyanka start off the Folk round with contestants Shivali K Aroraa, Aravind Mukundan, Arjun Adapalli, Sreeraj K Sahajan, and Sowmya. The contestants battle it out against each other.

episodesList.title: Mesmerising Performances
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, contestants Aravind K, Govind Prasad, Lakshmi Pradeep, Priya Jerson and Nirujan compete among each other in the folk round. Watch out for some mesmerising performances.

episodesList.title: The Celebration of Music
episodesList.summary: Contestants Faridha, Hari, Sravani Kiran, Siyad, and Irwin Victoria mesmerise the judges with their performances in the folk round. Who will get into the safe zone?

episodesList.title: Vaisakh and Shivali Bid Adieu
episodesList.summary: This episode features contestants Bhargavi, Anand Aravindakshan, Rajaganapathy, Vaisakh, and Latha Krishna in the folk round. Who will come out victorious?

episodesList.title: One-on-One Challenge
episodesList.summary: Hosts Ma Ka Pa Anand and Priyanka start the One-on-One round with contestants Aravind Mukundan, Nirujan, Priya Jesron and Anand Aravindakshan. They battle it out against each other. Who will come out victorious?

episodesList.title: A Music Treat
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, contestants Faridha, Bhargavi, Sowmya, Lakshmi Pradeep and Irwin Victoria compete with each other in the One-on-One round. Watch out for some mesmerising performances.

episodesList.title: One-on-One Challenge
episodesList.summary: The One-on-One challenge continues with Latha performing against Irwin. Rajaganapathy faces Siyad and Govind is opposite Aravind K in this tense competition, with the victorious one entering the safe zone and the weaker performers moving to the danger zone.

episodesList.title: Battle for the Safe Zone
episodesList.summary: Kiran Sravan faces Hari in the first One-on One challenge of the day, followed by two remaining contestants, Sreeraj and Arjun Adapalli battling it out for a spot in the safe zone.

episodesList.title: Threat of Facing Elimination
episodesList.summary: With the judges saving three of the seven danger zone contestants, the remaining four must fight each other in the Lifeline round to secure a spot in the safe zone. The singers give their best, motivated by the threat of elimination looming over their heads.

episodesList.title: Dedication Round
episodesList.summary: The dedication round starts with a performance by Aravind K who dedicates a song to his mother, thus moving everyone to tears. This is followed by equally touching performances by Lakshmi, Kiran Sravan and Hari. Host Bhavana surprises everyone with a special performance dedicated to her husband.

episodesList.title: Moving Dedications for Loved Ones
episodesList.summary: The touching dedication songs continue as Aravind, Sreeraj and Priya Jerson give soothing performances for their loved ones. Super Singer veteran, Jessica gives a special performance, with judge Srinivas rendering a beautiful composition penned by guest Madhan Karky, dedicated to music legend MSV.

episodesList.title: Uthara Unnikrishnan Performs
episodesList.summary: The dedication round continues with soulful performances by Bhargavi, Anand Aravindakshan and Arjun Adapalli. Super Singer Junior Anu relives her own dedication round and the events that occurred in the previous season. Judge Unnikrishnan's daughter, Uthara, delivers a beautiful special performance.

episodesList.title: Ma Ka Pa Anand Sings for Susan
episodesList.summary: Host Ma Ka Pa Anand dedicates a special song for his wife Susan, who sings a short but soulful number for her husband. Nirujan, Siyad and Faridha give touching performances, making everyone emotional. Judge Mano gives a special dedication performance for his wife and daughter.

episodesList.title: Irwin's Heartfelt Performance
episodesList.summary: The dedication round continues with scintillating performances from Rajaganapathy, Sowmya and Latha Krishna. Judge Usha Uthup gives a beautiful rendition of "Meri Maa" and gets the contestants to sing along. Irwin surprises everyone by singing for his parents and presenting them with a touching gift.

episodesList.title: Top 15 Lifeline Round
episodesList.summary: Phase 1 of the top 15 selections gets underway with lifeline performances by the bottom five contestants from last week: Aravind, Kiran Shravan, Hari, Sreeraj and Bhargavi. The two weakest performers face each other in a tie-breaker round while the loser faces immediate elimination.

episodesList.title: Stephen Devassy Returns
episodesList.summary: Stephen Devassy returns to perform with a world class orchestra, guaranteeing a musical treat. Phase 2 of the top 15 selections kicks off with performances by Latha Krishna, Rajaganapathy, Sowmya and Lakshmi. The singer with the least marks enters the danger zone and will possibly face elimination.

episodesList.title: Magical Performances
episodesList.summary: Day 2 of the top 15 selections, phase 2 sets the ball rolling with brilliant performances by Nirujan, Priya Jerson, Aravind K and Anand Aravindakshan. Stephen Devassy and the orchestra enthrall the crowd with their magical scores. The contestant with the least marks enters the danger zone.

episodesList.title: Judge Usha Uthup Performs
episodesList.summary: The top 15 selections continue as Aravind, Sreeraj, Faridha and Irwin Victoria fight it out to evade the danger zone and move on to the next round. As an added bonus, the contestants perform improvised renditions with Stephen and the brass band orchestra, with Judge Usha Uthup joining in.

episodesList.title: Voting against Elimination
episodesList.summary: Hari, Kiran Shravan, Siyad and Arjun Adapalli battle it out to secure a spot in the top 15. The four weakest performers from phase 2 are made to go through an audience and musician voting, with three making it to the safe zone. The weakest contender faces elimination.

episodesList.title: The Battle of the Best
episodesList.summary: The top 15 singers start the show with three judges pitting their best singers against each other. The round is an Imman song special with music director Imman being the special guest. Lakshmi, Sowmya and Sreeraj sing in the first round with the next batch featuring Arjun Adapalli, Anand and Siyad.

episodesList.title: A Grandfather's Love
episodesList.summary: The Imman special round continues as Siyad performs. Challenge 4 has Aravind K, Latha Krishnan and Hari singing, with the next round featuring Nirujan, Kiran Shravan and Priya Jerson. Nirujan delivers a splendid performance followed by a touching AV of him visiting his grandfather in Colombo.

episodesList.title: Trio Challenge Gets Tough
episodesList.summary: Host Ma Ka Pa Anand and Bhavana start the show with the fourth trio challenge between Kiran vs. Priya vs. Nirujan on Imman's composition as the theme for the round. In the fifth trio challenge, Irwin battles it out with Faridha and Rajaganapathy.

episodesList.title: 21st Century Songs Round
episodesList.summary: Host Ma Ka Pa Anand and Bhavana start the show with lifeline performances for the nine contestants to secure their position in the top 14. Anand Aravindakshan, Arjun Adapalli, Aravind and Lakshmi Pradeep battle it out against each other in 21st century songs round.

episodesList.title: Hit Songs of 2015
episodesList.summary: Host Ma Ka Pa Anand and Bhavana start off the 21st century songs round with Ananth Vaidyanathan. Contestants Irwin Victoria, Sreeraj K Sahajan, J Nirujan, Latha Krishna and Priya Jerson battle it out with each other. Watch out for some amazing performances.

episodesList.title: Sujatha, Deva on the Show
episodesList.summary: Host Ma Ka Pa Anand and Bhavana welcome singers Sujatha and Deva to the show. Contestants Kiran Sravan, J Nirujan, Arjun Adaplli, Sowmya, and Lakshmi Pradeep compete amongst each other.

episodesList.title: The Top 13 Finalists
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, contestants Priya Jesron, Faridha, Rajganpathy, Hari and Irwin Victoria compete among each other. Watch the full episode to find out who makes it into top 13 and who falls into the danger zone.

episodesList.title: Some Mesmerising Performances
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, contestants Anand Aravindakshan, Sreeraj K Sahajan, Latha Krishna and Siyad compete against each other to get into the top 13 slot. Watch out for some mesmerising performances.

episodesList.title: Veteran Singer P Susheela Visits
episodesList.summary: Host Ma Ka Pa Anand and Priyanka welcome veteran singer P Susheela to the show. Contestants Rajaganapathy, Anand Aravindakshan, Priya Jesron, Kiran Sravan and Irwin Victoria battle it out amongst themselves. Watch out for some wonderful performances.

episodesList.title: P Suseela's Hit Songs
episodesList.summary: The P Susheela hits round continues with performances by Hari, Lakshmi, Nirujan, Latha Krishna, Siyad and Sowmya. With Anand Aravindakshan, Kiran Shravan and Irwin Victoria in the waiting zone, it remains to be seen who will replace them and who will move to the safe zone?

episodesList.title: L R Eswari Special Round
episodesList.summary: Faridha and Arjun Adapalli finish the P Suseela round with a bang as Kiran Sravan faces Sreeraj in the one minute elimination round with the loser facing elimination. The L R Eswari special round starts with brilliant performances by Anand Aravindakshan and Priya Jerson.

episodesList.title: L R Eswari Special Round - 2
episodesList.summary: The L R Eswari special round continues. Erwin starts the show with his performance, followed by Siyad, Nirujan, Faridha, Hari and Arjun Adapalli's amazing performances.

episodesList.title: It's Elimination Time
episodesList.summary: In today's round two of Eshwari songs special, Sowmya, Latha Krishna, Rajaganapathy and Lakshmi participate. This also happens to be an elimination round.

episodesList.title: Top 10 Selection Begins
episodesList.summary: Ma Pa Ka Anand and Bhavana kick-start the top ten selection round. In this episode, Hari, Lakshmi, Nirujan and Siyad give amazing performances.

episodesList.title: Awaiting the Winner
episodesList.summary: Contestants Irwin Victoria, Sowmya, Sreeraj K Shajan, Arjun Adaplli and Anand Aravindakshan give their best performances in today's episode. Who will come out victorious?

episodesList.title: Enthralling Performances
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, contestants Rajaganapathy, Faridha, Priya Jerson, Sowmya and J Nirujan compete among each other. Watch out for some mesmerising performances.

episodesList.title: Who Will Make It into Top 10?
episodesList.summary: Hosts Ma Ka Pa Anand and Bhavana welcome the audience to today's episode. Contestants Faridha, Siyad, Irwin Victoria, Priya Jerson, and Arjun Adapalli battle it out amongst each other.

episodesList.title: S P Balasubramanyam Special
episodesList.summary: Host Ma Ka Pa Anand and Priyanka start the show with the top 10 singers singing S P Balasubramanyam songs. Rajaganapathy, Lakshmi Pradeep, Sri Raj and Hari battle it out to secure a slot as the second contestant in the top 10. Who will emerge victorious?

episodesList.title: Hari is Back on the Stage
episodesList.summary: Host Ma Ka Pa Anand, Priya, Bhavani Shankar start the show with a Devotional and Classical round. Sowmya, Nirujan and Priya Jerson showcase their performances while Hari arrives, after his marriage along with his bride, to perform and secure a slot as the third contestant in the top 10.

episodesList.title: Fight for the Fourth Position
episodesList.summary: Host Ma Ka Pa Anand and Priya Bhavani Shankar start the show with the Devotional and Classical round. Faridha, Arjun Adapalli, Siyad, Erwin and Rajaganapathy battle it out against each other with their performance to secure a slot as the fourth contestant in the top 10.

episodesList.title: Classical Round
episodesList.summary: Ma Ka Pa Anand and Priya host the Classical Round with enthralling performances by Irwin Victoria, Arjun Adapalli, Priya Jerson and Sowmya with a special performance by Top 10 finalist Lakshmi. Who will be selected to the Super seat and move on to the Top 10?

episodesList.title: Entering the Danger zone
episodesList.summary: The performances from Niirujan, Faridha and Siyad continue. Top 10 finalist Rajaganapathy gives a special performance. The 5th finalist is selected, but three singers enter the danger zone. Who will remain and who will be eliminated?

episodesList.title: One on One Challenge Round
episodesList.summary: Singers Mano, Malgudi Subha and Chithra return as the new panel of judges for the show. The last leg of the Top 10 finalists selection, the One on One challenge week, kicks off with Siyad Vs. Arjun Adapalli and Irwin Victoria challenging Sowmya. Top 10 finalist Hari delivers a Special performance.

episodesList.title: Faridha's Special Performance
episodesList.summary: The One on One Challenge Week continues with Priya Jerson Vs. Niirujan and Siyad Vs. Sowmya, each giving their best to impress the judges and secure a spot in the finals. Top 10 finalist Faridha delivers a scintillating special performance.

episodesList.title: Anand's Awesome Performance
episodesList.summary: Anand Aravindakshan gives a soothing performance as the One on One Challenge Week competition heats up between Priya and Arjun Adapalli, followed by a faceoff between Irwin Victoria and Nirujan.

episodesList.title: Super Singer Veteran Ravi Visits
episodesList.summary: Contestant Hari's brother and Super Singer veteran Ravi returns to the Super Singer stage to deliver a brilliant performance. The One on One challenge continues with Priya vs. Sowmya and Siyad vs. Nirujan. Rajaganapathi gives a beautiful and out of the box rendition of Yenai Matrum Kaadhale.

episodesList.title: The Top 10 Finalists
episodesList.summary: The One on One challenge finally comes to an end with Siyad vs. Niirujan, Irwin Victoria vs. Arjun Adapalli and a special performance by Top 10 finalist, Lakshmi. Names of the top 10 finalists are announced and they move on to battle it out for the final goal.

episodesList.title: Top 10 Celebrations!
episodesList.summary: The Top 10 celebrations kick-starts with a massive Senior Vs. Junior clash with 48 Super Singer contestants. Sarath Santhosh and Madhumitha face Akhilesh and Anjana, with Faridha and Nirujan competing with Siyad and Priya Jerson. Shenbagaraj and Soundarya deliver their performance against Irwin and Gautham.

episodesList.title: It's a Tough Competition
episodesList.summary: The competition continues as Irwin and Gautham wind up the folk round. The western round commences with Srisha and Yazhini vs. Anand and Syed, followed by Jayanth and Srinisha vs. Santhosh and Pravin, with every performance better than the last.

episodesList.title: Mullai, Godhandam on the Stage
episodesList.summary: Aravind and Niranjana face Aajith and Rakshitha in the Western round. The melody round begins with Anushya and Santhosh Balaji vs. Arjun Adapalli and Dhanyashree. Kalakka Povadhu Yaaru's Mullai and Godhandam's antics have everyone in splits. Nikhil Mathew and Kaushik deliver a brilliant performance.

episodesList.title: Who Will Win?
episodesList.summary: In today's Melody round, from the junior's team, Lakshmi and Anil compete with Sai and Pooja from the senior's team. Later, in the Classical round, Spurthi and Haripriya compete with Satya and Krishna.

episodesList.title: Juniors Vs Seniors
episodesList.summary: In today's Classical round, Nivas and Hari battle it out with Barath and Srikanth. Later, on the show Shravan and Raja Ganapathy compete with Deepti and Narayanan.

episodesList.title: Chennai, We Love You
episodesList.summary: Ma Ka Pa Anand and Priyanka kick-start today's Tamil Nadu special round. Arjun, Siyad and Arvind sing some happy songs dedicated to Chennai.

episodesList.title: Jolly Songs Round
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, the contestants continue with the jolly songs. Hari, Faridha, Anand, Priya and Raja Ganapathy entrain everyone with their performance.

episodesList.title: Folk Songs Special
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, Nirujan croons a melodious song. Later, Ma Ka Pa Anand and Priyanka kick-start the Folk round. Lakshmi, Hari and Arjun sing folk songs.

episodesList.title: Folk Songs Round- 2
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, Anand, Faridha, Irwin and Siyad sing folk songs and mesmerize the audience with their performance.

episodesList.title: It's Elimination Time
episodesList.summary: It's elimination round today. Priya, Rajaganapathy, Nirujan and Hari sing folk songs. Who will be eliminated in this episode?

episodesList.title: Dedicated to Chennai
episodesList.summary: Host Ma Ka Pa Anand and Priyanka start the Tamil Nadu round - Chennai dedication with Gana Bala on the show. Contestants Arjun Adapalli, Siyad, Lakshmi Pradeep, Irwin Victoria and Hari battle it out among themselves. Watch out for some amazing performances.

episodesList.title: Gana Bala on the Show
episodesList.summary: Host Ma Ka Pa Anand and Priyanka start the Tamil Nadu round - Chennai dedication with singer Gana Bala. Contestants Anand Aravindakshan, Faridha, Priya Jerson, Rjaganapathy and J Nirujan give superb performances to stay in the competition.

episodesList.title: Manikka Vinayagam Visits
episodesList.summary: Host Ma Ka Pa Anand and Priyanka start the Tamil Nadu - Folk round with singer Manikka Vinayagam on the show. Contestants Lakshmi Pradeep, Hari, Arjun Adapalli, Anand Aravindakshan, Irwin Victoria and Siyad showcase their talent.

episodesList.title: Tamil Nadu - Folk Round
episodesList.summary: Host Ma Ka Pa Anand and Priyanka start the Tamil Nadu - Folk round with singer Manikka Vinayagam on the show. Contestants Priya Jerson, Faridha, Rajaganapathy and J Nirujan fight it out among themselves. Who will come out victorious?

episodesList.title: The Exciting Tamil Nadu Round
episodesList.summary: Host Ma Ka Pa Anand and Priyanka start off the Tamil Nadu round with singer Gana Bala on the show. Contestants Irwin Victoria, Anand Aravindakshan, Lakshmi Pradeep, Faridha, Rajaganapathy and J Niirujan battle amongst each other. Watch out for some amazing performances.

episodesList.title: Dilwale Team on the Show
episodesList.summary: Host Ma Ka Pa Anand, Bhavana and Priyanka start off a special episode of Super Singer 5 with superstars Shah Rukh Khan and Kajol on the sets. Contestants mesmerise the guests with their amazing performances.

episodesList.title: Shah Rukh Khan, Kajol on the Show
episodesList.summary: Host Ma Ka Pa Anand, Bhavana and Priyanka kick-start today's superstar special episode with Shah Rukh Khan and Kajol on the sets. The contestants entertain the guests with their mesmerising performances. The guests and judges have a fun-filled time together.

episodesList.title: Super Singers in Mumbai
episodesList.summary: Host Ma Ka Pa Anand, Bhavana and Priyanka kick-start today's superstar special episode with Shah Rukh Khan and Kajol on the sets. The contestants entertain the guests with their mesmerising performances. The guests and judges have a fun-filled time together.

episodesList.title: Superstar Rajinikanth Special
episodesList.summary: In today's Superstar Rajinikanth Special episode, Nirujan, Priya Jerson, Hari and Siyad sing some of his hit songs, while sharing their experiences during the November rains. Anand Aravindakshan gives an outstanding performance, rocking the audience and judges alike with his charismatic rendition.

episodesList.title: Rajinikanth Special Round
episodesList.summary: Host Ma Ka Pa Anand and Priyanka start off today's superstar Rajinikanth special episode. Contestants Faridha, Arjun Adapalli, Lakshmi Pradeep and Rajaganapathy battle among each other. Who will come out victorious?

episodesList.title: A Tribute to the Victims
episodesList.summary: Host Ma Ka Pa Anand and Bhavana start off today's episode with a tribute to all the heroes who dedicated their lives for Chennai flood relief. Contestants Rajaganapathy, Arjun Adapalli, Faridha and Anand Aravindakshan compete among each other.

episodesList.title: Competition Gets Tougher
episodesList.summary: Host Ma Ka Pa Anand and Bhavana start off today's special episode. Contestants Siyad, J Niirujan, Lakshmi Pradeep, Priya Jerson, and Faridha compete among each other. Watch out for some mesmerising performances.

episodesList.title: Honouring the Heroes
episodesList.summary: Host Ma Ka Pa Anand and Bhavana start off today's episode honouring the heroes of Chennai flood relief. Contestants Arjun Adapalli, Rajaganapathy, Siyad, Lakshmi Pradeep, and Anand Aravindakshan compete among each other.

episodesList.title: MGR Special Round
episodesList.summary: Host Ma Ka Pa Anand and Bhavana start off the show with the evergreen songs of actor MGR as the theme for the top eight Super Singer 5 contestants. Priya Jerson, J Niirujan, Anand Aravindakshan, Arjun Adapalli, Lakshmi Pradeep and Rajaganapathy give some mesmerising performances.

episodesList.title: Dazzling Performances
episodesList.summary: Host Ma Ka Pa Anand and Bhavana start off the show with the continuation of the actor MGR evergreen songs theme. J Niirujan's performance followed by Priya Jerson, Siyad and Faridha showcase their talent to secure their position within the top seven contestants. Who will get eliminated?

episodesList.title: Seven Contestants Battle it Out
episodesList.summary: Host Ma Ka Pa Anand and Bhavana start off the show alongside Tamil poet-lyricist Vairamuthu and the top Super Singer 5 contestants. Priya Jerson, J Niirujan, Arjun Adapalli, Faridha, Siyad and Rajaganapathy battle against each other with their amazing performances.

episodesList.title: Lyricist Vairamuthu Special
episodesList.summary: Host Ma Ka Pa Anand and Bhavana start off the show alongside Tamil poet-lyricist Vairamuthu and the top seven Super Singer 5 contestants. Anand Aravindakshan and Lakshmi Pradeep showcase their powerful solo performance followed by duet performances on lyricist Vairamuthu's songs.

episodesList.title: Judges Enjoy Some Amazing Singing

title: Star Singer
summary: Star Singer is an Indian music reality television competition broadcast on Asianet. The show features contestants aged 15 to 35, who compete based on their singing talent and stage presence. From Seasons 1 to 7, viewer voting was conducted via SMS, with audience votes contributing partially to contestant advancement. Starting with Season 8, voting shifted to Disney+ Hotstar, the official OTT platform of Star Network. The competition includes a panel of judges comprising prominent figures from the Malayalam music industry, who evaluate performances and assign scores throughout the contest. In 2009, a spin-off titled Star Singer Junior was introduced, focusing on younger participants.

articleSections.text: Season 6 concluded on 22 December 2012, with Merin Gregory declared the winner. Rajiv Rajasekharan was the runner-up. Judges included Hariharan, K. S. Chithra, M. G. Sreekumar, Anuradha Sriram, and M. Jayachandran. The show was produced by Asianet and directed by Prathap Nair.

The eighth season was launched on 27 December 2020.The show was hosted by Jewel Mary. The launch event was telecasted on 3 January 2021. Due to the COVID-19 Pandemic, the show was put on hold after 43 episodes in July 2021 and relaunched with a mega event on 2 January 2022.The show ended on 19 June 2022 and the title winner is Ridhu Krishna. He won a flat worth Rupees 1 crore from Confident Group run by Dr. C. J. Roy.

Star Singer Season 9 premiered on 15 and 16 July 2023 and aired on Asianet every weekend. Judged by K. S. Chithra, Sithara, and Vidhu Prathap, and hosted by RJ Varsha, the contestants were initially split into two teams – Convent Music School and Gurukulam Sangeetha Vidyalayam. Though the finale was planned for February 2024, the show was extended after a break following Bigg Boss Malayalam Season 6. The planned finale was held as a 'Summer Festival' (aired on 11 and 17 February 2024), with the Rs 5 lakh prize money shared among the top 10 contestants.
The show was relaunched with a mega event on June 23, 2024, introducing two new wild card contestants alongside the existing top 10. The grand finale was held on October 20, 2024, at Adlux Convention Centre, Angamaly. Aravind Dileep Nair emerged as the winner, receiving a prize of ₹50 lakhs sponsored by Confident Group.

articleSections.title: 2025-present
articleSections.text: Season 10 was announced during the Season 9 finale, making Star Singer the first Malayalam reality show to reach 10 seasons. Auditions concluded in Kochi on 2 February 2025, and the show launched on 29–30 March. From 35 mega audition participants, 18 were selected for the main stage, with 4 more joining as wild card entrants later. From July 2025, the show was on a temporary break for Bigg Boss Malayalam Season 7, with a special Monsoon Festival episode featuring Mohanlal and Usha Uthup aired on 27 July 2025. The show relaunched after break with an event with special guests Urvashi and Nikhila Vimal aired on 23 November 2025. This season was hosted by Varsha Ramesh and Midhun Ramesh.The grand finale is scheduled to be held on 30 August 2026.

articleSections.title: SMS
articleSections.text:
Asianet has not made clear how the SMS votes are attributed before and after on each contestants reaching the 'danger zone' leading to their elimination. It is alleged that the SMS votes received are not added to decide the ranking of the contestants. The number or the percentage of SMS votes received by each contestants are kept private from the viewers of the show. Since the channel has its reach over 60 countries including the Indian sub-continent, Sri Lanka, China, South East Asia, Middle East, Europe, United States, Singapore and the lower half of the former Soviet Union at various time zones, the SMS voting end-time was initially not announced. Asianet later clarified after the eighth stage that SMS voting deadlines are based on Indian Time.
According to Asianet sources, for the Grand Finale, weightage of SMS was just 5% of overall score with judges' score attributing the rest 95%.

articleSections.title: Prizes
articleSections.text: There are criticism from various corners saying that many of the winners didn't actually opt to receive the prizes because of the huge tax they had to pay for receiving the villa. That means the channel's advertisement of getting a villa through their sponsor is questioned. This got more visible in the case of ISS season 4 winner Joby John

title: Stree Teri Kahani
summary: Stree Teri Kahani (transl. The Story of a Woman) was a show on DD National with a total of 743 episodes. It starred Ravi Dubey, Namrata Thapa, Meher Vij, Nikhhil Raj Khera, Snigdha Pandey and Sonica Handa. It was produced by Saira Banu, directed by Suneel Prasad and written by Shaheen. It was broadcast from 12:30-1:00 pm, Monday through Friday. The show launched on 21 August 2006, ran continuously for four years and ended in 2009. Due to high viewership (TRPS) and positive response, DD National made a repeated telecast at 2010 which ran until 14 November 2013. The series ran from 2006 to 2009.
plot:
The story of Stree Teri Kahaani revolves around four girls who are very close to each other. These four girls have gone to the same college and, come from the same batch. Now all four of them have finished their college and, strive towards fulfilling their dreams. The protagonist of the story is Radha. The name of the serial has been kept after the stories of these four women. The names of the four friends are Radha, Sanjana, Ritu and, Rubina. Radha is a mature girl who has her own likes and dislikes; she has a stubborn father too.
Sanjana is a chirpy, funny and relatable girl who lives her life to the fullest and has beautiful flaws. Ritu is a nice, mature, chirpy and understanding. She lives alone in Mumbai. Rubina whereas is a girl who lives out of Mumbai and wants to accomplish her dreams. She also inspires her friends to fulfill their dreams. The story is about these four girls and their precious friendship. The story of the serial includes Radha who is in love with a guy named Karan. Her father doesn’t support their relationship which is why she has to leave her home after which she marries Karan. But her father plans and plots something against them. He plans Karan’s murder and, succeeds in the same.
After this he has Radha marry his business friend's son Ajay, who is a good man, but Radha is unable to forget her first love. Ritu is in love with Karan, who lives outside Mumbai. Sanjana marries Vishal. Vishal marries Sanjana only for his good and he tortures her, beats her, put blame on her and, completely lock her. However, one day she manages to run where she meets another guy who helps her get her divorce and, cares for her. Radha moves on and things start to get better with Ajay where Karan returns and it is being shown that he has been saved. Karan starts to create problems in Ajay’s and Radha’s life and story has further twists.
Meanwhile Devyani who works in Ajay’s office and Anu who is a relative of Ajay create problems in their lives. The show was all about the moments of happiness, sadness, struggles and love in a woman’s life. Above all the show celebrates the beauty of girl’s friendship. It also showed how women’s lives change after marriage and the effects on their friendship. The show was truly one of a kind. The audience enjoyed the show.

title: Surviving Disaster
summary:
Surviving Disaster is a 2006 BBC, Discovery Channel, and ProSieben co-production documentary-drama series about disasters in the 20th century, starring people who survived them. It was produced in association with France 5.
It is narrated by Bernard Hill.

episodesList.title: Munich Air Crash
episodesList.summary: 6 February 1958: the plane carrying Manchester United crashes during take-off in Germany, killing 23 of the 43 on board, including eight members of the "Busby Babes".

episodesList.title: Eruption at Mount St Helens
episodesList.summary: Eruption at Mount St Helens. Rising almost 10,000 feet over Washington State, the volcano had not erupted for more than 100 years until May 1980, when its unexpected explosion unleashed a destructive force estimated to be 500 times the power of the Hiroshima atomic bomb.

episodesList.title: Chernobyl Nuclear Disaster
episodesList.summary: April 1986: a blast at a Soviet nuclear plant emits 400 times more radiation than Hiroshima's bomb. Adrian Edmondson stars in a drama documentary recalling a catastrophe that the UN claims has killed at least 8,000.

episodesList.title: San Francisco Earthquake
episodesList.summary: 17 October 1989: a tremor measuring 7.1 on the Richter scale causes major damage to the coastal city, trapping scores of drivers on the Cypress freeway. This drama documentary vividly reconstructs the disaster and the rescue mission, while survivors recall the terror.

episodesList.title: The Fastnet Yacht Race
episodesList.summary: Terror awaited men and women sailing in the infamous offshore race of August 1979. This drama documentary reconstructs the ferocious Irish Sea storm that hit the race and scattered yachts in treacherous waters - killing 15 and causing 24 crews to abandon ship.

episodesList.title: Iran Hostage Rescue
episodesList.summary: In November 1979, Iranian militants seized the US embassy in Tehran, taking 66 Americans hostage. President Carter ordered an elite US military force to launch a top-secret rescue, Operation Eagle Claw. This re-creation of the dramatic events splices the action with archive footage of those directly involved.

episodesList.title: The Sinking of The Estonia
episodesList.summary: Once a symbol of independence for the Estonian people, the ferry ventured into the Baltic's high winds and ferocious waves in September 1994. Under pressure to arrive on time, the Estonia kept going at speed - causing the car ramp to open and water to enter. Of the aboard, only 137 survived.

title: Sanya
summary: Sanya is an Indian television teen sitcom which aired on Hungama TV from 12 December 2005 to 10 March 2006.
plot:
The show is about Sanya, the girl who just cannot say "No". She is the friend to everyone in need, the most popular girl on the campus of Clarence College. Everyone except Tanyashree (Tiger) wants to be her friend. But with all those qualities she is the most indecisive person on Earth. She always needs help with solving problems. Each episode ends with Sanya asking viewers what to do, facing them with a problem that has two solutions - one selfish and the other selfless. She usually decides to be selfless and help her friends.
The show also revolves around Sanya's friends in college: Tanaaz, Shefu, Jimmy, Mihir. She is also close to her brother and parents. All in all, she is the girl-next-door with a difference.

title: Saat Phere – Saloni Ka Safar
summary: Saat Phere – Saloni Ka Safar (International title: Saloni) is an Indian Hindi-language drama television series that aired on Zee TV from 17 October 2005 to 28 May 2009. Produced by Sphere Origins, the show starred Rajshree Thakur and Sharad Kelkar. The story focused on issues of social discrimination, especially surrounding skin colour, and was one of Zee TV’s most popular shows in the mid-2000s.
plot:
The series follows Saloni (Rajshree Thakur), a young woman who faces prejudice due to her dark skin tone. Despite societal challenges, she strives to build her own identity and lead a fulfilling life through her talent of singing. Saloni marries Nahar (Sharad Kelkar) and navigates the struggles of marriage and family responsibilities while confronting social biases and various external enemies who want to harm her family.
Later in the series, following a generation leap, the focus shifts to Saloni's daughter Savri, who encounters her own challenges before the family is ultimately reunited.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text:
In November 2008, production of all Hindi television series, including Saat Phere, was halted following a strike by the Federation of Western India Cine Employees (FWICE). The dispute concerned wages and working conditions. After nearly two weeks of repeat telecasts, the strike was resolved on 19 November 2008 and fresh episodes began airing again from 1 December 2008.
Lead actor Sharad Kelkar was originally signed for 30 episodes but continued due to the popularity of his character. He eventually quit in 2009 but returned for the final episode. Rajshree Thakur also left the series during its generation leap. In April 2009, the show introduced new storylines featuring Saloni’s children.
Despite strong early ratings, the leap failed to revive viewership, leading Zee TV to end the show in May 2009.

articleSections.title: Critical response
articleSections.text: India Today described the show’s plot as "simple" but noted its role in boosting Zee TV’s ratings in the mid-2000s.

articleSections.title: Ratings
articleSections.text: The show opened with ratings around 2 TVR and steadily climbed, reaching above 6 TVR in 2006, making it one of the most-watched Hindi serials at the time. Ratings later declined after the generation leap, leading to its conclusion in May 2009.

writtenBy: Purnendu Shekhar, Sampurn Anand, Anar Anand, Rajesh Dubey

title: Shanno Ki Shaadi
summary: Shanno Ki Shaadi (transl. Shanno's Wedding) is an Indian Hindi sitcom which aired on StarPlus from 7 August 2005 to 2006 on Sunday and later weekend nights. It is based on the American film My Big Fat Greek Wedding. Produced by UTV Motion Pictures, it starred Divya Dutta and Vikas Bhalla. Initially aired on Sunday nights only, since December 2005, it became biweekly.
plot: Set in the backdrop of Punjab, the series follows the journey of a 26 year old, simple and ordinary girl, Shanno, who is unmarried and loves to make Parathas (flat bread) in her father's Dhaba. She loses her interest in marriage on not finding a suitable groom for her while her family is keen for her marriage as soon as possible. Soon, she crosses paths with a NRI Sindhi man Arjun and they both fall in love after many confusions. They soon get married and their life goes on.
reception:
The Tribune stated, "Star’s shanno Ki Shaadi looks far less shambolic. We’re happy to see the ultra-gifted Divya Dutta back on the medium. She has a way of lighting up the medium. Most of the characters are true to life. And the sequences revolving around a Punjabi wedding add to the credibility of the sitcom."
Rediff stated, "The show's USP appears to be its simplicity and the way the audience can relate to the characters."

title: Saarrthi
summary:
Saarrthi is a Hindi drama television series broadcast on Star Plus and produced by Asit Kumarr Modi under Neela Tele Films Private Limited. It aired from 8 November 2004 to 15 February 2008 and contained 708 episodes. The story is a reworking of the Hindu epic, the Mahabharata, detailing the conflict between two brothers and their families in contemporary India.
The drama serial premiered on 9 November 2004 and aired Monday through Thursday. In August 2007, Saarrthi began airing on Fridays as well.
plot: The story and characters are adapted from Mahabharata which is a story of conflict between two half-brothers – Mansen and Siddhartha (Dhritarashtra and Pandu) – and their families. The lead, Bhoomika (Subhadra), and her husband Arjun (Arjuna), portray the eternal couple who try to bring peace between the warring families. Along with them is Manasvi (Draupadi) who becomes the center of a conflict between two brothers Satya (Yudhishthira) and Suraj (Karna).While the antagonists are Shifali (Bhanumati), and her husband Yuvraj (Duryodhana).

title: Sarabhai vs Sarabhai
summary: Sarabhai vs Sarabhai is an Indian Hindi-language television sitcom that aired on STAR One from 1 November 2004 to 16 April 2006 and on Disney+ Hotstar from 15 May to 17 July 2017 for two seasons in 80 episodes altogether. The show was directed by Deven Bhojani and produced by Jamnadas D. Majethia and Aatish Kapadia under the production banner of Hats Off Productions. Starring an ensemble cast of Satish Shah, Ratna Pathak Shah, Sumeet Raghavan, Rupali Ganguly, and Rajesh Kumar, the show revolves around the Sarabhais, a quintessential upper-class Gujarati family living in the upmarket neighbourhood of Cuffe Parade in South Mumbai. The family members include the matriarch, Maya; her husband, Indravadan; their two sons, Sahil and Rosesh; Sahil's wife, Monisha; Indravadan and Maya's son-in-law, Dushyant; and Indravadan's brother-in-law, Madhusudan Fufa. Regarded as being ahead of its generation in terms of its concept, writing, and average viewership ratings at the time of its initial release, the show ultimately has gone on to become a cult classic.
plot:
Sarabhai vs Sarabhai portrays the lives of the Sarabhais, a quintessential upper-class Gujarati family living in the upmarket neighbourhood of Cuffe Parade in South Mumbai. The matriarch of the family is Maya, a snobbish woman who always tries to maintain her high-society status. Her husband, Indravadan, is an indolent, insensitive and mischievous man, who enjoys teasing his wife and other family members. The couple has two sons and a daughter; Sahil, Rosesh and Sonia. Sahil is a cosmetologist and is quite calm, wise and noble as compared to other characters, while Rosesh is an aspiring poet and actor who often makes everyone cringe with his eccentric poetry and acting as well his peculiar and amusing voice. Sahil is married to Monisha, a middle-class Punjabi girl who constantly tries to fit in with her wealthy in-laws. Maya's socialite attitude and Monisha's middle-class habits always lead to conflicts and Indravadan's playful nature only increases them, while Sahil deals with his own personal and professional challenges.
Indravadan and Maya's son-in-law, Dushyant Painter, and Indravadan's brother-in-law, Madhusudan Fufa, are also part of the family. The gadget-freak Dushyant, married to Indravadan and Maya's psychic daughter, Sonia, is an electrical engineer, who has a morbid fascination for various electronic machines. He always irritates the family by explaining different theories about different gadgets and using Rosesh for each demonstration. Dushyant's catchphrase is "I'll explain!" and does not understand sarcasm which leads to humorous situations. On the other hand, the deaf Madhusudan Fufa, married to Indravadan's older sister, Ilaben, usually does not acknowledge the fact that he cannot hear and refuses to use a hearing aid. He is a former freedom fighter who repeatedly asks questions and blames others for speaking softly. Madhusudan Fufa interrupts almost always during conversations with his catchphrase "Hain?" and his misinterpretations are particularly bothersome to Indravadan.
Comedy and conflict ensue in the daily events occurring in the Sarabhais' lives and much of the mother-in-law humour in the show is derived from the shallow interactions among the city's elite and their perceived notions of the shortcomings and failings of middle-class society. The show has a cult-like status among all the Indian sitcoms.
